```{r Download GBIF occurence data}

  # Define list of species
    species_list <- c(
      "Aedes aegypti",
      "Aedes albopictus",
      #"Aedes geniculatus",
      "Aedes vexans",
      #"Aedes caspius",
      "Culex pipiens",
      "Culex theileri",
      #"Culex hortensis",
      "Culex tritaeniorhynchus",
      "Culiseta annulata",
      #"Culiseta longiareolata",
      "Ixodes ricinus",
      "Dermacentor reticulatus",
      "Haemaphysalis inermis",
      "Dermacentor marginatus",
      "Rhipicephalus sanguineus",
      "Hyalomma marginatum",
      "Hyalomma aegyptium",
      #"Anopheles claviger",
      #"Anopheles hyrcanus",
      "Anopheles maculipennis",
      "Anopheles plumbeus",
      "Anopheles sacharovi"
    )

  # Get taxon keys for all species
    species_keys <- species_list |>
      map_dfr(~{
        backbone <- name_backbone(name = .x)
        tibble(
          searched_name = .x,
          taxon_key = backbone$usageKey,
          scientific_name = backbone$scientificName,
          rank = backbone$rank,
          status = backbone$status
        )
      })

  # Download occurrence data for Georgia (country code: GE)
    vector_georgia_download <- occ_download(
      pred_in("taxonKey", species_keys$taxon_key),
      pred("country", "GE"),
      pred("hasCoordinate", TRUE),
      format = "SIMPLE_CSV",
      user = "username", # replace
      pwd = "password", # replace
      email = "email.edu" # replace
    )
  
  # Wait for download to complete (this can take several minutes)
    occ_download_wait(vector_georgia_download)
  
  # Import the downloaded data
    vector_occurrences <- occ_download_get(vector_georgia_download) |>
      occ_download_import()
    
  # Summary by species
    species_summary <- vector_occurrences |>
      dplyr::select(species, scientificName, genus, family) |>
      group_by(species, scientificName) |>
      summarise(
        n_occurrences = n(),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) |>
      arrange(desc(n_occurrences))
    
    print(species_summary)

```

```{r Pull date, location and species from data}

  # Function to create species name from Genus + Species
    create_species_name <- function(genus, species) {
        case_when(
            is.na(genus) | genus == "" | genus == "No data" ~ NA_character_,
            is.na(species) | species == "" | species == "No data" ~ genus,
            species == "spp." | species == "sp." ~ paste(genus, "sp."),
            TRUE ~ paste(genus, species)
        )
    }

  # Helper function to convert empty strings to NA
    empty_to_na <- function(x) {
        if_else(x == "" | x == "No data", NA_character_, x)
    }

  # Date parsing function
    parse_date_flexible <- function(date_col) {
        if(inherits(date_col, "Date")) {
            return(date_col)
        }
        
        date_char <- as.character(date_col)
        date_char <- str_trim(date_char)
        
        parsed_date <- case_when(
            is.na(date_char) | date_char == "" | date_char == "No data" ~ as.Date(NA),
            str_detect(date_char, "^\\d{1,2}/\\d{1,2}/\\d{4}\\s+\\d{1,2}:\\d{2}:\\d{2}\\s+[AP]M") ~ 
                as.Date(mdy_hms(date_char)),
            str_detect(date_char, "^\\d{1,2}/\\d{1,2}/\\d{4}\\s+\\d{1,2}:\\d{2}") ~ 
                as.Date(mdy_hm(date_char)),
            str_detect(date_char, "^\\d{1,2}/\\d{1,2}/\\d{4}$") ~ mdy(date_char),
            str_detect(date_char, "^\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}") ~ ymd(date_char),
            str_detect(date_char, "^\\d{1,2}-[A-Za-z]{3}-\\d{2}$") ~ dmy(date_char),
            TRUE ~ as.Date(NA)
        )
        
        return(parsed_date)
    }

  # Process vector_occurrences (GBIF data)
    vector_occurrences_std <- vector_occurrences |>
        mutate(
            species = species,  # Use the 'species' column, not 'scientificName'
            date = parse_date_flexible(eventDate),
            latitude = decimalLatitude,
            longitude = decimalLongitude,
            count = as.numeric(individualCount),
            source = "GBIF"
        ) |>
        dplyr::select(species, date, latitude, longitude, count, source)

  # Process tick_data_vm
    tick_data_vm_std <- tick_data_vm |>
        filter(
            !(Genus %in% c("No collection (Ticks)", "No data") | 
              is.na(Genus))
        ) |>
        mutate(
            date_raw = coalesce(
                empty_to_na(as.character(EarliestDateCollected)),
                empty_to_na(as.character(VerbatimCollectingDate))
            ),
            species = create_species_name(Genus, Species),
            date = parse_date_flexible(date_raw),
            latitude = as.numeric(DecimalLongitude),
            longitude = as.numeric(DecimalLatitude),
            count = as.numeric(IndividualCount),
            source = "VectorMap_Ticks"
        ) |>
        dplyr::select(species, date, latitude, longitude, count, source)

  # Process mosquito_data_vm
    mosquito_data_vm_std <- mosquito_data_vm |>
        filter(
            !(Genus %in% c("No collection", "No data") | 
              is.na(Genus))
        ) |>
        mutate(
            date_raw = coalesce(
                empty_to_na(as.character(EarliestDateCollected)),
                empty_to_na(as.character(VerbatimCollectingDate))
            ),
            species = create_species_name(Genus, Species),
            date = parse_date_flexible(date_raw),
            latitude = as.numeric(DecimalLongitude),
            longitude = as.numeric(DecimalLatitude),
            count = as.numeric(IndividualCount),
            source = "VectorMap_Mosquitoes"
        ) |>
        dplyr::select(species, date, latitude, longitude, count, source)
  
  # Process tick_georgia_new
    tick_georgia_new_std <- tick_georgia_new |>
        filter(
            !(Genus %in% c("No collection (Ticks)", "No data") | 
              is.na(Genus))
        ) |>
        mutate(
            species = create_species_name(Genus, Species),
            date = parse_date_flexible(Start_.Date),
            latitude = as.numeric(Latitude),
            longitude = as.numeric(Longitude),
            count = as.numeric(Vector.Count),
            source = "Georgia_Ticks"
        ) |>
        dplyr::select(species, date, latitude, longitude, count, source)
  
  # Combine all datasets
    unified_vector_data <- bind_rows(
        vector_occurrences_std,
        tick_data_vm_std,
        mosquito_data_vm_std,
        tick_georgia_new_std
    ) |>
        filter(!is.na(species)) |>
        arrange(date, species)
  
  # Clean species names
    standardize_species <- function(species_name) {
        species_name |>
            str_remove_all("\\([^)]+\\)") |>
            str_remove_all(",\\s*\\d{4}") |>
            str_remove_all("\\s+\\d{4}$") |>
            str_trim() |>
            str_extract("^\\S+\\s+\\S+") |>
            str_trim()
    }
  
  # Function to identify records to remove
    should_remove <- function(species_name) {
        case_when(
            str_detect(species_name, "^BOLD:") ~ TRUE,
            str_detect(species_name, "Unidentified") ~ TRUE,
            str_detect(species_name, "<Null>") ~ TRUE,
            str_detect(species_name, "^\\S+\\s*$") ~ TRUE,
            str_detect(species_name, "^\\S+\\s+$") ~ TRUE,
            str_detect(species_name, "\\ssp\\.$") ~ TRUE,
            TRUE ~ FALSE
        )
    }
  
  # Clean the dataset
    unified_vector_data <- unified_vector_data |>
        mutate(
            species_clean = standardize_species(species),
            remove_flag = should_remove(species)
        ) |>
        filter(
            !remove_flag,
            !is.na(species_clean),
            species_clean != ""
        ) |>
        mutate(species = species_clean) |>
        dplyr::select(-species_clean, -remove_flag)
  
  # Summary statistics
    summary_stats <- unified_vector_data |>
        group_by(source) |>
        summarise(
            n_records = n(),
            n_species = n_distinct(species),
            n_with_count = sum(!is.na(count)),
            n_with_coords = sum(!is.na(latitude) & !is.na(longitude)),
            n_with_date = sum(!is.na(date)),
            date_range = if_else(
                sum(!is.na(date)) > 0,
                paste(min(date, na.rm = TRUE), "to", max(date, na.rm = TRUE)),
                "No dates available"
            )
        )
  
    print(sort(unique(unified_vector_data$species)))
  
  # View the result
    unified_vector_data
```

```{r Clean species column}

  # Function to standardize species names
    standardize_species <- function(species_name) {
        species_name |>
            # Remove author citations in parentheses
              str_remove_all("\\([^)]+\\)") |>
            # Remove author citations without parentheses (comma followed by year)
              str_remove_all(",\\s*\\d{4}") |>
            # Remove standalone years
              str_remove_all("\\s+\\d{4}$") |>
            # Remove leading/trailing whitespace
              str_trim() |>
            # Extract just Genus and species (first two words)
              str_extract("^\\S+\\s+\\S+") |>
            # Final trim
              str_trim()
    }

  # Function to identify records to remove
    should_remove <- function(species_name) {
        case_when(
            # Remove BOLD identifiers
              str_detect(species_name, "^BOLD:") ~ TRUE,
            # Remove "Unidentified"
              str_detect(species_name, "Unidentified") ~ TRUE,
            # Remove <Null> entries
              str_detect(species_name, "<Null>") ~ TRUE,
            # Remove entries that are just genus + blank
              str_detect(species_name, "^\\S+\\s*$") ~ TRUE,
            # Remove entries with only whitespace after genus
              str_detect(species_name, "^\\S+\\s+$") ~ TRUE,
            # Remove entries ending in "sp." (genus-level only)
              str_detect(species_name, "\\ssp\\.$") ~ TRUE,
            # Keep everything else
              TRUE ~ FALSE
        )
    }

  # Clean the unified dataset
    unified_vector_data_clean <- unified_vector_data |>
        mutate(
            # Create standardized species name
              species_clean = standardize_species(species),
            # Flag records to remove
              remove_flag = should_remove(species)
        ) |>
      # Keep records that shouldn't be removed and have a valid species_clean
        filter(
            !remove_flag,
            !is.na(species_clean),
            species_clean != ""
        ) |>
      # Replace original species with cleaned version
        mutate(species = species_clean) |>
      # Remove temporary columns
        dplyr::select(-species_clean, -remove_flag)

  # Check the cleaning results
    print(sort(unique(unified_vector_data_clean$species)))
  
  # Summary by source after cleaning
    summary_after_cleaning <- unified_vector_data_clean |>
        group_by(source) |>
        summarise(
            n_records = n(),
            n_species = n_distinct(species),
            n_with_count = sum(!is.na(count)),
            n_with_coords = sum(!is.na(latitude) & !is.na(longitude)),
            n_with_date = sum(!is.na(date))
        )
    
    print(summary_after_cleaning)

  # Replace the unified dataset with cleaned version
    unified_vector_data <- unified_vector_data_clean
```

```{r Canonical Municipality Boundaries}

  # Set the municipalities and boundaries for Georgia explicitly

  # Raw URL for the zip file in the github repo
    geojson_url <- "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/IanPsheaSmith/GeorgiaVectors/main/Shapefiles/gadm/geo_admin_boundaries.geojson.zip"
  
  # Download zip to a temporary file, then unzip to a temp directory
    temp_zip <- tempfile(fileext = ".zip")
    temp_dir <- tempdir()
  
    download.file(geojson_url, destfile = temp_zip, mode = "wb")
    unzip(temp_zip, exdir = temp_dir, overwrite = TRUE)
  
  # Read all three administrative levels
    georgia_admin0 <- st_read(file.path(temp_dir, "geo_admin0.geojson"), quiet = TRUE)
    georgia_admin1 <- st_read(file.path(temp_dir, "geo_admin1.geojson"), quiet = TRUE)
    georgia_admin2 <- st_read(file.path(temp_dir, "geo_admin2.geojson"), quiet = TRUE)

  ## Name mapping: GeoJSON adm2_name → SVI municipality slug

        "Poti"    = "poti",    "Rustavi" = "rustavi",

        "Chkhorotsku"    = "chxorowyu",     "Baghdati"       = "bagdadi",
        "Bagdati"        = "bagdadi",       "Kareli"         = "qareli",
        "Qareli"         = "qareli",        "Sighnaghi"      = "signagi",
        "Signagi"        = "signagi",       "Ninotsminda"    = "ninowminda",
        "Tkibuli"        = "tyibuli",       "Zestaponi"      = "zestafoni",
        "Kazbegi"        = "yazbegi",
        ## Direct matches
        "Abasha"      = "abasha",      "Adigeni"     = "adigeni",
        "Aspindza"    = "aspindza",     "Akhalkalaki" = "axalqalaqi",
        "Bolnisi"     = "bolnisi",      "Borjomi"     = "borjomi",
        "Chiatura"    = "chiatura",     "Chokhatauri" = "choxatauri",
        "Dmanisi"     = "dmanisi",      "Dusheti"     = "dusheti",

        "Marneuli"    = "marneuli",     "Martvili"    = "martvili",
        "Mestia"      = "mestia",       "Oni"         = "oni",
        "Keda"        = "qeda",         "Kobuleti"    = "qobuleti",

  ## Map names and extract Tbilisi from admin1 
    georgia_admin2_mapped <- georgia_admin2 |>
        mutate(
            municipality_mapped = dplyr::case_when(
                adm2_name %in% names(name_mapping) ~ name_mapping[adm2_name],
                TRUE ~ tolower(adm2_name)

        ) |>
        dplyr::select(adm2_name, adm1_name, municipality_mapped, geometry)

    tbilisi_geom <- georgia_admin1 |>
        dplyr::filter(str_detect(tolower(adm1_name), "tbilisi")) |>
        mutate(
            adm2_name           = "Tbilisi",
            municipality_mapped = "tbilisi"
        ) |>
        dplyr::select(adm2_name, adm1_name, municipality_mapped, geometry)

  ## Combine and dissolve to one polygon per SVI municipality
    muni_boundaries <- bind_rows(georgia_admin2_mapped, tbilisi_geom) |>
        group_by(municipality_mapped) |>
        summarise(
            geometry = sf::st_union(geometry),
            .groups  = "drop"
        ) |>
        sf::st_make_valid()

  ## Country outline for clipping and base-layer mapping
    georgia_union <- sf::st_union(muni_boundaries)
```

```{r Load in Covariates}
                \(url, dest) download.file(url, destfile = dest, mode = "wb", quiet = TRUE)
            )
        ) |>
        dplyr::filter(file.size(local_path) > 0)
  
  ## Build named path vector for monthly rasters (excludes Combined, Baseline, Static)

        dplyr::filter(
            !stringr::str_detect(file_name, "Combined|Baseline|Static")
        ) |>
        dplyr::arrange(file_name) |>
        dplyr::pull(local_path) |>
        rlang::set_names(
            ~ stringr::str_remove(basename(.), "\\.tif$")
        )
  
  ## Load baseline raster

      dplyr::filter(stringr::str_detect(file_name, "Baseline")) |>
```

```{r Test & Check for Swapped Lat/Lon and "Problem" Dates}

  georgia_boundary <- sf::st_union(georgia_admin0)

	## Build sf from the raw filtered data
  	uvc_sf <- unified_vector_data_filtered |>
  		dplyr::filter(!is.na(latitude) & !is.na(longitude)) |>
  		sf::st_as_sf(coords = c("longitude", "latitude"), crs = 4326, remove = FALSE)

    	inside_original <- as.logical(
    		sf::st_intersects(uvc_sf, georgia_boundary, sparse = FALSE)
    	)

	outside_sf <- uvc_sf[!inside_original, ] |> sf::st_drop_geometry()

	cat("  Total records:", nrow(uvc_sf), "\n")
	cat("  Inside Georgia:", sum(inside_original), "\n")
	cat("  Outside Georgia:", nrow(outside_sf), "\n")

	## Test if swapping lat/lon fixes outside records
  	swap_test_sf <- outside_sf |>
  		sf::st_as_sf(coords = c("latitude", "longitude"), crs = 4326)
  
  	swap_fixes <- as.logical(
  		sf::st_intersects(swap_test_sf, georgia_boundary, sparse = FALSE)
  	)
  
  	cat("  Fixable by swap:", sum(swap_fixes, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
  	cat("  Unfixable:", sum(!swap_fixes, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")

	## Build swap key from the fixable records
  	swap_keys <- outside_sf[swap_fixes, ] |>
  		dplyr::mutate(key = paste(species, date, latitude, longitude)) |>
  		dplyr::pull(key)

	## Create corrected dataset: swap where needed, then clip
  	unified_vector_data_corrected <- unified_vector_data_filtered |>
  		dplyr::mutate(
  			key = paste(species, date, latitude, longitude),
  			needs_swap = key %in% swap_keys,
  			lat_new = dplyr::if_else(needs_swap, longitude, latitude),
  			lon_new = dplyr::if_else(needs_swap, latitude, longitude),
  			latitude = lat_new,
  			longitude = lon_new
  		) |>
  		dplyr::select(-key, -needs_swap, -lat_new, -lon_new)
  
  	cat("  Swapped", length(swap_keys), "records\n")

	## Clip: remove anything still outside after swapping
  	uvc_sf_final <- unified_vector_data_corrected |>
  		dplyr::filter(!is.na(latitude) & !is.na(longitude)) |>
  		sf::st_as_sf(coords = c("longitude", "latitude"), crs = 4326, remove = FALSE)
  
  	inside_final <- as.logical(
  		sf::st_intersects(uvc_sf_final, georgia_boundary, sparse = FALSE)
  	)
  
  	n_removed <- sum(!inside_final)
  	unified_vector_data_corrected <- uvc_sf_final[inside_final, ] |>
  		sf::st_drop_geometry()
  
  	cat(sprintf("  Final: %d records (%d swapped, %d removed as unfixable)\n",
  	            nrow(unified_vector_data_corrected),
  	            length(swap_keys), n_removed))

	## Apply the date corrections
  	PLACEHOLDER_SPECIES <- c("Aedes aegypti", "Aedes albopictus")
  	PRE2000_SPECIES     <- c("Culex tritaeniorhynchus", "Anopheles sacharovi")
  
  	unified_vector_data_corrected <- unified_vector_data_corrected |>
  		dplyr::mutate(
  			date = dplyr::case_when(
  				species %in% PLACEHOLDER_SPECIES &
  					lubridate::month(date) == 1L &
  					lubridate::mday(date)  == 1L          ~ as.Date(NA),
  				species %in% PRE2000_SPECIES &
  					!is.na(date) &
  					lubridate::year(date) < 2000           ~ as.Date(NA),
  				TRUE                                       ~ date
  			),
  			month_name = lubridate::month(date, label = TRUE, abbr = FALSE) |>
  				as.character()
  		)

	## Clean up
  	rm(uvc_sf, uvc_sf_final, outside_sf, swap_test_sf,
  	   inside_original, inside_final, swap_fixes, swap_keys,
  	   georgia_boundary)
  	gc()
```

```{r Spatial thinning of presence points}

	## Preserve pre-thinning counts for comparison
  	pre_thinning_counts <- unified_vector_data_corrected |>
  		dplyr::group_by(species) |>
  		dplyr::summarise(
  			n_pre = dplyr::n(),
  			.groups = "drop"
  		)

	## Assign each record to a raster cell using the baseline covariate grid.
	## cellFromXY() maps each lon/lat pair to its enclosing cell index at the
	## ~1 km modeling resolution, ensuring thinning operates at the same scale
	## as covariate extraction and prediction.
  	unified_vector_data_corrected <- unified_vector_data_corrected |>
  		dplyr::mutate(
  			cell_id = terra::cellFromXY(
  				baseline_raster,
  				cbind(longitude, latitude)
  			)
  		)

	## Quick diagnostic: how many records fall outside the raster extent?
	  n_outside <- sum(is.na(unified_vector_data_corrected$cell_id))

  	if (n_outside > 0) {
  		cat("  NOTE:", n_outside, "records fall outside the baseline raster extent.\n")
  		cat("  These will be retained but could not be assigned a cell_id.\n\n")
  	}

	## Split by temporal status, thin each partition, then recombine.
	## Records WITH a month: one per species × cell × month preserves seasonal signal
  	records_with_month <- unified_vector_data_corrected |>
  		dplyr::filter(!is.na(month_name) & !is.na(cell_id)) |>
  		dplyr::distinct(species, cell_id, month_name, .keep_all = TRUE)

	## Records WITHOUT a month (NA): one per species × cell (pure spatial dedup)
  	records_baseline <- unified_vector_data_corrected |>
  		dplyr::filter(is.na(month_name) & !is.na(cell_id)) |>
  		dplyr::distinct(species, cell_id, .keep_all = TRUE)

	## Records outside raster extent: retain as-is (rare edge cases)
  	records_outside <- unified_vector_data_corrected |>
  		dplyr::filter(is.na(cell_id))

	## Recombine and drop the temporary cell_id column
  	unified_vector_data_corrected <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  		records_with_month,
  		records_baseline,
  		records_outside
  	) |>
  		dplyr::select(-cell_id) |>
  		dplyr::arrange(species, date)

	## Clean up partition objects
	  rm(records_with_month, records_baseline, records_outside)



## Thinning summary: before vs after counts with tier assignment preview


	## Compute post-thinning counts and assign preliminary tiers
  	post_thinning_counts <- unified_vector_data_corrected |>
  		dplyr::group_by(species) |>
  		dplyr::summarise(
  			n_post = dplyr::n(),
  			.groups = "drop"
  		)

	## Join pre and post, compute reduction, and assign tiers for both
  	thinning_summary <- pre_thinning_counts |>
  		dplyr::left_join(post_thinning_counts, by = "species") |>
  		dplyr::mutate(
  			n_removed   = n_pre - n_post,
  			pct_removed = round((n_removed / n_pre) * 100, 1),
  			## Tier assignments based on pre-thinning counts
    			tier_pre = dplyr::case_when(
    				n_pre < 10  ~ "Excluded",
    				n_pre <= 50 ~ "ESM",
    				n_pre <= 100 ~ "Tuned_BRT",
    				TRUE ~ "Standard_BRT"
    			),
  			## Tier assignments based on post-thinning counts
    			tier_post = dplyr::case_when(
    				n_post < 10  ~ "Excluded",
    				n_post <= 50 ~ "ESM",
    				n_post <= 100 ~ "Tuned_BRT",
    				TRUE ~ "Standard_BRT"
    			),
  			## Flag species whose tier changed
  			  tier_changed = tier_pre != tier_post
  		) |>
  		dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(n_pre))
	

  	thinning_summary |>
  		dplyr::select(species, n_pre, n_post, n_removed, pct_removed,
  		              tier_pre, tier_post, tier_changed) |>
  		print(n = Inf, width = Inf)

	## Highlight any tier changes for manual review
  	tier_changes <- thinning_summary |>
  		dplyr::filter(tier_changed)
  
  	if (nrow(tier_changes) > 0) {
  		cat("\n  TIER CHANGES DETECTED -- review before proceeding:\n\n")
  		tier_changes |>
  			dplyr::mutate(
  				label = sprintf("    %-30s  %s (%d) -> %s (%d)",
  				                species, tier_pre, n_pre, tier_post, n_post)
  			) |>
  			dplyr::pull(label) |>
  			purrr::walk(cat, "\n")
  		cat("\n")
  	} else {
  		cat("\n  No tier changes from thinning.\n")
  	}

	## Report overall reduction
  	cat(sprintf("\n  Total records:  %d -> %d  (%.1f%% reduction)\n",
  	            sum(thinning_summary$n_pre),
  	            sum(thinning_summary$n_post),
  	            (1 - sum(thinning_summary$n_post) / sum(thinning_summary$n_pre)) * 100))
```

```{r Define PA Generation & Cov Extraction Functions}

  # Projected CRS for Georgia - UTM Zone 38N, used for accurate metric buffering
    CRS_PROJECTED <- "EPSG:32638"
    CRS_WGS84     <- "EPSG:4326"

  #' Generate Pseudo-Absences for a Single Species
  #'
  #' Samples background points from the valid (non-NA) extent of a reference
  #' raster, excluding a buffer around all known presence locations, and clipped
  #' to the study boundary to exclude regions without presence data (e.g.,
  #' Abkhazia, South Ossetia). Points are distributed proportionally across the
  #' species' observed months so that monthly covariate extraction is temporally
  #' matched. Records with no date (NA month) are assigned to the baseline
  #' raster at extraction time.
  #'
  #' @param species_name    Character. Species label attached to output rows.
  #' @param species_data    Data frame. Presence records with longitude/latitude.
  #' @param n_pas           Integer. Number of pseudo-absences to generate.
  #' @param buffer_km       Numeric. Exclusion buffer radius around presences (km).
  #' @param observed_months Character vector. Months observed for this species.
  #' @param extent_mask     SpatRaster. Template raster defining valid sampling domain.
  #' @param study_boundary  sf polygon. Boundary clipping the sampling domain
  #'                        (e.g., georgia_union — excludes separatist regions).
  #' @return Tibble with columns: species, longitude, latitude, month_name, presence.
  
  generate_species_pseudo_absences <- function(species_name,
                                               species_data,
                                               n_pas,
                                               buffer_km,
                                               observed_months,
                                               extent_mask,
                                               study_boundary) {
  
    buffer_m <- buffer_km * 1000
  
    ## Convert valid raster cells to a sampling polygon, projected for buffering
      valid_mask  <- !is.na(extent_mask)
      valid_polys <- terra::as.polygons(valid_mask) |>
        sf::st_as_sf() |>
        dplyr::filter(dplyr::across(1, ~ .x == 1)) |>
        sf::st_union() |>
        sf::st_transform(CRS_PROJECTED)
  
    ## Clip valid raster extent to study boundary (excludes separatist regions)
      study_boundary_proj <- study_boundary |>
        sf::st_transform(CRS_PROJECTED)
    
      valid_polys <- sf::st_intersection(valid_polys, study_boundary_proj)
  
    ## Build exclusion zone: union of buffered presence points
      presence_sf <- species_data |>
        dplyr::filter(!is.na(longitude) & !is.na(latitude)) |>
        sf::st_as_sf(coords = c("longitude", "latitude"), crs = CRS_WGS84) |>
        sf::st_transform(CRS_PROJECTED)
    
      exclusion_zone <- presence_sf |>
        sf::st_buffer(dist = buffer_m) |>
        sf::st_union()
  
    ## Subtract exclusion zone from valid (clipped) sampling area
      available_area <- sf::st_difference(valid_polys, exclusion_zone)
    
      if (length(available_area) == 0 || sf::st_is_empty(available_area)) {
        warning("No valid sampling area remains after buffer exclusion for: ", species_name)
        return(tibble::tibble(
          species    = character(),
          longitude  = numeric(),
          latitude   = numeric(),
          month_name = character(),
          presence   = integer()
        ))
      }
  
    ## Assign months proportionally across observed months.
    ## If no months are observed (all baseline records), all PAs get NA month.
      if (length(observed_months) == 0) {
        month_assignments <- rep(NA_character_, n_pas)
      } else {
        month_counts      <- rep(floor(n_pas / length(observed_months)), length(observed_months))
        remainder         <- n_pas - sum(month_counts)
        month_counts[seq_len(remainder)] <- month_counts[seq_len(remainder)] + 1L
        month_assignments <- rep(observed_months, times = month_counts) |>
          sample()
      }
  
    ## Sample random points within available area; oversample then trim
      n_sample    <- ceiling(n_pas * 1.5)
      sampled_pts <- sf::st_sample(available_area, size = n_sample, type = "random") |>
        sf::st_as_sf() |>
        dplyr::slice_head(n = n_pas) |>
        sf::st_transform(CRS_WGS84) |>
        dplyr::mutate(
          longitude = sf::st_coordinates(x)[, 1],
          latitude  = sf::st_coordinates(x)[, 2]
        ) |>
        sf::st_drop_geometry()
    
      ## Attach species label, month assignments, and presence = 0
      sampled_pts |>
        dplyr::mutate(
          species    = species_name,
          month_name = month_assignments[seq_len(nrow(sampled_pts))],
          presence   = 0L
        ) |>
        dplyr::select(species, longitude, latitude, month_name, presence)
    }


  # Categorical layers requiring majority extraction rather than mean
    CATEGORICAL_LAYERS <- "WorldCover"

  #' Extract Covariates for a Single Point Using a Circular Buffer
  #'
  #' Determines the appropriate raster (monthly or baseline) from the record's
  #' month, creates a circular buffer around the point, and extracts covariate
  #' values using mean for continuous layers and majority for WorldCover.
  #' Falls back to baseline_raster for any record with NA or unrecognised month.
  #'
  #' @param longitude  Numeric. WGS84 longitude.
  #' @param latitude   Numeric. WGS84 latitude.
  #' @param month_name Character. Full month name (e.g. "July") or NA.
  #' @param buffer_m   Numeric. Buffer radius in metres (default 1000).
  #' @return Single-row data frame of extracted covariate values.

    extract_covariates_for_record_buffered <- function(longitude,
                                                           latitude,
                                                           month_name,
                                                           buffer_m = 1000) {
    
          # Select monthly or baseline raster
            raster_to_use <- if (!is.na(month_name) && month_name %in% names(month_to_raster)) {
              month_to_raster[[month_name]]
            } else {
              baseline_raster
            }
    
          # Build a 1km circular buffer, projected to UTM 38N for accurate metric
          # distances, then transformed back to match the raster CRS
            point_sf <- sf::st_as_sf(
                data.frame(x = longitude, y = latitude),
                coords = c("x", "y"),
                crs    = CRS_WGS84
              ) |>
              sf::st_transform(CRS_PROJECTED) |>
              sf::st_buffer(dist = buffer_m) |>
              sf::st_transform(sf::st_crs(raster_to_use))
    
          # Partition layer names into continuous and categorical
            layer_names      <- names(raster_to_use)
            categorical_here <- intersect(CATEGORICAL_LAYERS, layer_names)
            continuous_here  <- setdiff(layer_names, categorical_here)
    
          # Extract continuous layers (mean); exact_extract returns a data frame
          # when given a multi-layer raster
            continuous_vals <- if (length(continuous_here) > 0) {
              exactextractr::exact_extract(
                raster_to_use[[continuous_here]],
                point_sf,
                fun      = "mean",
                progress = FALSE
              ) |>
                as.data.frame() |>
                dplyr::rename_with(~ stringr::str_remove(.x, "^mean\\."))
            } else {
              data.frame()
            }
    
          # Extract categorical layers (majority)
            categorical_vals <- if (length(categorical_here) > 0) {
              raw <- exactextractr::exact_extract(
                raster_to_use[[categorical_here]],
                point_sf,
                fun      = "majority",
                progress = FALSE
              )

              if (!is.data.frame(raw)) {
                raw <- stats::setNames(data.frame(raw), paste0("majority.", categorical_here))
              }
              raw |>
                as.data.frame() |>
                dplyr::rename_with(~ stringr::str_remove(.x, "^majority\\."))
            } else {
              data.frame()
            }
    
          dplyr::bind_cols(continuous_vals, categorical_vals)
        }
```

```{r Pseudo-absence generatio}

  # Set species parameters for PA generation
    species_modeling_params <- unified_vector_data_corrected |>
      dplyr::group_by(species) |>
      dplyr::summarise(
        n_occurrences = n(),
        n_unique_locations = n_distinct(paste(latitude, longitude)),
        # Extract unique months, excluding NA
          observed_months = list(unique(month_name[!is.na(month_name)])),
          n_months_observed = length(unique(month_name[!is.na(month_name)])),
          n_records_with_month = sum(!is.na(month_name)),
          n_records_baseline = sum(is.na(month_name))
      ) |>
      dplyr::filter(n_occurrences >= 10) |>  # Drop very low-n species
      dplyr::mutate(
        # Determine modeling approach
          modeling_approach = dplyr::case_when(
            n_occurrences <= 50 ~ "ESM",
            n_occurrences <= 100 ~ "Tuned_BRT",
            TRUE ~ "Standard_BRT"
          ),
        # Number of pseudo-absences to generate
        n_pseudo_absences = dplyr::case_when(
          modeling_approach == "ESM" ~ 10000L,
          TRUE ~ as.integer(n_occurrences)  # 1:1 for BRTs
        ),
        # PA 10K buffer
          pa_buffer_km = 10
      )
    
    print(species_modeling_params, n = Inf)

  # Extract study extent from baseline raster
    georgia_extent <- ext(baseline_raster)
    georgia_mask <- baseline_raster[[1]]  # Use first layer as template
    georgia_mask[!is.na(georgia_mask)] <- 1

  # Generate the pseudo-absences 
    species_params_list <- species_modeling_params |>
      dplyr::mutate(
        # Convert observed_months list column to a format pmap can handle
          observed_months_vec = purrr::map(observed_months, ~.x)
      ) |>
      dplyr::select(
        species, 
        n_pseudo_absences, 
        pa_buffer_km, 
        observed_months_vec
      )
    
  # Generate the pseudo-absences 
    pseudo_absences_list <- purrr::pmap_dfr(
      list(
        species_name    = species_params_list$species,
        n_pas           = species_params_list$n_pseudo_absences,
        buffer_km       = species_params_list$pa_buffer_km,
        observed_months = species_params_list$observed_months_vec
      ),
      function(species_name, n_pas, buffer_km, observed_months) {
    
        species_data <- unified_vector_data_corrected |>
          dplyr::filter(species == species_name)
    
        pas <- generate_species_pseudo_absences(
          species_name    = species_name,
          species_data    = species_data,
          n_pas           = n_pas,
          buffer_km       = buffer_km,
          observed_months = observed_months,
          extent_mask     = georgia_mask,
          study_boundary  = georgia_union
        )
        return(pas)
      }
    )
    
  pseudo_absences_list |>
    dplyr::group_by(species) |>
    dplyr::summarise(
      n_pas = n(),
      n_months = n_distinct(month_name, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    print(n = Inf)
```

```{r Extract Covariates}
  # Function to extract covariates for a single record
    extract_covariates_for_record <- function(longitude, latitude, month_name) {
      
      # Convert to spatial point
      point <- terra::vect(
        data.frame(x = longitude, y = latitude),
        geom = c("x", "y"),
        crs = "EPSG:4326"
      )
      
      # Determine which raster to use
      if (is.na(month_name) || !month_name %in% names(month_to_raster)) {
        raster_to_use <- baseline_raster
      } else {
        raster_to_use <- month_to_raster[[month_name]]
      }
      
      # Extract values
      extracted_values <- terra::extract(raster_to_use, point, ID = FALSE)
      
      return(as.data.frame(extracted_values))
    }
```

```{r Generate the 100 PAs}
  # Filter for BRT species that need multiple PA sets
    brt_species <- species_modeling_params |>
      dplyr::filter(modeling_approach %in% c("Standard_BRT", "Tuned_BRT")) |>
      dplyr::mutate(
        # Convert observed_months list column to a format pmap can handle

      )
  
  # Define output directory
    output_dir <- "your local directory" # Replace with your local directory
    dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  
  # Generate and save 100 PA sets for each BRT species
    purrr::walk(
      1:100,
      function(iteration) {
        # Set unique seed for this iteration
          set.seed(1000 + iteration)
        
        # Generate PAs for all BRT species in this iteration
          iteration_pas <- purrr::pmap_dfr(
            list(
              species_name = brt_species$species,
              n_pas = brt_species$n_pseudo_absences,
              buffer_km = brt_species$pa_buffer_km,
              observed_months = brt_species$observed_months_vec
            ),
            function(species_name, n_pas, buffer_km, observed_months) {
              
              # Filter data for this species
                species_data <- unified_vector_data_corrected |>
                  dplyr::filter(species == species_name)
              
              # Generate PAs (with monthly distribution)
                pas <- generate_species_pseudo_absences(
                  species_name = species_name,
                  species_data = species_data,
                  n_pas = n_pas,
                  buffer_km = buffer_km,
                  observed_months = observed_months,
                  extent_mask = georgia_mask,
                  study_boundary  = georgia_union
                )
              
              return(pas)
            }
        ) |>
          dplyr::mutate(pa_iteration = iteration)
        
        # Save this iteration to disk
        saveRDS(
          iteration_pas,
          file = file.path(output_dir, paste0("brt_pas_iteration_", sprintf("%03d", iteration), ".rds"))
        )
      }
    )
  
  # Verify files were created
    created_files <- list.files(output_dir, pattern = "^brt_pas_iteration_.*\\.rds$", full.names = TRUE)
```

```{r Collinearity Assessment — Taxon-Level VIF}
  
  ## Species-to-taxon classification
  
  	ALL_MOSQUITO_SPECIES <- c(
  		"Aedes aegypti", "Aedes albopictus", 
  		#"Aedes caspius",
  		#"Aedes geniculatus", 
  		"Aedes vexans",
  		"Anopheles maculipennis", "Anopheles plumbeus", "Anopheles sacharovi",
  		"Culex pipiens", "Culex theileri", "Culex tritaeniorhynchus",
  		"Culiseta annulata"#, "Culiseta longiareolata"
  	)
  
  	ALL_TICK_SPECIES <- c(
  		"Dermacentor marginatus", "Dermacentor reticulatus",
  		"Haemaphysalis inermis",
  		"Hyalomma aegyptium", "Hyalomma marginatum",
  		"Ixodes ricinus",
  		"Rhipicephalus sanguineus"
  	)
  
  ## Candidate predictor sets (continuous only; WorldCover handled separately)
  
  	MOSQUITO_CONTINUOUS <- c(
  		"hurs", "pr", "sfcWind", "tas", "tasmax", "tasmin",
  		"NDVI", "Elevation", "Slope"
  	)
  
  	TICK_CONTINUOUS <- c(
  		"hurs", "pr", "tas", "tasmax", "tasmin",
  		"NDVI", "Elevation", "Slope",
  		"BulkDensity", "CoarseFragments", "Nitrogen",
  		"SoilpH", "SandContent", "SiltContent", "SoilOrganicCarbon"
  	)
  
  	CATEGORICAL_VAR <- "WorldCover"
  
  
  ## VIF helper functions
  
  	#' Compute VIF for all columns in a data frame of continuous predictors.
  	#' VIF_j = 1 / (1 - R²_j), where R²_j is from regressing variable j
  	#' on all remaining variables.
  	compute_vif <- function(data) {
  		vars <- names(data)
  		purrr::map_dfr(vars, function(v) {
  			fml <- as.formula(paste(v, "~ ."))
  			r2  <- summary(stats::lm(fml, data = data))$r.squared
  			tibble::tibble(variable = v, vif = 1 / (1 - r2), r_squared = r2)
  		}) |>
  			dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(vif))
  	}
  
  	#' Stepwise VIF removal: iteratively drop the highest-VIF variable
  	#' until all remaining variables have VIF below the threshold.
  	#' Returns the retained set, removal order, and final VIF table.
  	stepwise_vif <- function(data, threshold = 10, verbose = TRUE) {
  
  		current_data <- data
  		removal_log  <- tibble::tibble(
  			step     = integer(),
  			removed  = character(),
  			vif_at_removal = numeric()
  		)
  
  		step <- 0L
  
  		repeat {
  			vif_table <- compute_vif(current_data)
  			max_vif   <- max(vif_table$vif)
  
  			if (max_vif < threshold) break
  
  			step <- step + 1L
  			worst_var <- vif_table$variable[which.max(vif_table$vif)]
  			worst_vif <- max_vif
  
  			removal_log <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  				removal_log,
  				tibble::tibble(
  					step = step, removed = worst_var, vif_at_removal = worst_vif
  				)
  			)
  
  			if (verbose) {
  				cat(sprintf("    Step %d: removed %-20s (VIF = %.1f)\n",
  				            step, worst_var, worst_vif))
  			}
  
  			current_data <- current_data |>
  				dplyr::select(-dplyr::all_of(worst_var))
  		}
  
  		list(
  			retained    = names(current_data),
  			removed     = removal_log,
  			final_vif   = compute_vif(current_data),
  			n_removed   = nrow(removal_log)
  		)
  	}
  
  
  ## Extract covariate matrices by taxon
  
  	## Mosquito records (presence + PA) — continuous predictors only
    	mosquito_cov_matrix <- combined_pa_presence_with_covariates |>
    		dplyr::filter(species %in% ALL_MOSQUITO_SPECIES) |>
    		dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(MOSQUITO_CONTINUOUS)) |>
    		tidyr::drop_na()
  
  	## Tick records (presence + PA) — continuous predictors only
    	tick_cov_matrix <- combined_pa_presence_with_covariates |>
    		dplyr::filter(species %in% ALL_TICK_SPECIES) |>
    		dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(TICK_CONTINUOUS)) |>
    		tidyr::drop_na()
  
    	cat("  Mosquito covariate matrix:", nrow(mosquito_cov_matrix), "records x",
    	    ncol(mosquito_cov_matrix), "continuous predictors\n")
    	cat("  Tick covariate matrix:    ", nrow(tick_cov_matrix), "records x",
    	    ncol(tick_cov_matrix), "continuous predictors\n\n")
    
  
  ## Pairwise Pearson correlations
  	
  	## Mosquito correlations — flag pairs with |r| > 0.7
  	  mosquito_cor <- cor(mosquito_cov_matrix, use = "complete.obs")
  
    	mosquito_high_cor <- mosquito_cor |>
    		as.data.frame() |>
    		tibble::rownames_to_column("var1") |>
    		tidyr::pivot_longer(-var1, names_to = "var2", values_to = "r") |>
    		dplyr::filter(var1 < var2, abs(r) > 0.7) |>
    		dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(abs(r)))
  
    	cat("  MOSQUITOES — pairs with |r| > 0.7:\n")
    	if (nrow(mosquito_high_cor) == 0) {
    		cat("    None\n\n")
    	} else {
    		purrr::pwalk(mosquito_high_cor, function(var1, var2, r) {
    			cat(sprintf("    %-15s × %-15s  r = %+.3f\n", var1, var2, r))
    		})
    		cat("\n")
    	}
  
  	## Tick correlations — flag pairs with |r| > 0.7
    	tick_cor <- cor(tick_cov_matrix, use = "complete.obs")
    
    	tick_high_cor <- tick_cor |>
    		as.data.frame() |>
    		tibble::rownames_to_column("var1") |>
    		tidyr::pivot_longer(-var1, names_to = "var2", values_to = "r") |>
    		dplyr::filter(var1 < var2, abs(r) > 0.7) |>
    		dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(abs(r)))
    
    	cat("  TICKS — pairs with |r| > 0.7:\n")
    	if (nrow(tick_high_cor) == 0) {
    		cat("    None\n\n")
    	} else {
    		purrr::pwalk(tick_high_cor, function(var1, var2, r) {
    			cat(sprintf("    %-15s × %-15s  r = %+.3f\n", var1, var2, r))
    		})
    		cat("\n")
    	}
  
  
  ## Stepwise VIF (threshold = 10)
    	
  	## -- Mosquitoes --
    	cat("  MOSQUITOES:\n")
    	cat("  Initial predictors:", paste(MOSQUITO_CONTINUOUS, collapse = ", "), "\n\n")
    
    	mosquito_vif_result <- stepwise_vif(mosquito_cov_matrix, threshold = 10)
    
    	if (mosquito_vif_result$n_removed == 0) {
    		cat("    No variables exceeded VIF = 10; all retained.\n")
    	}
    
    	cat("\n  Final mosquito VIF values:\n")
    	purrr::pwalk(mosquito_vif_result$final_vif, function(variable, vif, r_squared) {
    		cat(sprintf("    %-20s  VIF = %6.2f  (R² = %.3f)\n",
    		            variable, vif, r_squared))
    	})
  
  	## -- Ticks --
    	cat("\n\n  TICKS:\n")
    	cat("  Initial predictors:", paste(TICK_CONTINUOUS, collapse = ", "), "\n\n")
    
    	tick_vif_result <- stepwise_vif(tick_cov_matrix, threshold = 10)
    
    	if (tick_vif_result$n_removed == 0) {
    		cat("    No variables exceeded VIF = 10; all retained.\n")
    	}
    
    	cat("\n  Final tick VIF values:\n")
    	purrr::pwalk(tick_vif_result$final_vif, function(variable, vif, r_squared) {
    		cat(sprintf("    %-20s  VIF = %6.2f  (R² = %.3f)\n",
    		            variable, vif, r_squared))
    	})
    
  
  ## Define final predictor sets (append WorldCover back in)
  
  	MOSQUITO_VARS_FINAL <- c(mosquito_vif_result$retained, CATEGORICAL_VAR)
  	TICK_VARS_FINAL     <- c(tick_vif_result$retained, CATEGORICAL_VAR)
  
  	cat("\n\n===================================================================\n")
  	cat("  FINAL PREDICTOR SETS\n")
  	cat("===================================================================\n\n")
  
  	cat("  Mosquitoes (", length(MOSQUITO_VARS_FINAL), "vars ):\n")
  	cat("   ", paste(MOSQUITO_VARS_FINAL, collapse = ", "), "\n\n")
  
  	cat("  Ticks (", length(TICK_VARS_FINAL), "vars ):\n")
  	cat("   ", paste(TICK_VARS_FINAL, collapse = ", "), "\n\n")
  
  	## Report what was removed from each taxon
  	if (mosquito_vif_result$n_removed > 0) {
  		cat("  Removed from mosquitoes:",
  		    paste(mosquito_vif_result$removed$removed, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  	}
  	if (tick_vif_result$n_removed > 0) {
  		cat("  Removed from ticks:     ",
  		    paste(tick_vif_result$removed$removed, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  	}
  
  
  ## Species-level VIF verification
  
  	## Get species actually in the modeling pipeline
    	modeled_species <- unique(combined_pa_presence_with_covariates$species)
    
    	species_vif_check <- purrr::map_dfr(modeled_species, function(sp) {
  
  		## Determine taxon and select appropriate reduced predictor set
    		if (sp %in% ALL_MOSQUITO_SPECIES) {
    			cont_vars <- setdiff(MOSQUITO_VARS_FINAL, CATEGORICAL_VAR)
    			taxon <- "mosquito"
    		} else if (sp %in% ALL_TICK_SPECIES) {
    			cont_vars <- setdiff(TICK_VARS_FINAL, CATEGORICAL_VAR)
    			taxon <- "tick"
    		} else {
    			return(tibble::tibble())
    		}
    
  		## Extract this species' covariate values (presence + PA)
    		sp_cov <- combined_pa_presence_with_covariates |>
    			dplyr::filter(species == sp) |>
    			dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(cont_vars)) |>
    			tidyr::drop_na()
  
  		## Need at least n > p for VIF to be computable
    		if (nrow(sp_cov) <= length(cont_vars)) {
    			return(tibble::tibble(
    				species = sp, taxon = taxon,
    				max_vif = NA_real_, flagged = NA
    			))
    		}
  
    		sp_vif <- compute_vif(sp_cov)
    
    		tibble::tibble(
    			species  = sp,
    			taxon    = taxon,
    			max_vif  = max(sp_vif$vif),
    			flagged  = max(sp_vif$vif) >= 10
    		)
    	})
  
    	species_vif_check |>
```

```{r ESMs Full Pipeline}
  # Helper: compute maxSSS threshold
  
    compute_maxsss <- function(preds, obs) {
    	pres_p <- preds[obs == 1]
    	abs_p  <- preds[obs == 0]
    	cands  <- sort(unique(preds[!is.na(preds)]))
    	if (length(cands) > 500) {
    		cands <- quantile(cands, seq(0, 1, length.out = 500), na.rm = TRUE)
    	}
    	ss <- map_dbl(cands, function(t) {
    		sum(pres_p >= t) / length(pres_p) + sum(abs_p < t) / length(abs_p)
    	})
    	cands[which.max(ss)]
    }
  
  
  # Run ESM for one species
  
    run_esm <- function(sp_name, data, baseline_raster) {
    
    	covariates <- get_covariates(sp_name)
    	sp_slug    <- gsub(" ", "_", sp_name)
    
    	# Prepare data
      	sp_data <- data |>
      		filter(species == sp_name) |>
      		drop_na(all_of(covariates))
    
    	resp <- sp_data$presence
    	xy   <- sp_data |> dplyr::select(longitude, latitude) |> as.data.frame()
    	expl <- sp_data |> dplyr::select(all_of(covariates)) |> as.data.frame()
    
    	n_pres <- sum(resp == 1)
    	n_pa   <- sum(resp == 0)
    	n_biva <- choose(ncol(expl), 2)
    
    	# Format for biomod2
    	biomod_data <- BIOMOD_FormatingData(
    		resp.var  = resp,
    		expl.var  = expl,
    		resp.xy   = xy,
    		resp.name = sp_slug
    	)
  
  	# MAXNET options: LQH + beta = 2.5
  	maxnet_opts <- tryCatch({
  		bm_ModelingOptions(
  			data.type = "binary",
  			models    = "MAXNET",
  			strategy  = "user.defined",
  			user.val  = list(
  				MAXNET.binary.maxnet.maxnet = list(
  					"_allData_allRun" = list(regmult = 2.5, classes = "lqh")
  				)
  			),
  			user.base = "bigboss",
  			bm.format = biomod_data
  		)
  	}, error = function(e) {
  		bm_ModelingOptions(
  			data.type = "binary",
  			models    = "MAXNET",
  			strategy  = "bigboss",
  			bm.format = biomod_data
  		)
  	})
  
  	# Fit bivariate ESMs
  	esm_model <- ecospat.ESM.Modeling(
  		data            = biomod_data,
  		models          = c("MAXNET"),
  		models.options  = maxnet_opts,
  		NbRunEval       = 3,
  		DataSplit       = 70,
  		Prevalence      = 0.5,
  		weighting.score = c("SomersD"),
  		parallel        = FALSE,
  		modeling.id     = sp_slug,
  		cleanup         = FALSE
  	)
  
  	n_failed <- length(esm_model$failed)
  
  	# Ensemble weighted by Somers' D
  	esm_ensemble <- ecospat.ESM.EnsembleModeling(
  		ESM.modeling.output = esm_model,
  		weighting.score     = c("SomersD"),
  		threshold           = 0
  	)
  
  	# Evaluation metrics (mean across runs)
  	evals    <- esm_ensemble$ESM.evaluations
  	mean_auc <- mean(evals$AUC, na.rm = TRUE)
  	mean_tss <- mean(evals$TSS, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  	# Thresholds from ensemble fitted values (on 0-1000 scale, convert to 0-1)
  	fit_df    <- esm_ensemble$ESM.fit
  	ens_col   <- grep("Full_", names(fit_df), value = TRUE)[1]
  	ens_preds <- fit_df[[ens_col]]
  	pres_preds <- ens_preds[resp == 1]
  
  	mtp    <- min(pres_preds, na.rm = TRUE) / 1000
  	maxsss <- compute_maxsss(ens_preds, resp) / 1000
  
  	# Project to baseline raster and rescale to 0-1
  	baseline_proj <- NULL
  	proj_status   <- "skipped"
  
  	if (!is.null(baseline_raster)) {
  		baseline_proj <- tryCatch({
  			biv_proj <- ecospat.ESM.Projection(
  				ESM.modeling.output = esm_model,
  				new.env             = baseline_raster,
  				name.env            = "Baseline",
  				parallel            = FALSE
  			)
  			ens_proj <- ecospat.ESM.EnsembleProjection(
  				ESM.prediction.output       = biv_proj,
  				ESM.EnsembleModeling.output = esm_ensemble
  			)
  			# Rescale from 0-1000 to 0-1
  			ens_proj / 1000
  		}, error = function(e) {
  			warning(sp_name, " projection failed: ", e$message)
  			NULL
  		})
  		proj_status <- if (!is.null(baseline_proj)) "success" else "failed"
  	}
  
  	# Return everything
  	list(
  		species         = sp_name,
  		esm_model       = esm_model,
  		esm_ensemble    = esm_ensemble,
  		baseline_raster = baseline_proj,
  		n_pres          = n_pres,
  		n_pa            = n_pa,
  		n_biva          = n_biva,
  		n_failed        = n_failed,
  		mean_auc        = mean_auc,
  		mean_tss        = mean_tss,
  		mtp             = mtp,
  		maxsss          = maxsss,
  		proj_status     = proj_status,
  		covariates      = covariates
  	)
  }
  
  
  # ── Run all ESM species ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  
  cat("Starting ESM pipeline for", length(ESM_SPECIES), "species...\n\n")
  
  esm_results <- map(set_names(ESM_SPECIES), function(sp) {
  	cat("  Fitting:", sp, "...")
  	t0  <- Sys.time()
  	res <- tryCatch(
  		run_esm(sp, combined_pa_presence_with_covariates, baseline_raster),
  		error = function(e) {
  			cat(" FAILED:", e$message, "\n")
  			list(
  				species = sp, esm_model = NULL, esm_ensemble = NULL,
  				baseline_raster = NULL, n_pres = NA, n_pa = NA,
  				n_biva = NA, n_failed = NA, mean_auc = NA, mean_tss = NA,
  				mtp = NA, maxsss = NA, proj_status = "error", covariates = NA
  			)
  		}
  	)
  	elapsed <- round(difftime(Sys.time(), t0, units = "mins"), 1)
  	cat(" done (", elapsed, "min)\n")
  	res
  })
  
  
  # ── Summary table ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  
  esm_summary <- esm_results |>
  	map_dfr(function(r) {
  		tibble(
  			species        = r$species,
  			n_pres         = r$n_pres,
  			n_pa           = r$n_pa,
  			n_biva_combos  = r$n_biva,
  			n_failed       = r$n_failed,
  			mean_auc       = round(r$mean_auc, 3),
  			mean_tss       = round(r$mean_tss, 3),
  			thresh_mtp     = round(r$mtp, 4),
  			thresh_maxsss  = round(r$maxsss, 4),
  			projection     = r$proj_status
  		)
  	})
  
  cat("\n")
  print(esm_summary, n = 20, width = Inf)
  
  
  # ── Save outputs ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  
  # Save each species' model objects individually for future climate projections
    walk(esm_results, function(r) {
  	if (is.null(r$esm_model)) return(invisible())
  
  	sp_slug <- gsub(" ", "_", r$species)
  	sp_dir  <- file.path(SAVE_DIR, sp_slug)
  	dir.create(sp_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
  
  	# Model and ensemble objects (needed for future projections)
  	saveRDS(
  		list(
  			esm_model    = r$esm_model,
  			esm_ensemble = r$esm_ensemble,
  			covariates   = r$covariates,
  			thresholds   = list(mtp = r$mtp, maxsss = r$maxsss)
  		),
  		file.path(sp_dir, "esm_model_objects.rds")
  	)
  
  	# Baseline prediction raster (0-1 scale)
  	if (!is.null(r$baseline_raster)) {
  		writeRaster(
  			r$baseline_raster,
  			file.path(sp_dir, "baseline_suitability.tif"),
  			overwrite = TRUE
  		)
  	}
  })
  
  # Save summary table
    write_csv(esm_summary, file.path(SAVE_DIR, "esm_summary.csv"))
  
  # Save the full results list (for reloading into R later)
    saveRDS(esm_results, file.path(SAVE_DIR, "esm_all_results.rds"))
  
```

```{r BRT Conservative Pipeline}

  # Set the seed for reproducibility
    set.seed(1999)

	## Input directory: per-iteration .rds files with combined presence + PA data
	  INPUT_DIR <- "input directory including .rds files" # replace

	## Output directory for tuned BRT results
	  OUTPUT_DIR <- "output directory for the brt model results; subdirectories created below"

	## Create output subdirectories
  	dir.create(file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "models"),              showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
  	dir.create(file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "statistics"),           showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
  	dir.create(file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "partial_dependence"),   showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

	## Conservative BRT parameters for the 50–100 occurrence tier
	## tc=1: additive only, no interaction terms (Elith et al. 2008)
	## bag.fraction=0.5: more stochasticity per tree for regularization
	## n.folds=5: stable fold sizes (~13 presences per test fold)
	## step.size=25: finer evaluation of optimal tree number
  	BRT_PARAMS <- list(
  		tree.complexity = 1,
  		learning.rate   = 0.001,
  		bag.fraction    = 0.5,
  		n.folds         = 5,
  		family          = "bernoulli",
  		step.size       = 25,
  		max.trees       = 50000
  	)

	## The four "Tuned BRT" species (50–100 occurrences)
    TUNED_SPECIES <- c(
    	"Aedes albopictus", 
    	"Dermacentor reticulatus", 
    	"Haemaphysalis inermis",
    	"Hyalomma marginatum"
    )

	## Species-to-taxon mapping (determines covariate set)
  	MOSQUITO_SPECIES <- c("Aedes albopictus")
  	TICK_SPECIES     <- c("Dermacentor reticulatus",
                      "Haemaphysalis inermis", "Hyalomma marginatum")

	## Categorical covariate
	  CATEGORICAL_VAR <- "WorldCover"

  ## Variables
  	MOSQUITO_VARS <- MOSQUITO_VARS_FINAL
  	TICK_VARS     <- TICK_VARS_FINAL


	#' Retrieve appropriate covariate names for a given species
  	get_predictor_vars <- function(species_name) {
  		if (species_name %in% MOSQUITO_SPECIES) return(MOSQUITO_VARS)
  		if (species_name %in% TICK_SPECIES)     return(TICK_VARS)
  		stop("Species '", species_name, "' not found in taxon lists.")
  	}


	#' Determine vector type label for a species
  	get_vector_type <- function(species_name) {
  		if (species_name %in% MOSQUITO_SPECIES) return("mosquito")
  		if (species_name %in% TICK_SPECIES)     return("tick")
  		stop("Species '", species_name, "' not found in taxon lists.")
  	}


	#' Prepare a data frame for BRT modeling
	#' Selects response + predictors, drops NAs, converts WorldCover to factor
  	prepare_brt_data <- function(df, predictor_vars) {
  
  		model_df <- df |>
  			dplyr::select(presence, all_of(predictor_vars)) |>
  			drop_na()
  
  		## Ensure WorldCover is treated as categorical
  		if (CATEGORICAL_VAR %in% names(model_df)) {
  			model_df <- model_df |>
  				mutate(!!CATEGORICAL_VAR := as.factor(.data[[CATEGORICAL_VAR]]))
  		}
  
  		return(model_df)
  	}


	#' Fit a single BRT model via dismo::gbm.step()
	#' Returns NULL on failure rather than stopping the pipeline
  	fit_single_brt <- function(model_data, predictor_vars, params) {
  
  		## Column indices required by gbm.step
  		  response_col  <- which(names(model_data) == "presence")
  		  predictor_cols <- which(names(model_data) %in% predictor_vars)
  
  		## Fit with suppressed convergence warnings (expected for binary data)
    		model <- tryCatch({
    			suppressWarnings({
    				gbm.step(
    					data            = as.data.frame(model_data),
    					gbm.x           = predictor_cols,
    					gbm.y           = response_col,
    					family           = params$family,
    					tree.complexity  = params$tree.complexity,
    					learning.rate    = params$learning.rate,
    					bag.fraction     = params$bag.fraction,
    					n.folds          = params$n.folds,
    					step.size        = params$step.size,
    					max.trees        = params$max.trees,
    					plot.main        = FALSE,
    					plot.folds       = FALSE,
    					silent           = TRUE
    				)
    			})
    		}, error = function(e) {
    			warning("BRT fitting failed: ", e$message)
    			return(NULL)
    		})
    
    		return(model)
    	}


	#' Extract performance statistics from a fitted gbm.step model
  	extract_model_stats <- function(model) {
  
  		if (is.null(model)) {
  			return(tibble(
  				n_trees            = NA_integer_,
  				cv_deviance_mean   = NA_real_,
  				cv_deviance_se     = NA_real_,
  				training_auc       = NA_real_,
  				cv_auc             = NA_real_,
  				cv_correlation     = NA_real_,
  				deviance_explained = NA_real_
  			))
  		}

		## Optimal number of trees from CV
		  n_trees <- model$gbm.call$best.trees

		## CV deviance at optimal tree number
		  cv_deviance_mean <- model$cv.statistics$deviance.mean
		  cv_deviance_se   <- model$cv.statistics$deviance.se

		## AUC: training and cross-validated
		  training_auc <- model$self.statistics$discrimination
		  cv_auc       <- model$cv.statistics$discrimination.mean

		## CV correlation (Pearson between observed and predicted in held-out folds)
		  cv_correlation <- model$cv.statistics$correlation.mean

		## Deviance explained: (null - residual) / null × 100
		  deviance_explained <- (1 - (model$cv.statistics$deviance.mean /
		                            model$self.statistics$mean.null)) * 100

  		tibble(
  			n_trees            = n_trees,
  			cv_deviance_mean   = cv_deviance_mean,
  			cv_deviance_se     = cv_deviance_se,
  			training_auc       = training_auc,
  			cv_auc             = cv_auc,
  			cv_correlation     = cv_correlation,
  			deviance_explained = deviance_explained
  		)
  	}


	#' Extract variable importance from a fitted gbm.step model
  	extract_var_importance <- function(model) {
  
  		if (is.null(model)) return(NULL)
  
  		## gbm.step stores relative influence in the summary
  		importance <- summary(model, plotit = FALSE) |>
  			as_tibble() |>
  			rename(variable = var, rel_influence = rel.inf)
  
  		return(importance)
  	}


	#' Extract partial dependence data for all predictors from a gbm.step model
	#' Returns a tibble with variable, x-value, and predicted y-value columns
  	extract_partial_dependence <- function(model, predictor_vars) {
  
  		if (is.null(model)) return(NULL)
  
  		## Iterate across all predictors and extract PDP values
    		pdp_data <- purrr::map_dfr(
    			seq_along(predictor_vars),
    			function(var_idx) {
  
  				## gbm::plot.gbm returns the PDP data invisibly
    				pdp <- tryCatch({
    					plot.gbm(model, i.var = var_idx, return.grid = TRUE)
    				}, error = function(e) {
    					return(NULL)
    				})
    
    				if (is.null(pdp)) return(NULL)
    
    				tibble(
    					variable = predictor_vars[var_idx],
    					x        = as.numeric(pdp[[1]]),
    					y        = pdp$y
    				)
    			}
    		)
  
  		return(pdp_data)
  	}


  # LOAD AND DISAGGREGATE ITERATION DATA BY SPECIES

  	## List all iteration files
    	iteration_files <- list.files(
    		INPUT_DIR,
    		pattern    = "^brt_data_iteration_\\d{3}\\.rds$",
    		full.names = TRUE
    	) |>
    		sort()

  	## Verify we have all 100
    	if (length(iteration_files) != 100) {
    		warning("Expected 100 iteration files, found ", length(iteration_files))
    	}

	  sample_data <- readRDS(iteration_files[1])

  	## Confirm our four target species are present
    	available_species <- unique(sample_data$species)
    	missing_species   <- setdiff(TUNED_SPECIES, available_species)

    	if (length(missing_species) > 0) {
    		stop("Missing species in iteration data: ", paste(missing_species, collapse = ", "))
    	}
    	
	purrr::walk(TUNED_SPECIES, ~ cat("  •", .x, "\n"))

  	## Clean up sample data
    	rm(sample_data)
    	gc()


  # RUN THE MODELS! Code structured w/ assistance from claude.ai;
    	# verified and double-checked prior to and following the
    	# completed run.
    	
  	purrr::walk(
  		TUNED_SPECIES,
  		function(sp) {
  
  			cat("\n───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
  			cat("SPECIES:", sp, "\n")
  			cat("───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
  
  			## Determine covariate set based on taxon
  			predictor_vars <- get_predictor_vars(sp)
  			vector_type    <- get_vector_type(sp)
  
  			cat("  Vector type:", vector_type, "\n")
  			cat("  Predictors: ", length(predictor_vars), "\n")
  
  			## Containers to accumulate results across iterations
  			all_models     <- vector("list", length(iteration_files))
  			all_stats      <- vector("list", length(iteration_files))
  			all_varimp     <- vector("list", length(iteration_files))
  			all_pdp        <- vector("list", length(iteration_files))
  
  			## Track iteration-level progress
  			n_failed <- 0L
  
  			purrr::walk(
  				seq_along(iteration_files),
  				function(i) {
  
  					if (i %% 10 == 1 || i == length(iteration_files)) {
  						cat(sprintf("  Iteration %3d / %d ...\n", i, length(iteration_files)))
  					}
  
  					## Load this iteration and filter to target species
  					iter_data <- readRDS(iteration_files[i]) |>
  						dplyr::filter(species == sp)
  
  					## Prepare for modeling
  					model_data <- prepare_brt_data(iter_data, predictor_vars)
  
  					## Report sample size on first iteration
  					if (i == 1) {
  						n_pres <- sum(model_data$presence == 1)
  						n_abs  <- sum(model_data$presence == 0)
  						cat(sprintf("  Sample size: %d presences, %d pseudo-absences\n", n_pres, n_abs))
  					}
  
  					## Fit BRT
  					model <- fit_single_brt(model_data, predictor_vars, BRT_PARAMS)
  
  					## Track failures
  					if (is.null(model)) {
  						n_failed <<- n_failed + 1L
  					}
  
  					## Store model object
  					all_models[[i]] <<- model
  
  					## Extract statistics
  					all_stats[[i]] <<- extract_model_stats(model) |>
  						mutate(iteration = i)
  
  					## Extract variable importance
  					varimp <- extract_var_importance(model)
  					if (!is.null(varimp)) {
  						all_varimp[[i]] <<- varimp |>
  							mutate(iteration = i)
  					}
  
  					## Extract partial dependence
  					pdp <- extract_partial_dependence(model, predictor_vars)
  					if (!is.null(pdp)) {
  						all_pdp[[i]] <<- pdp |>
  							mutate(iteration = i)
  					}
  
  					## Free memory from loaded iteration data
  					rm(iter_data, model_data, model)
  
  				}
  			) ## End iteration loop
  
  			## Report completion for this species
  			cat(sprintf("\n  Completed: %d models fit, %d failures\n",
  			            length(iteration_files) - n_failed, n_failed))
  
  
  			# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  			# COMPILE AND SAVE STATISTICS
  			# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  
  			## Performance statistics across all iterations
  			species_stats <- bind_rows(all_stats) |>
  				mutate(
  					species     = sp,
  					vector_type = vector_type,
  					.before     = everything()
  				)
  
  			## Summary statistics (means + SDs across iterations)
  			species_summary <- species_stats |>
  				dplyr::filter(!is.na(n_trees)) |>
  				summarise(
  					species            = first(species),
  					vector_type        = first(vector_type),
  					n_models           = n(),
  					n_failed           = n_failed,
  					n_trees_mean       = mean(n_trees),
  					n_trees_sd         = sd(n_trees),
  					n_trees_min        = min(n_trees),
  					n_trees_max        = max(n_trees),
  					cv_deviance_mean   = mean(cv_deviance_mean),
  					cv_deviance_sd     = sd(cv_deviance_mean),
  					training_auc_mean  = mean(training_auc),
  					training_auc_sd    = sd(training_auc),
  					cv_auc_mean        = mean(cv_auc),
  					cv_auc_sd          = sd(cv_auc),
  					cv_correlation_mean = mean(cv_correlation),
  					cv_correlation_sd  = sd(cv_correlation),
  					deviance_explained_mean = mean(deviance_explained),
  					deviance_explained_sd   = sd(deviance_explained),
  					.groups = "drop"
  				)
  
  			cat("\n  Summary statistics:\n")
  			cat(sprintf("    CV AUC:             %.4f ± %.4f\n",
  			            species_summary$cv_auc_mean, species_summary$cv_auc_sd))
  			cat(sprintf("    Training AUC:       %.4f ± %.4f\n",
  			            species_summary$training_auc_mean, species_summary$training_auc_sd))
  			cat(sprintf("    Deviance explained: %.2f%% ± %.2f%%\n",
  			            species_summary$deviance_explained_mean, species_summary$deviance_explained_sd))
  			cat(sprintf("    Optimal trees:      %.0f ± %.0f (range: %d – %d)\n",
  			            species_summary$n_trees_mean, species_summary$n_trees_sd,
  			            species_summary$n_trees_min, species_summary$n_trees_max))
  
  
  			# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  			# COMPILE VARIABLE IMPORTANCE
  			# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  
  			## Aggregate importance across iterations (mean ± SD)
  			species_varimp_raw <- bind_rows(compact(all_varimp))
  
  			species_varimp_summary <- species_varimp_raw |>
  				group_by(variable) |>
  				summarise(
  					mean_influence = mean(rel_influence),
  					sd_influence   = sd(rel_influence),
  					min_influence  = min(rel_influence),
  					max_influence  = max(rel_influence),
  					.groups        = "drop"
  				) |>
  				arrange(desc(mean_influence)) |>
  				mutate(
  					species     = sp,
  					vector_type = vector_type,
  					.before     = everything()
  				)
  
  			cat("\n  Top 5 variables:\n")
  			species_varimp_summary |>
  				slice_head(n = 5) |>
  				mutate(label = sprintf("    %s: %.2f%% ± %.2f%%", variable,
  				                       mean_influence, sd_influence)) |>
  				pull(label) |>
  				walk(cat, "\n")
  
  
  			# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  			# COMPILE AVERAGED PARTIAL DEPENDENCE PLOTS
  			# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  
  			## Average PDP curves across all iterations
  			## For each variable, bin x-values and compute mean ± SD of y
  			species_pdp_raw <- bind_rows(compact(all_pdp))
  
  			species_pdp_averaged <- species_pdp_raw |>
  				group_by(variable) |>
  				mutate(
  					## Create consistent x-bins within each variable's range
  					x_bin = cut(x, breaks = 50, labels = FALSE)
  				) |>
  				group_by(variable, x_bin) |>
  				summarise(
  					x_mean = mean(x),
  					y_mean = mean(y),
  					y_sd   = sd(y),
  					y_lower = y_mean - y_sd,
  					y_upper = y_mean + y_sd,
  					.groups = "drop"
  				) |>
  				mutate(
  					species     = sp,
  					vector_type = vector_type,
  					.before     = everything()
  				)
  
  
  			# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  			# SAVE ALL OUTPUTS
  			# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  
  			## Clean species name for filenames
  			sp_clean <- str_replace_all(sp, " ", "_")
  
  			## Save model objects (list of 100 gbm.step objects)
  			saveRDS(
  				all_models,
  				file = file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "models",
  				                 paste0(sp_clean, "_tuned_brt_models.rds"))
  			)
  
  			## Save per-iteration statistics
  			saveRDS(
  				species_stats,
  				file = file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "statistics",
  				                 paste0(sp_clean, "_iteration_stats.rds"))
  			)
  
  			## Save summary statistics
  			saveRDS(
  				species_summary,
  				file = file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "statistics",
  				                 paste0(sp_clean, "_summary_stats.rds"))
  			)
  
  			## Save variable importance (raw + summary)
  			saveRDS(
  				list(raw = species_varimp_raw, summary = species_varimp_summary),
  				file = file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "statistics",
  				                 paste0(sp_clean, "_variable_importance.rds"))
  			)
  
  			## Save averaged PDP data
  			saveRDS(
  				species_pdp_averaged,
  				file = file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "partial_dependence",
  				                 paste0(sp_clean, "_averaged_pdp.rds"))
  			)
  
  			cat("\n  Outputs saved to:", file.path(OUTPUT_DIR), "\n")
  
  			## Free memory before next species
  			rm(all_models, all_stats, all_varimp, all_pdp,
  			   species_stats, species_summary, species_varimp_raw,
  			   species_varimp_summary, species_pdp_raw, species_pdp_averaged)
  			gc()
  
  		}
  	) ## End species loop


  	## Load all individual species summaries and bind into a single table
    	summary_files <- list.files(
    		file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "statistics"),
    		pattern    = "_summary_stats\\.rds$",
    		full.names = TRUE
    	)
  
    	cross_species_summary <- purrr::map_dfr(summary_files, readRDS) |>
    		arrange(desc(cv_auc_mean))
  
  	## Print formatted table
    	cross_species_summary |>
    		mutate(
    			label = sprintf(
    				"  %-25s  CV AUC: %.4f ± %.4f  |  DevExpl: %5.1f%% ± %4.1f%%  |  Trees: %5.0f ± %5.0f  |  Failed: %d",
    				species, cv_auc_mean, cv_auc_sd,
    				deviance_explained_mean, deviance_explained_sd,
    				n_trees_mean, n_trees_sd, n_failed
    			)
    		) |>
    		pull(label) |>
    		walk(cat, "\n")
  
  	## Save the combined summary
    	saveRDS(
    		cross_species_summary,
    		file = file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "statistics", "tuned_brt_cross_species_summary.rds")
    	)
    	write_csv(
    		cross_species_summary,
    		file = file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "statistics", "tuned_brt_cross_species_summary.csv")
    	)
```
