  set.seed(1999)

  # CONFIGURATION
  
  	## Input directory: per-iteration .rds files with combined presence + PA data
  	  INPUT_DIR <- "input directory including .rds files" # replace
  
  	## Output directory for standard BRT results
  	  OUTPUT_DIR <- "output directory for model results" # replace
  
  	## Create output subdirectories
    	dir.create(file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "models"),              showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
    	dir.create(file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "statistics"),           showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
    	dir.create(file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "partial_dependence"),   showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
  
  	## Standard BRT parameters for the >100 occurrence tier
  	## tc=2: pairwise interactions (ecologically meaningful, estimable at n>100)
  	## bag.fraction=0.75: standard per Elith et al. (2008)
  	## n.folds=10: stable fold sizes with 118+ presences
  	## step.size=50: standard evaluation interval
    	BRT_PARAMS <- list(
    		tree.complexity = 2,
    		learning.rate   = 0.001,
    		bag.fraction    = 0.75,
    		n.folds         = 10,
    		family          = "bernoulli",
    		step.size       = 50,
    		max.trees       = 50000
    	)
  
  	## The "Standard BRT" species (>100 occurrences)
      STANDARD_SPECIES <- c(
      	"Culex pipiens",
      	"Ixodes ricinus",
      	"Dermacentor marginatus"
      )
  
  	## Species-to-taxon mapping (determines covariate set)
      MOSQUITO_SPECIES <- c("Culex pipiens")
      TICK_SPECIES     <- c("Ixodes ricinus", "Dermacentor marginatus")
  
   ## Categorical covariate
     CATEGORICAL_VAR <- "WorldCover"
     
   ## Variables (Using the VIF-assessed final lists)
     MOSQUITO_VARS <- MOSQUITO_VARS_FINAL
     TICK_VARS     <- TICK_VARS_FINAL
  
  
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # HELPER FUNCTIONS
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  
  	#' Retrieve appropriate covariate names for a given species
    	get_predictor_vars <- function(species_name) {
    		if (species_name %in% MOSQUITO_SPECIES) return(MOSQUITO_VARS)
    		if (species_name %in% TICK_SPECIES)     return(TICK_VARS)
    		stop("Species '", species_name, "' not found in taxon lists.")
    	}
  
  
  	#' Determine vector type label for a species
    	get_vector_type <- function(species_name) {
    		if (species_name %in% MOSQUITO_SPECIES) return("mosquito")
    		if (species_name %in% TICK_SPECIES)     return("tick")
    		stop("Species '", species_name, "' not found in taxon lists.")
    	}
  
  
  	#' Prepare a data frame for BRT modeling
  	#' Selects response + predictors, drops NAs, converts WorldCover to factor
    	prepare_brt_data <- function(df, predictor_vars) {
    
    		model_df <- df |>
    			dplyr::select(presence, all_of(predictor_vars)) |>
    			drop_na()
    
    		## Ensure WorldCover is treated as categorical
    		if (CATEGORICAL_VAR %in% names(model_df)) {
    			model_df <- model_df |>
    				mutate(!!CATEGORICAL_VAR := as.factor(.data[[CATEGORICAL_VAR]]))
    		}
    
    		return(model_df)
    	}
  
  
  	#' Fit a single BRT model via dismo::gbm.step()
  	#' Returns NULL on failure rather than stopping the pipeline
  	  fit_single_brt <- function(model_data, predictor_vars, params) {
  
  		## Column indices required by gbm.step
  		  response_col   <- which(names(model_data) == "presence")
  		  predictor_cols <- which(names(model_data) %in% predictor_vars)
  
  		## Fit with suppressed convergence warnings (expected for binary data)
    		model <- tryCatch({
    			suppressWarnings({
    				gbm.step(
    					data            = as.data.frame(model_data),
    					gbm.x           = predictor_cols,
    					gbm.y           = response_col,
    					family           = params$family,
    					tree.complexity  = params$tree.complexity,
    					learning.rate    = params$learning.rate,
    					bag.fraction     = params$bag.fraction,
    					n.folds          = params$n.folds,
    					step.size        = params$step.size,
    					max.trees        = params$max.trees,
    					plot.main        = FALSE,
    					plot.folds       = FALSE,
    					silent           = TRUE
    				)
    			})
    		}, error = function(e) {
    			warning("BRT fitting failed: ", e$message)
    			return(NULL)
    		})
    
    		return(model)
    	}
  
  
  	#' Extract performance statistics from a fitted gbm.step model
    	extract_model_stats <- function(model) {
    
    		if (is.null(model)) {
    			return(tibble(
    				n_trees            = NA_integer_,
    				cv_deviance_mean   = NA_real_,
    				cv_deviance_se     = NA_real_,
    				training_auc       = NA_real_,
    				cv_auc             = NA_real_,
    				cv_correlation     = NA_real_,
    				deviance_explained = NA_real_
    			))
    		}
  
  		## Optimal number of trees from CV
  		  n_trees <- model$gbm.call$best.trees
  
  		## CV deviance at optimal tree number
  		  cv_deviance_mean <- model$cv.statistics$deviance.mean
  		  cv_deviance_se   <- model$cv.statistics$deviance.se
  
  		## AUC: training and cross-validated
  		  training_auc <- model$self.statistics$discrimination
  		  cv_auc       <- model$cv.statistics$discrimination.mean
  
  		## CV correlation (Pearson between observed and predicted in held-out folds)
  		  cv_correlation <- model$cv.statistics$correlation.mean
  
  		## Deviance explained: (null - residual) / null × 100
  		  deviance_explained <- (1 - (model$cv.statistics$deviance.mean /
  		                            model$self.statistics$mean.null)) * 100
  
    		tibble(
    			n_trees            = n_trees,
    			cv_deviance_mean   = cv_deviance_mean,
    			cv_deviance_se     = cv_deviance_se,
    			training_auc       = training_auc,
    			cv_auc             = cv_auc,
    			cv_correlation     = cv_correlation,
    			deviance_explained = deviance_explained
    		)
    	}
  
  
  	#' Extract variable importance from a fitted gbm.step model
  	  extract_var_importance <- function(model) {
  
  		  if (is.null(model)) return(NULL)
  
  		## gbm.step stores relative influence in the summary
    		importance <- summary(model, plotit = FALSE) |>
    			as_tibble() |>
    			rename(variable = var, rel_influence = rel.inf)
    
    		return(importance)
    	}
  
  
  	#' Extract partial dependence data for all predictors from a gbm.step model
  	#' Returns a tibble with variable, x-value, and predicted y-value columns
  	  extract_partial_dependence <- function(model, predictor_vars) {
  
  		  if (is.null(model)) return(NULL)
  
  		## Iterate across all predictors and extract PDP values
    		pdp_data <- purrr::map_dfr(
    			seq_along(predictor_vars),
    			function(var_idx) {
    
    				## gbm::plot.gbm returns the PDP data invisibly
      				pdp <- tryCatch({
      					plot.gbm(model, i.var = var_idx, return.grid = TRUE)
      				}, error = function(e) {
      					return(NULL)
      				})
    
    				if (is.null(pdp)) return(NULL)
    
    				tibble(
    					variable = predictor_vars[var_idx],
    					x        = as.numeric(pdp[[1]]),
    					y        = pdp$y
    				)
    			}
    		)
    
    		return(pdp_data)
    	}
  
  # LOAD AND VALIDATE ITERATION DATA
  	## List all iteration files
    	iteration_files <- list.files(
    		INPUT_DIR,
    		pattern    = "^brt_data_iteration_\\d{3}\\.rds$",
    		full.names = TRUE
    	) |>
    		sort()

    	if (length(iteration_files) != 100) {
    		warning("Expected 100 iteration files, found ", length(iteration_files))
    	}
  
  	## Inspect structure from first iteration
  	sample_data <- readRDS(iteration_files[1])
  	available_species <- unique(sample_data$species)
  	missing_species   <- setdiff(STANDARD_SPECIES, available_species)
  
  	if (length(missing_species) > 0) {
  		stop("Missing species in iteration data: ", paste(missing_species, collapse = ", "))
  	}
  
  	## Report per-species sample sizes from first iteration
    	sample_data |>
    		dplyr::filter(species %in% STANDARD_SPECIES) |>
    		group_by(species) |>
    		summarise(
    			n_presence = sum(presence == 1),
    			n_absence  = sum(presence == 0),
    			n_total    = n(),
    			.groups    = "drop"
    		) |>
    		arrange(desc(n_presence)) |>
    		mutate(label = sprintf("  %-25s %4d pres / %4d abs", species, n_presence, n_absence)) |>
    		pull(label) |>
    		walk(cat, "\n")
  
  	## Print parameter configuration
    	rm(sample_data)
    	gc()
  
  # RuN SOME MORE MODELS!
  	purrr::walk(
  		STANDARD_SPECIES,
  		function(sp) {
  
  			cat("\n───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
  			cat("SPECIES:", sp, "\n")
  			cat("───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
  
  			## Determine covariate set based on taxon
  			  predictor_vars <- get_predictor_vars(sp)
  			  vector_type    <- get_vector_type(sp)
  
  			cat("  Vector type:", vector_type, "\n")
  			cat("  Predictors: ", length(predictor_vars), "\n")
  
  			## Pre-allocate result containers
    			all_models <- vector("list", length(iteration_files))
    			all_stats  <- vector("list", length(iteration_files))
    			all_varimp <- vector("list", length(iteration_files))
    			all_pdp    <- vector("list", length(iteration_files))
    
  			n_failed <- 0L
  
  			## Track timing for progress estimates
  			  t_start <- Sys.time()
  
    			purrr::walk(
    				seq_along(iteration_files),
    				function(i) {
    
    					## Progress reporting every 10 iterations + timing estimate
    					if (i %% 10 == 1 || i == length(iteration_files)) {
    						elapsed <- as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t_start, units = "mins"))
    						if (i > 1) {
    							rate <- elapsed / (i - 1)
    							remaining <- rate * (length(iteration_files) - i)
    							cat(sprintf("  Iteration %3d / %d  [%.1f min elapsed, ~%.1f min remaining]\n",
    							            i, length(iteration_files), elapsed, remaining))
    						} else {
    							cat(sprintf("  Iteration %3d / %d ...\n", i, length(iteration_files)))
    						}
    					}
  
  					## Load this iteration and filter to target species
  					  iter_data <- readRDS(iteration_files[i]) |>
  						  dplyr::filter(species == sp)
  
  					## Prepare for modeling
  					  model_data <- prepare_brt_data(iter_data, predictor_vars)
  
  					## Report sample size on first iteration
    					if (i == 1) {
    						n_pres <- sum(model_data$presence == 1)
    						n_abs  <- sum(model_data$presence == 0)
    						cat(sprintf("  Sample size: %d presences, %d pseudo-absences\n", n_pres, n_abs))
    					}
  
  					## Fit BRT
  					  model <- fit_single_brt(model_data, predictor_vars, BRT_PARAMS)
  
  					## Track failures
    					if (is.null(model)) {
    						n_failed <<- n_failed + 1L
    					}
  
  					## Store model object
  					all_models[[i]] <<- model
  
  					## Extract statistics
    					all_stats[[i]] <<- extract_model_stats(model) |>
    						mutate(iteration = i)
  
  					## Extract variable importance
    					varimp <- extract_var_importance(model)
    					if (!is.null(varimp)) {
    						all_varimp[[i]] <<- varimp |>
    							mutate(iteration = i)
    					}
  
  					## Extract partial dependence
    					pdp <- extract_partial_dependence(model, predictor_vars)
    					if (!is.null(pdp)) {
    						all_pdp[[i]] <<- pdp |>
    							mutate(iteration = i)
    					}
  
  					## Free memory
  					rm(iter_data, model_data, model)
  				}
  			) ## End iteration loop
  
  			## Report completion
    			total_time <- as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t_start, units = "mins"))
    			cat(sprintf("\n  Completed: %d models fit, %d failures (%.1f min total)\n",
    			            length(iteration_files) - n_failed, n_failed, total_time))
  
  
  			# COMPILE AND SAVE STATISTICS

    			## Per-iteration statistics
      			species_stats <- bind_rows(all_stats) |>
      				mutate(
      					species     = sp,
      					vector_type = vector_type,
      					.before     = everything()
      				)
  
  			## Summary across iterations
    			species_summary <- species_stats |>
    				dplyr::filter(!is.na(n_trees)) |>
    				summarise(
    					species                 = first(species),
    					vector_type             = first(vector_type),
    					n_models                = n(),
    					n_failed                = n_failed,
    					n_trees_mean            = mean(n_trees),
    					n_trees_sd              = sd(n_trees),
    					n_trees_min             = min(n_trees),
    					n_trees_max             = max(n_trees),
    					cv_deviance_mean        = mean(cv_deviance_mean),
    					cv_deviance_sd          = sd(cv_deviance_mean),
    					training_auc_mean       = mean(training_auc),
    					training_auc_sd         = sd(training_auc),
    					cv_auc_mean             = mean(cv_auc),
    					cv_auc_sd               = sd(cv_auc),
    					cv_correlation_mean     = mean(cv_correlation),
    					cv_correlation_sd       = sd(cv_correlation),
    					deviance_explained_mean = mean(deviance_explained),
    					deviance_explained_sd   = sd(deviance_explained),
    					.groups                 = "drop"
    				)
  
  			## Print summary
  			cat(sprintf("    CV AUC:             %.4f ± %.4f\n",
  			            species_summary$cv_auc_mean, species_summary$cv_auc_sd))
  			cat(sprintf("    Training AUC:       %.4f ± %.4f\n",
  			            species_summary$training_auc_mean, species_summary$training_auc_sd))
  			cat(sprintf("    Deviance explained: %.2f%% ± %.2f%%\n",
  			            species_summary$deviance_explained_mean, species_summary$deviance_explained_sd))
  			cat(sprintf("    Optimal trees:      %.0f ± %.0f (range: %d – %d)\n",
  			            species_summary$n_trees_mean, species_summary$n_trees_sd,
  			            species_summary$n_trees_min, species_summary$n_trees_max))
  
  			## Overfitting diagnostic: training-CV AUC gap
    			auc_gap <- species_summary$training_auc_mean - species_summary$cv_auc_mean
  
  			# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  			# COMPILE VARIABLE IMPORTANCE
  			# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  
  			species_varimp_raw <- bind_rows(compact(all_varimp))
  
  			species_varimp_summary <- species_varimp_raw |>
  				group_by(variable) |>
  				summarise(
  					mean_influence = mean(rel_influence),
  					sd_influence   = sd(rel_influence),
  					min_influence  = min(rel_influence),
  					max_influence  = max(rel_influence),
  					.groups        = "drop"
  				) |>
  				arrange(desc(mean_influence)) |>
  				mutate(
  					species     = sp,
  					vector_type = vector_type,
  					.before     = everything()
  				)
  
  			cat("\n  Top 5 variables:\n")
  			species_varimp_summary |>
  				slice_head(n = 5) |>
  				mutate(label = sprintf("    %s: %.2f%% ± %.2f%%", variable,
  				                       mean_influence, sd_influence)) |>
  				pull(label) |>
  				walk(cat, "\n")
  
  
  			# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  			# COMPILE AVERAGED PARTIAL DEPENDENCE PLOTS
  			# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  
  			species_pdp_raw <- bind_rows(compact(all_pdp))
  
  			species_pdp_averaged <- species_pdp_raw |>
  				group_by(variable) |>
  				mutate(x_bin = cut(x, breaks = 50, labels = FALSE)) |>
  				group_by(variable, x_bin) |>
  				summarise(
  					x_mean  = mean(x),
  					y_mean  = mean(y),
  					y_sd    = sd(y),
  					y_lower = y_mean - y_sd,
  					y_upper = y_mean + y_sd,
  					.groups = "drop"
  				) |>
  				mutate(
  					species     = sp,
  					vector_type = vector_type,
  					.before     = everything()
  				)
  
  
  			# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  			# SAVE ALL OUTPUTS
  			# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  
  			sp_clean <- str_replace_all(sp, " ", "_")
  
  			## Model objects (list of 100 gbm.step objects)
    			saveRDS(
    				all_models,
    				file = file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "models",
    				                 paste0(sp_clean, "_standard_brt_models.rds"))
    			)
  
  			## Per-iteration statistics
    			saveRDS(
    				species_stats,
    				file = file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "statistics",
    				                 paste0(sp_clean, "_iteration_stats.rds"))
    			)
  
  			## Summary statistics
    			saveRDS(
    				species_summary,
    				file = file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "statistics",
    				                 paste0(sp_clean, "_summary_stats.rds"))
    			)
  
  			## Variable importance (raw + summary)
    			saveRDS(
    				list(raw = species_varimp_raw, summary = species_varimp_summary),
    				file = file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "statistics",
    				                 paste0(sp_clean, "_variable_importance.rds"))
    			)
  
  			## Averaged PDP data
    			saveRDS(
    				species_pdp_averaged,
    				file = file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "partial_dependence",
    				                 paste0(sp_clean, "_averaged_pdp.rds"))
    			)
  
  			## Free memory
    			rm(all_models, all_stats, all_varimp, all_pdp,
    			   species_stats, species_summary, species_varimp_raw,
    			   species_varimp_summary, species_pdp_raw, species_pdp_averaged)
    			gc()
    		}
  	) ## End species loop
  
  # COMPILE CROSS-SPECIES SUMMARY TABLE

  	summary_files <- list.files(
  		file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "statistics"),
  		pattern    = "_summary_stats\\.rds$",
  		full.names = TRUE
  	)
  
  	cross_species_summary <- purrr::map_dfr(summary_files, readRDS) |>
  		arrange(desc(cv_auc_mean))
  
  	## Formatted output with overfitting diagnostic
    	cross_species_summary |>
    		mutate(
    			auc_gap = training_auc_mean - cv_auc_mean,
    			flag    = if_else(auc_gap > 0.02, "⚠", "✓"),
    			label   = sprintf(
    				"  %-25s  CV AUC: %.4f ± %.4f  |  Gap: %.4f %s  |  DevExpl: %5.1f%%  |  Trees: %5.0f ± %4.0f",
    				species, cv_auc_mean, cv_auc_sd,
    				auc_gap, flag,
    				deviance_explained_mean,
    				n_trees_mean, n_trees_sd
    			)
    		) |>
    		pull(label) |>
    		walk(cat, "\n")
  
  	## Save combined summary
    	saveRDS(
    		cross_species_summary,
    		file = file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "statistics", "standard_brt_cross_species_summary.rds")
    	)
  
    	write_csv(
    		cross_species_summary,
    		file = file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "statistics", "standard_brt_cross_species_summary.csv")
    	)

  ## ── Load Georgian boundary from GitHub ───────────────────────────────
      gadm_url <- "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/IanPsheaSmith/GeorgiaVectors/main/Shapefiles/gadm/gadm41_GEO_2_pk.rds"

  ## ── (2) Diagnostic: count NAs per tick layer after masking ───────────
      baseline_na_report <- TICK_VARS_FINAL |>
          purrr::map_dfr(function(var_name) {
              r <- baseline_raster[[var_name]]
              tibble::tibble(
                  variable = var_name,
                  n_cells  = terra::ncell(r),
                  n_na     = terra::global(r, fun = function(x) sum(is.na(x))) |>
                      as.numeric()
              )
          }) |>
          dplyr::mutate(pct_na = round(100 * n_na / n_cells, 3)) |>
          dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(n_na))
  
      print(baseline_na_report, n = nrow(baseline_na_report))
  
  ## ── (3) Identify layers with excess NA ───────────────────────────────
      structural_na  <- min(baseline_na_report$n_na)
      layers_to_fill <- baseline_na_report |>
          dplyr::filter(n_na > structural_na) |>
          dplyr::pull(variable)
  
      cat("Structural NA:", structural_na, "| Layers to fill:", length(layers_to_fill), "\n")
  
  ## ── (4) Focal-mean infill function ───────────────────────────────────
      focal_fill_na <- function(raster_stack, layer_names, max_iter = 50) {
          purrr::walk(layer_names, function(lyr) {
              r        <- raster_stack[[lyr]]
              na_start <- terra::global(r, fun = function(x) sum(is.na(x))) |>
                  as.numeric()
              if (na_start <= structural_na) return(invisible())
              iter    <- 0
              na_prev <- na_start
              while (iter < max_iter) {
                  iter     <- iter + 1
                  r_filled <- terra::focal(
                      r,
                      w         = 3,
                      fun       = "mean",
                      na.policy = "only",
                      na.rm     = TRUE
                  )
                  r_filled <- terra::mask(r_filled, georgia_boundary)
                  na_now   <- terra::global(r_filled, fun = function(x) sum(is.na(x))) |>
                      as.numeric()
                  if (na_now == na_prev) break
                  r       <- r_filled
                  na_prev <- na_now
              }
              raster_stack[[lyr]] <<- r_filled
              cat(lyr, ":", na_start, "->", na_prev, "NA (", iter, "iters)\n")
          })
          return(raster_stack)
      }
  
  ## ── (4a) Apply to baseline raster ────────────────────────────────────
      if (length(layers_to_fill) > 0) {
          baseline_raster <- focal_fill_na(baseline_raster, layers_to_fill)
      }
  
  ## ── (4b) Crop, mask, fill and write monthly rasters ──────────────────

          month_rast <- terra::rast(path) |>
              terra::crop(georgia_boundary) |>
              terra::mask(georgia_boundary)
          month_fill_layers <- intersect(layers_to_fill, names(month_rast))
          if (length(month_fill_layers) > 0) {
              month_rast <- focal_fill_na(month_rast, month_fill_layers)
          }
          out_path <- file.path(FILLED_MONTHLY_DIR, basename(path))
          terra::writeRaster(month_rast, out_path, overwrite = TRUE)
          return(out_path)
      })
  
  ## ── (5) Validation: confirm uniform NA footprint ─────────────────────

      if (nrow(excess_remaining) == 0) {
          cat("All tick covariate layers share a uniform NA footprint (", structural_na, "cells).\n")
      } else {
          warning(
              "Excess NAs persist in: ",
              paste(excess_remaining$variable, collapse = ", ")
          )

      }

          "Anopheles maculipennis", "Anopheles plumbeus",
          "Anopheles sacharovi", "Culex theileri",

      MOSQUITO_COVARIATES <- MOSQUITO_VARS_FINAL
      TICK_COVARIATES     <- TICK_VARS_FINAL
  
      get_covariates_for_species <- function(sp_name) {
          if (sp_name %in% ALL_MOSQUITO) return(MOSQUITO_COVARIATES)
          if (sp_name %in% ALL_TICK)     return(TICK_COVARIATES)
          stop("Species '", sp_name, "' not found in taxon lists.")
      }
  
      get_brt_model_path <- function(sp_name) {
          sp_clean <- gsub(" ", "_", sp_name)
          if (sp_name %in% STANDARD_BRT_SPECIES) {
              file.path(STANDARD_BRT_MODEL_DIR,
                        paste0(sp_clean, "_standard_brt_models.rds"))
          } else {
              file.path(TUNED_BRT_MODEL_DIR,
                        paste0(sp_clean, "_tuned_brt_models.rds"))
          }
      }
  
      MONTH_LABELS <- gsub("Georgia_Covariates_", "", names(monthly_raster_paths))
      names(MONTH_LABELS) <- names(monthly_raster_paths)
  
      MONTH_ORDER <- c("Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun",
                       "Jul", "Aug", "Sep", "Oct", "Nov", "Dec")
  
  # HELPER FUNCTIONS
      prepare_raster_for_brt <- function(rast_stack, covariates) {
          proj_raster <- rast_stack[[covariates]]
          if ("WorldCover" %in% names(proj_raster)) {
              proj_raster[["WorldCover"]] <- as.factor(proj_raster[["WorldCover"]])
          }
          dummy_presence        <- proj_raster[[1]] * 0
          names(dummy_presence) <- "presence"
          return(c(dummy_presence, proj_raster))
      }
  
      predict_brt_ensemble <- function(model_list, proj_raster) {
          pred_stack <- model_list |>
              purrr::compact() |>
              purrr::map(function(mod) {
                  tryCatch({
                      terra::predict(
                          proj_raster,
                          mod,
                          n.trees = mod$gbm.call$best.trees,
                          type    = "response",
                          na.rm   = TRUE
                      )
                  }, error = function(e) {
                      warning("Single BRT prediction failed: ", e$message)
                      return(NULL)
                  })
              }) |>
              purrr::compact() |>
              terra::rast()
          mean_rast        <- terra::app(pred_stack, mean, na.rm = TRUE)
          sd_rast          <- terra::app(pred_stack, sd,   na.rm = TRUE)
          names(mean_rast) <- "mean"
          names(sd_rast)   <- "sd"
          return(c(mean_rast, sd_rast))
      }
  
      project_esm_to_raster <- function(esm_model, esm_ensemble, proj_raster) {
          biv_proj <- ecospat.ESM.Projection(
              ESM.modeling.output = esm_model,
              new.env             = proj_raster,
              parallel            = FALSE
          )
          ens_proj <- ecospat.ESM.EnsembleProjection(
              ESM.prediction.output       = biv_proj,
              ESM.EnsembleModeling.output = esm_ensemble
          )
          ens_proj        <- ens_proj / 1000
          names(ens_proj) <- "mean"
          return(ens_proj)
      }
  
  # PART 1: BRT PREDICTIONS
      purrr::walk(ALL_BRT_SPECIES, function(sp) {
          sp_clean   <- gsub(" ", "_", sp)
          covariates <- get_covariates_for_species(sp)
          sp_start   <- Sys.time()
          cat("---\nSpecies:", sp, "\n")
          model_path <- get_brt_model_path(sp)
          if (!file.exists(model_path)) {
              cat("  Model file not found, skipping.\n")
              return(invisible())
          }
          models  <- readRDS(model_path)
          n_valid <- sum(!purrr::map_lgl(models, is.null))
          cat("  Models loaded:", n_valid, "/", length(models), "\n")
          baseline_proj <- prepare_raster_for_brt(baseline_raster, covariates)
          baseline_pred <- predict_brt_ensemble(models, baseline_proj)
          terra::writeRaster(
              baseline_pred,
              file.path(PREDICTION_DIR, "Baseline", paste0(sp_clean, "_baseline.tif")),
              overwrite = TRUE
          )
          monthly_sp_dir <- file.path(PREDICTION_DIR, "Monthly", sp_clean)
          dir.create(monthly_sp_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
          purrr::walk(MONTH_ORDER, function(month_label) {
              raster_key <- paste0("Georgia_Covariates_", month_label)
              if (!raster_key %in% names(monthly_raster_paths)) return(invisible())
              month_proj <- prepare_raster_for_brt(
                  terra::rast(monthly_raster_paths[[raster_key]]),
                  covariates
              )
              month_pred <- predict_brt_ensemble(models, month_proj)
              terra::writeRaster(
                  month_pred,
                  file.path(monthly_sp_dir, paste0(sp_clean, "_", month_label, ".tif")),
                  overwrite = TRUE
              )
          })
          rm(models, baseline_proj, baseline_pred)
          gc()
          cat("  Done (", round(difftime(Sys.time(), sp_start, units = "mins"), 1), "min)\n")
      })
  
  # PART 2: ESM PREDICTIONS
      purrr::walk(ESM_SPECIES, function(sp) {
          sp_clean   <- gsub(" ", "_", sp)
          sp_start   <- Sys.time()
          cat("---\nSpecies:", sp, "\n")
          model_path <- file.path(ESM_MODEL_DIR, sp_clean, "esm_model_objects.rds")
          if (!file.exists(model_path)) {
              cat("  Model file not found, skipping.\n")
              return(invisible())
          }
          esm_objs     <- readRDS(model_path)
          esm_model    <- esm_objs$esm_model
          esm_ensemble <- esm_objs$esm_ensemble
          covariates   <- esm_objs$covariates
          baseline_proj <- baseline_raster[[covariates]]
          baseline_pred <- tryCatch({
              project_esm_to_raster(esm_model, esm_ensemble, baseline_proj)
          }, error = function(e) {
              cat("  Baseline projection failed:", e$message, "\n")
              return(NULL)
          })
          if (!is.null(baseline_pred)) {
              terra::writeRaster(
                  baseline_pred,
                  file.path(PREDICTION_DIR, "Baseline", paste0(sp_clean, "_baseline.tif")),
                  overwrite = TRUE
              )
          }
          monthly_sp_dir <- file.path(PREDICTION_DIR, "Monthly", sp_clean)
          dir.create(monthly_sp_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
          purrr::walk(MONTH_ORDER, function(month_label) {
              raster_key <- paste0("Georgia_Covariates_", month_label)
              if (!raster_key %in% names(monthly_raster_paths)) return(invisible())
              month_proj <- terra::rast(monthly_raster_paths[[raster_key]])[[covariates]]
              month_pred <- tryCatch({
                  project_esm_to_raster(esm_model, esm_ensemble, month_proj)
              }, error = function(e) {
                  cat("  ", month_label, "projection failed:", e$message, "\n")
                  return(NULL)
              })
              if (!is.null(month_pred)) {
                  terra::writeRaster(
                      month_pred,
                      file.path(monthly_sp_dir, paste0(sp_clean, "_", month_label, ".tif")),
                      overwrite = TRUE
                  )
              }
          })
          rm(esm_objs, esm_model, esm_ensemble, baseline_proj, baseline_pred)
          gc()
          cat("  Done (", round(difftime(Sys.time(), sp_start, units = "mins"), 1), "min)\n")
      })
  
  # SUMMARY
      n_baseline <- length(list.files(file.path(PREDICTION_DIR, "Baseline"), pattern = "\\.tif$"))
      n_monthly  <- length(list.files(file.path(PREDICTION_DIR, "Monthly"),  pattern = "\\.tif$", recursive = TRUE))
      cat("Baseline outputs:", n_baseline, "| Monthly outputs:", n_monthly, "\n")

## Load and mask a single species raster
## georgia_union already excludes autonomous regions [1]
  load_masked_raster <- function(sp_name) {

  sp_clean      <- gsub(" ", "_", sp_name)
  baseline_path <- file.path(BASELINE_DIR, paste0(sp_clean, "_baseline.tif"))

  if (!file.exists(baseline_path)) {
    warning("Baseline raster not found for: ", sp_name)
    return(NULL)
  }

  pred_rast <- terra::rast(baseline_path)

  ## BRT = 2-layer [mean, sd]; ESM = 1-layer
  mean_rast <- if (terra::nlyr(pred_rast) >= 2) pred_rast[[1]] else pred_rast

  ## Mask to georgia_union (excludes Abkhazia + South Ossetia)
  georgia_vect <- terra::vect(georgia_union)
  mean_rast    <- terra::mask(mean_rast, georgia_vect)

  names(mean_rast) <- sp_name
  mean_rast
}


## Build a single species panel
  plot_species_suitability <- function(sp_name, rast_obj) {

  ## Convert to data frame for ggplot
  suit_df <- terra::as.data.frame(rast_obj, xy = TRUE) |>
    dplyr::rename(suitability = 3) |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(suitability))

  ## Italicised species label
  sp_label <- bquote(italic(.(sp_name)))

  ggplot() +
    ## Grey base: full country including autonomous regions (visual context)
    geom_sf(
      data      = georgia_admin0,
      fill      = "grey92",
      colour    = NA
    ) +
    ## Suitability surface (autonomous regions will be blank — masked above)
    geom_raster(
      data    = suit_df,
      mapping = aes(x = x, y = y, fill = suitability)
    ) +
    ## Municipal boundaries (light, non-distracting)
    geom_sf(
      data      = muni_boundaries,
      fill      = NA,
      colour    = "white",
      linewidth = 0.15
    ) +
    ## Outer country border
    geom_sf(
      data      = georgia_admin0,
      fill      = NA,
      colour    = "grey40",
      linewidth = 0.3
    ) +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(
      option   = "viridis",
      name     = "Suitability",
      limits   = c(0, 1),
      breaks   = c(0, 0.5, 1),
      labels   = c("0", "0.5", "1"),
      na.value = "transparent",
      guide    = guide_colorbar(
        barwidth  = 0.4,
        barheight = 3,
        ticks     = FALSE
      )
    ) +
    labs(title = sp_label) +
    coord_sf(expand = FALSE) +
    theme_void(base_size = 9) +
    theme(
      plot.title       = element_text(
        size   = 8,
        hjust  = 0.5,
        face   = "italic",
        margin = ggplot2::margin(b = 2)
      ),
      legend.position  = "right",
      legend.title     = element_text(size = 7),
      legend.text      = element_text(size = 6),
      plot.margin      = ggplot2::margin(4, 4, 4, 4)
    )
}

# HELPER FUNCTIONS

	#' Extract per-iteration evaluation metrics from a single gbm.step model
	#' Returns CV AUC, training AUC, deviance explained, TSS, and n_presences
  	extract_brt_metrics <- function(model) {
  
  		if (is.null(model)) {
  			return(tibble(
  				cv_auc             = NA_real_,
  				training_auc       = NA_real_,
  				deviance_explained = NA_real_,
  				tss                = NA_real_,
  				n_presences        = NA_integer_
  			))
  		}

		## Training predictions and observed response
		  preds <- model$fitted
		  obs   <- model$gbm.call$dataframe[[model$gbm.call$gbm.y]]

		## dismo evaluation object for TSS computation
  		eval_obj <- tryCatch(
  			dismo::evaluate(p = preds[obs == 1], a = preds[obs == 0]),
  			error = function(e) NULL
  		)

		## TSS = max(sensitivity + specificity - 1) across all thresholds
  		tss_val <- if (!is.null(eval_obj)) {
  			max(eval_obj@TPR + eval_obj@TNR - 1, na.rm = TRUE)
  		} else NA_real_

		## gbm.step internal performance metrics
  		cv_auc  <- model$cv.statistics$discrimination.mean
  		tr_auc  <- model$self.statistics$discrimination
  		dev_exp <- (1 - (model$cv.statistics$deviance.mean /
  		                 model$self.statistics$mean.null)) * 100
  
  		tibble(
  			cv_auc             = cv_auc,
  			training_auc       = tr_auc,
  			deviance_explained = dev_exp,
  			tss                = tss_val,
  			n_presences        = as.integer(sum(obs == 1))
  		)
  	}


	#' Process all 100 BRT models for one species: extract per-iteration
	#' metrics and return summary statistics (mean ± SD)
	#' Boyce index is computed separately from ensemble rasters (see below)
  	summarise_brt_species <- function(sp_name, model_list, tier) {
  
  		cat("  Extracting metrics from", sum(!map_lgl(model_list, is.null)),
  		    "models...\n")
  
  		## Extract metrics from each iteration
    		iter_metrics <- model_list |>
    			map_dfr(extract_brt_metrics)
  
  		## Summarise across iterations
  		tibble(
  			species                 = sp_name,
  			modeling_tier           = tier,
  			n_occurrences           = iter_metrics$n_presences[1],
  			cv_auc_mean             = mean(iter_metrics$cv_auc, na.rm = TRUE),
  			cv_auc_sd               = sd(iter_metrics$cv_auc, na.rm = TRUE),
  			training_auc_mean       = mean(iter_metrics$training_auc, na.rm = TRUE),
  			training_auc_sd         = sd(iter_metrics$training_auc, na.rm = TRUE),
  			deviance_explained_mean = mean(iter_metrics$deviance_explained, na.rm = TRUE),
  			deviance_explained_sd   = sd(iter_metrics$deviance_explained, na.rm = TRUE),
  			tss_mean                = mean(iter_metrics$tss, na.rm = TRUE),
  			tss_sd                  = sd(iter_metrics$tss, na.rm = TRUE),
  			boyce_mean              = NA_real_,
  			boyce_sd                = NA_real_
  		)
  	}


	#' Compute Boyce index for a BRT species using the ensemble mean raster
	#' and occurrence coordinates extracted from the master PA dataset
	#' Returns a single Boyce correlation value (Spearman cor of P/E ratio)
  	compute_brt_boyce <- function(sp_name, pres_coords_sf, baseline_dir) {
  
  		sp_clean <- gsub(" ", "_", sp_name)
  
  		## Load baseline ensemble mean raster
  		baseline_path <- file.path(baseline_dir, paste0(sp_clean, "_baseline.tif"))
  		if (!file.exists(baseline_path)) {
  			cat("    ⚠ Baseline raster not found\n")
  			return(NA_real_)
  		}
  
  		pred_rast <- rast(baseline_path)
  		mean_rast <- if (nlyr(pred_rast) >= 2) pred_rast[[1]] else pred_rast
  
  		## Full landscape predicted values (background distribution)
  		fit_vals <- values(mean_rast, na.rm = TRUE) |> as.numeric()
  
  		## Convert presence coords to SpatVector for extraction
  		pres_vect <- vect(pres_coords_sf)
  
  		## Extract ensemble predictions at known occurrence locations
  		obs_vals <- terra::extract(mean_rast, pres_vect)[[2]] |>
  			na.omit() |>
  			as.numeric()
  
  		if (length(obs_vals) < 5) {
  			cat("    ⚠ Too few valid presence extractions for Boyce\n")
  			return(NA_real_)
  		}
  
  		## Boyce index (predicted-to-expected ratio correlation)
  		boyce_result <- tryCatch(
  			ecospat::ecospat.boyce(
  				fit     = fit_vals,
  				obs     = obs_vals,
  				PEplot  = FALSE
  			),
  			error = function(e) {
  				cat("    ⚠ Boyce computation failed:", e$message, "\n")
  				NULL
  			}
  		)
  
  		if (!is.null(boyce_result)) boyce_result$cor else NA_real_
  	}


	#' Extract evaluation metrics from a saved ESM model object
	#' ESMs store AUC, TSS, and Boyce in the ensemble evaluation output
  	summarise_esm_species <- function(sp_name, esm_objs) {
  
  		esm_ensemble <- esm_objs$esm_ensemble
  
  		## Evaluation metrics from ecospat ensemble
  		evals <- esm_ensemble$ESM.evaluations
  
  		auc_vals   <- evals$AUC
  		tss_vals   <- evals$TSS
  		boyce_vals <- evals$Boyce
  
  		## Attempt to extract n_occurrences from ESM model objects
  		## The BIOMOD formatted data stores presence count; exact accessor
  		## depends on your ESM object structure — adjust as needed
  		n_occ <- tryCatch({
  			if (!is.null(esm_objs$n_presences)) {
  				as.integer(esm_objs$n_presences)
  			} else if (!is.null(esm_objs$biomod_data)) {
  				## biomod2 formatted data stores coords for presences
  				sum(esm_objs$biomod_data@data.species == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
  			} else {
  				NA_integer_
  			}
  		}, error = function(e) NA_integer_)
  
  		tibble(
  			species                 = sp_name,
  			modeling_tier           = "ESM",
  			n_occurrences           = n_occ,
  			cv_auc_mean             = mean(auc_vals, na.rm = TRUE),
  			cv_auc_sd               = sd(auc_vals, na.rm = TRUE),
  			training_auc_mean       = NA_real_,
  			training_auc_sd         = NA_real_,
  			deviance_explained_mean = NA_real_,
  			deviance_explained_sd   = NA_real_,
  			tss_mean                = mean(tss_vals, na.rm = TRUE),
  			tss_sd                  = sd(tss_vals, na.rm = TRUE),
  			boyce_mean              = mean(boyce_vals, na.rm = TRUE),
  			boyce_sd                = sd(boyce_vals, na.rm = TRUE)
  		)
  	}


# PART 1: EXTRACT EVALUATION METRICS

  ## Species by tier
      STANDARD_BRT_SPECIES <- c(
          "Culex pipiens", "Ixodes ricinus", "Aedes albopictus",
          "Dermacentor marginatus", "Dermacentor reticulatus"
      )
      TUNED_BRT_SPECIES <- c(
          "Aedes vexans", "Culex theileri",
          "Haemaphysalis inermis", "Hyalomma marginatum"
      )
      ESM_SPECIES <- c(
          "Aedes aegypti",
          "Anopheles maculipennis", "Anopheles plumbeus", "Anopheles sacharovi",
          "Culex tritaeniorhynchus", "Culiseta annulata",
          "Hyalomma aegyptium", "Rhipicephalus sanguineus"
      )
  
  # maxSSS COMPUTATION
  #' Compute the maxSSS threshold from predicted values and binary observed response
      compute_maxsss <- function(preds, obs) {
          pres_p <- preds[obs == 1]
          abs_p  <- preds[obs == 0]
          cands  <- sort(unique(preds[!is.na(preds)]))
          if (length(cands) > 500) {
              cands <- quantile(cands, seq(0, 1, length.out = 500), na.rm = TRUE)
          }
          ss    <- purrr::map_dbl(cands, function(t) {
              sum(pres_p >= t) / length(pres_p) + sum(abs_p < t) / length(abs_p)
          })
          cands[which.max(ss)]
      }
  
  #' Extract maxSSS from a single gbm.step model object
      extract_brt_maxsss <- function(model) {
          if (is.null(model)) return(NA_real_)
          preds <- model$fitted
          obs   <- model$gbm.call$dataframe[[model$gbm.call$gbm.y]]
          compute_maxsss(preds, obs)
      }
  
  # PART 1: BRT THRESHOLDS

              model_dir   = STANDARD_BRT_MODEL_DIR,

              tier        = "Tuned_BRT",
              model_dir   = TUNED_BRT_MODEL_DIR,
              file_suffix = "_tuned_brt_models.rds"
          )
      )
  
      brt_thresholds <- purrr::pmap_dfr(
          brt_threshold_specs,
          function(species, tier, model_dir, file_suffix) {
              sp_clean   <- gsub(" ", "_", species)
              model_path <- file.path(model_dir, paste0(sp_clean, file_suffix))
              cat(species, "(", tier, ") ...")
              if (!file.exists(model_path)) {
                  cat(" model file not found\n")
                  return(tibble::tibble(
                      species       = species,
                      modeling_tier = tier,
                      maxsss_mean   = NA_real_,
                      maxsss_sd     = NA_real_,
                      n_models      = NA_integer_
                  ))
              }
              models           <- readRDS(model_path)
              iter_thresholds  <- purrr::map_dbl(models, extract_brt_maxsss)
              valid_thresholds <- iter_thresholds[!is.na(iter_thresholds)]
              cat(" ", length(valid_thresholds), "valid |",
                  "maxSSS:", round(mean(valid_thresholds), 4), "\n")
              rm(models); gc()
              tibble::tibble(
                  species       = species,
                  modeling_tier = tier,
                  maxsss_mean   = mean(valid_thresholds),
                  maxsss_sd     = sd(valid_thresholds),
                  n_models      = length(valid_thresholds)
              )
          }
      )
  
  # PART 2: ESM THRESHOLDS
      esm_thresholds <- purrr::map_dfr(ESM_SPECIES, function(sp) {
          sp_clean   <- gsub(" ", "_", sp)
          model_path <- file.path(ESM_MODEL_DIR, sp_clean, "esm_model_objects.rds")
          cat(sp, "(ESM) ...")
          if (!file.exists(model_path)) {
              cat(" model file not found\n")
              return(tibble::tibble(
                  species       = sp,
                  modeling_tier = "ESM",
                  maxsss_mean   = NA_real_,
                  maxsss_sd     = NA_real_,
                  n_models      = NA_integer_
              ))
          }
          esm_objs   <- readRDS(model_path)
          maxsss_val <- esm_objs$thresholds$maxsss
          cat(" maxSSS:", round(maxsss_val, 4), "\n")
          tibble::tibble(
              species       = sp,
              modeling_tier = "ESM",
              maxsss_mean   = maxsss_val,
              maxsss_sd     = NA_real_,
              n_models      = 1L
          )
      })
  
  # COMBINE ALL THRESHOLDS
      all_thresholds <- dplyr::bind_rows(brt_thresholds, esm_thresholds) |>
          dplyr::arrange(modeling_tier, species)
  
      print(all_thresholds, n = nrow(all_thresholds), width = Inf)
  
  # PART 3: BINARY CLASSIFICATION AND LANDSCAPE PROPORTION
      landscape_proportion <- purrr::pmap_dfr(
          all_thresholds,
          function(species, modeling_tier, maxsss_mean, maxsss_sd, n_models) {
              sp_clean      <- gsub(" ", "_", species)
              baseline_path <- file.path(BASELINE_DIR, paste0(sp_clean, "_baseline.tif"))
              if (is.na(maxsss_mean) || !file.exists(baseline_path)) {
                  return(tibble::tibble(
                      species          = species,
                      modeling_tier    = modeling_tier,
                      maxsss_threshold = maxsss_mean,
                      n_pixels_total   = NA_integer_,
                      n_pixels_present = NA_integer_,
                      pct_landscape    = NA_real_
                  ))
              }
              pred_rast   <- terra::rast(baseline_path)
              mean_rast   <- if (terra::nlyr(pred_rast) >= 2) pred_rast[[1]] else pred_rast
              binary_rast <- mean_rast >= maxsss_mean
              all_vals    <- terra::values(binary_rast, na.rm = TRUE)
              n_total     <- length(all_vals)
              n_present   <- sum(all_vals == 1)
              cat(species, ":", round((n_present / n_total) * 100, 2), "% present\n")
              tibble::tibble(
                  species          = species,
                  modeling_tier    = modeling_tier,
                  maxsss_threshold = round(maxsss_mean, 4),
                  n_pixels_total   = as.integer(n_total),
                  n_pixels_present = as.integer(n_present),
                  pct_landscape    = round((n_present / n_total) * 100, 2)
              )
          }
      )
  
      print(landscape_proportion, n = nrow(landscape_proportion), width = Inf)
  
  # PART 4: SAVE BINARY RASTERS
      purrr::pwalk(
          landscape_proportion |> dplyr::filter(!is.na(maxsss_threshold)),
          function(species, modeling_tier, maxsss_threshold, ...) {
              sp_clean      <- gsub(" ", "_", species)
              baseline_path <- file.path(BASELINE_DIR, paste0(sp_clean, "_baseline.tif"))
              pred_rast     <- terra::rast(baseline_path)
              mean_rast     <- if (terra::nlyr(pred_rast) >= 2) pred_rast[[1]] else pred_rast
              binary_rast   <- mean_rast >= maxsss_threshold
              names(binary_rast) <- "present"
              terra::writeRaster(
                  binary_rast,
                  file.path(BINARY_DIR, paste0(sp_clean, "_binary_maxsss.tif")),
                  overwrite = TRUE,
                  datatype  = "INT1U"
              )
          }
      )
  
  # PART 5: SAVE SUMMARY TABLES
      readr::write_csv(
          all_thresholds,
          file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "maxsss_thresholds_all_species.csv")
      )
      readr::write_csv(
          landscape_proportion,
          file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "landscape_proportion_at_maxsss.csv")
      )
  
      all_thresholds |>
          dplyr::left_join(
              landscape_proportion |>
                  dplyr::select(species, n_pixels_total, n_pixels_present, pct_landscape),
              by = "species"
          ) |>
          readr::write_csv(
              file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "maxsss_threshold_and_landscape_summary.csv")
          )

          "sfg_rickettsia", "Hyalomma aegyptium",         0.05,        0.01,          0.10,
          ## Crimean-Congo Haemorrhagic Fever Virus (CCHFV)
          "cchf",           "Hyalomma marginatum",        1.00,        0.90,          1.00,

          ## Tularaemia (Francisella tularensis)

          "tularemia",      "Ixodes ricinus",             0.25,        0.10,          0.40,
          "tularemia",      "Dermacentor reticulatus",    0.25,        0.10,          0.40
      )
  
  ## Readable labels for output and plotting
      disease_labels <- tibble::tribble(
          ~disease_group,   ~disease_label,
          "aedes_arbo",     "Emerging Aedes-borne Viruses",
          "wnv_complex",    "West Nile Virus Complex",
          "malaria",        "Malaria (Receptivity)",
          "tbe",            "Tick-borne Encephalitis",
          "lyme",           "Lyme Borreliosis",
          "sfg_rickettsia", "Spotted Fever Rickettsioses",
          "cchf",           "Crimean-Congo Haemorrhagic Fever",
          "tularemia",      "Tularaemia"
      )
  
  # LOAD INPUT DATA
  ## Municipal suitability: long format (species x municipality)
      municipal_suit <- readr::read_csv(MUNICIPAL_SUIT_PATH, show_col_types = FALSE)
  
  ## maxSSS thresholds: species-level mean +/- SD from the 100-iteration ensemble
      thresholds <- readr::read_csv(THRESHOLD_PATH, show_col_types = FALSE)
  
  ## Verify species alignment between weights and available data
      available_species <- unique(municipal_suit$species)
      required_species  <- unique(disease_weights$species)
      missing_species   <- setdiff(required_species, available_species)
  
      if (length(missing_species) > 0) {
          warning(
              "Species in weight table not found in municipal suitability data:\n  ",
              paste(missing_species, collapse = "\n  "),
              "\n  These will be excluded from their disease groups."
          )
      }
  
      disease_weights <- disease_weights |>
          dplyr::filter(species %in% available_species)
  
  ## Verify threshold availability
      missing_thresholds <- setdiff(unique(disease_weights$species), unique(thresholds$species))
      if (length(missing_thresholds) > 0) {
          warning(
              "Species missing from thresholds table:\n  ",
              paste(missing_thresholds, collapse = "\n  ")
          )
      }
  
      municipalities   <- municipal_suit |>
          dplyr::select(municipality_mapped) |>
          dplyr::distinct()
      n_municipalities <- nrow(municipalities)
      disease_groups   <- unique(disease_weights$disease_group)
      n_groups         <- length(disease_groups)
  
      cat("Municipalities:", n_municipalities,
          "| Disease groups:", n_groups,
          "| Species:", length(unique(disease_weights$species)),
          "| MC iterations:", N_ITERATIONS, "\n\n")
  
  # HELPER FUNCTIONS
  #' Estimate SD from lower/upper bounds interpreted as ~95% CI
      bounds_to_sd <- function(lower, upper) {
          (upper - lower) / 3.92
      }
  
  #' Sample truncated normal weights for a single specification
      sample_weight <- function(central, lower, upper, n_samples) {
          truncnorm::rtruncnorm(
              n    = n_samples,
              a    = 0,
              b    = 1,
              mean = central,
              sd   = bounds_to_sd(lower, upper)
          )
      }
  
  #' Sample truncated normal thresholds using ensemble mean +/- SD
      sample_threshold <- function(threshold_mean, threshold_sd, n_samples) {
          if (is.na(threshold_sd) || threshold_sd == 0) {
              return(rep(threshold_mean, n_samples))
          }
          truncnorm::rtruncnorm(
              n    = n_samples,
              a    = 0,
              b    = 1,
              mean = threshold_mean,
              sd   = threshold_sd
          )
      }
  
  # PRE-SAMPLE ALL STOCHASTIC INPUTS
  ## Pre-sampling once avoids repeated RNG calls inside the iteration loop
  ## and ensures full reproducibility from a single seed
      set.seed(SEED)
  
      weight_samples <- disease_weights |>
          dplyr::mutate(
              sample_key = paste(disease_group, species, sep = "::"),
              samples    = purrr::pmap(
                  list(weight_raw, weight_lower, weight_upper),
                  ~ sample_weight(..1, ..2, ..3, N_ITERATIONS)
              )
          ) |>
          dplyr::select(sample_key, samples) |>
          tibble::deframe()
  
      threshold_samples <- thresholds |>
          dplyr::filter(species %in% unique(disease_weights$species)) |>
          dplyr::mutate(
              samples = purrr::pmap(
                  list(maxsss_mean, maxsss_sd),
                  ~ sample_threshold(..1, ..2, N_ITERATIONS)
              )
          ) |>
          dplyr::select(species, samples) |>
          tibble::deframe()
  
      cat("Weight sample keys:", length(weight_samples),
          "| Threshold sample keys:", length(threshold_samples), "\n\n")
  
  # BUILD MUNICIPAL SUITABILITY LOOKUP
  ## Named list of named vectors for fast lookup:
  ##   suit_lookup[["species_name"]] -> named vector (municipality -> mean suitability)
      suit_lookup <- municipal_suit |>
          split(~species) |>
          purrr::map(\(df) rlang::set_names(df$municipal_mean, df$municipality_mapped))
  
      cat("Built suitability lookup for", length(suit_lookup), "species\n\n")
  
  # MONTE CARLO SIMULATION
  ## For each disease group and iteration:
  ##   (1) Retrieve pre-sampled weights and renormalise to sum to 1
  ##   (2) Retrieve pre-sampled thresholds for each species
  ##   (3) Classify each municipality as suitable/unsuitable (binary)
  ##   (4) Compute weighted sum of binary indicators
      cat("Running Monte Carlo simulation...\n")
  
      mc_results <- purrr::map(disease_groups, function(dg) {
          cat(" ", dg, "\n")
          group_species <- disease_weights |>
              dplyr::filter(disease_group == dg) |>
              dplyr::pull(species)
          result_mat <- matrix(
              NA_real_,
              nrow     = n_municipalities,
              ncol     = N_ITERATIONS,
              dimnames = list(municipalities$municipality_mapped, NULL)
          )
          purrr::walk(seq_len(N_ITERATIONS), function(iter) {
              raw_weights  <- purrr::map_dbl(group_species, \(sp) {
                  weight_samples[[paste(dg, sp, sep = "::")]][iter]
              })
              norm_weights <- raw_weights / sum(raw_weights)
              weighted_binary <- purrr::map2_dfc(
                  group_species,
                  norm_weights,
                  function(sp, wt) {
                      thresh    <- threshold_samples[[sp]][iter]
                      suit_vals <- suit_lookup[[sp]][municipalities$municipality_mapped]
                      tibble::tibble(!!sp := as.numeric(suit_vals >= thresh) * wt)
                  }
              )
              result_mat[, iter] <<- rowSums(weighted_binary, na.rm = TRUE)
          })
          result_mat
      }) |>
          rlang::set_names(disease_groups)
  
      cat("Monte Carlo simulation complete.\n\n")
  
  # WEIGHT-ONLY SENSITIVITY: VARIANCE DECOMPOSITION
  ## Re-runs MC with thresholds fixed at their ensemble means to isolate
  ## the contribution of weight uncertainty to total output variance.
  ## Variance attributable to threshold uncertainty = total_var - weight_var.
      cat("Running weight-only MC for variance decomposition...\n")
  
      threshold_fixed <- thresholds |>
          dplyr::filter(species %in% unique(disease_weights$species)) |>
          dplyr::select(species, maxsss_mean) |>
          tibble::deframe()
  
      mc_results_weights_only <- purrr::map(disease_groups, function(dg) {
          group_species <- disease_weights |>
              dplyr::filter(disease_group == dg) |>
              dplyr::pull(species)
          result_mat <- matrix(
              NA_real_,
              nrow     = n_municipalities,
              ncol     = N_ITERATIONS,
              dimnames = list(municipalities$municipality_mapped, NULL)
          )
          purrr::walk(seq_len(N_ITERATIONS), function(iter) {
              raw_weights  <- purrr::map_dbl(group_species, \(sp) {
                  weight_samples[[paste(dg, sp, sep = "::")]][iter]
              })
              norm_weights <- raw_weights / sum(raw_weights)
              weighted_binary <- purrr::map2_dfc(
                  group_species,
                  norm_weights,
                  function(sp, wt) {
                      thresh    <- threshold_fixed[[sp]]
                      suit_vals <- suit_lookup[[sp]][municipalities$municipality_mapped]
                      tibble::tibble(!!sp := as.numeric(suit_vals >= thresh) * wt)
                  }
              )
              result_mat[, iter] <<- rowSums(weighted_binary, na.rm = TRUE)
          })
          result_mat
      }) |>
          rlang::set_names(disease_groups)
  
      cat("Weight-only MC complete.\n\n")
  
  ## Variance decomposition: per-municipality, per-disease-group
      variance_decomposition <- purrr::map_dfr(disease_groups, function(dg) {
          mat_total  <- mc_results[[dg]]
          mat_weight <- mc_results_weights_only[[dg]]
          tibble::tibble(
              disease_group       = dg,
              municipality_mapped = rownames(mat_total),
              var_total           = apply(mat_total,  1, var, na.rm = TRUE),
              var_weight_only     = apply(mat_weight, 1, var, na.rm = TRUE),
              var_threshold_only  = var_total - var_weight_only
          ) |>
              dplyr::mutate(
                  weight_var_fraction    = var_weight_only / pmax(var_total, 1e-10),
                  threshold_var_fraction = 1 - weight_var_fraction
              )
      }) |>
          dplyr::left_join(disease_labels, by = "disease_group")
  
      variance_decomposition |>
          dplyr::group_by(disease_group, disease_label) |>
          dplyr::summarise(
              mean_weight_frac    = round(mean(weight_var_fraction,    na.rm = TRUE), 3),
              mean_threshold_frac = round(mean(threshold_var_fraction, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
              .groups = "drop"
          ) |>
          dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(mean_weight_frac)) |>
          print(n = Inf, width = Inf)
  
      readr::write_csv(
          variance_decomposition,
          file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "variance_decomposition_weights_vs_thresholds.csv")
      )
  
  # SUMMARISE MC RESULTS
  ## For each disease group x municipality, compute mean, SD, and 95% CI
      disease_exposure <- purrr::map_dfr(disease_groups, function(dg) {
          mat <- mc_results[[dg]]
          tibble::tibble(
              disease_group       = dg,
              municipality_mapped = rownames(mat),
              exposure_mean       = rowMeans(mat, na.rm = TRUE),
              exposure_sd         = apply(mat, 1, sd,                    na.rm = TRUE),
              exposure_q025       = apply(mat, 1, quantile, 0.025,       na.rm = TRUE),
              exposure_q975       = apply(mat, 1, quantile, 0.975,       na.rm = TRUE)
          )
      }) |>
          dplyr::left_join(disease_labels, by = "disease_group")
  
      disease_exposure |>
          dplyr::group_by(disease_group, disease_label) |>
          dplyr::summarise(
              mean_exposure    = round(mean(exposure_mean), 4),
              sd_exposure      = round(mean(exposure_sd),   4),
              min_exposure     = round(min(exposure_mean),  4),
              max_exposure     = round(max(exposure_mean),  4),
              n_municipalities = dplyr::n(),
              .groups = "drop"
          ) |>
          print(n = Inf, width = Inf)
  
  # WEIGHT SENSITIVITY: COEFFICIENT OF VARIATION
      sensitivity_summary <- disease_exposure |>
          dplyr::mutate(
              cv = dplyr::if_else(exposure_mean > 0, exposure_sd / exposure_mean, NA_real_)
          ) |>
          dplyr::group_by(disease_group, disease_label) |>
          dplyr::summarise(
              mean_cv = round(mean(cv, na.rm = TRUE), 4),
              max_cv  = round(max(cv,  na.rm = TRUE), 4),
              .groups = "drop"
          ) |>
          dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(mean_cv))
  
      print(sensitivity_summary, n = Inf, width = Inf)
  
  # SAVE OUTPUTS
      readr::write_csv(
          disease_exposure,
          file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "disease_exposure_mc_baseline.csv")
      )
      readr::write_csv(
          sensitivity_summary,
          file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "weight_sensitivity_cv.csv")
      )
  
      cat("All outputs saved to:", OUTPUT_DIR, "\n")

          "aedes_arbo",     "Aedes vexans",               0.05,        0.01,          0.10,
          ## West Nile Virus Complex (WNV / USUV / SINV)
          "wnv_complex",    "Culex pipiens",              1.00,        0.90,          1.00,
          "wnv_complex",    "Culex theileri",             0.50,        0.30,          0.70,
          "wnv_complex",    "Culex tritaeniorhynchus",    0.40,        0.20,          0.60,
          "wnv_complex",    "Aedes vexans",               0.15,        0.05,          0.25,
          ## Malaria (Plasmodium falciparum / P. vivax)
          "malaria",        "Anopheles sacharovi",        1.00,        0.90,          1.00,
          "malaria",        "Anopheles maculipennis",     0.50,        0.30,          0.70,
          "malaria",        "Anopheles plumbeus",         0.50,        0.30,          0.70,
          ## Tick-borne Encephalitis Virus (TBEV)
          "tbe",            "Ixodes ricinus",             1.00,        0.90,          1.00,
          "tbe",            "Dermacentor reticulatus",    0.40,        0.20,          0.60,
          "tbe",            "Haemaphysalis inermis",      0.30,        0.15,          0.45,
          "tbe",            "Dermacentor marginatus",     0.15,        0.05,          0.25,
          ## Lyme Borreliosis (Borrelia burgdorferi s.l.)
          "lyme",           "Ixodes ricinus",             1.00,        0.95,          1.00,
          ## Spotted Fever Group Rickettsioses
          "sfg_rickettsia", "Rhipicephalus sanguineus",   1.00,        0.85,          1.00,
          "sfg_rickettsia", "Dermacentor marginatus",     0.85,        0.70,          1.00,
          "sfg_rickettsia", "Dermacentor reticulatus",    0.70,        0.50,          0.90,
          "sfg_rickettsia", "Hyalomma marginatum",        0.65,        0.45,          0.85,
          "sfg_rickettsia", "Hyalomma aegyptium",         0.05,        0.01,          0.10,
          ## Crimean-Congo Haemorrhagic Fever Virus (CCHFV)
          "cchf",           "Hyalomma marginatum",        1.00,        0.90,          1.00,
          "cchf",           "Hyalomma aegyptium",         0.25,        0.10,          0.40,
          ## Tularaemia (Francisella tularensis)
          "tularemia",      "Dermacentor marginatus",     1.00,        0.90,          1.00,
          "tularemia",      "Ixodes ricinus",             0.25,        0.10,          0.40,
          "tularemia",      "Dermacentor reticulatus",    0.25,        0.10,          0.40
      )
  
  ## Readable labels for output and plotting
      disease_labels <- tibble::tribble(
          ~disease_group,   ~disease_label,
          "aedes_arbo",     "Emerging Aedes-borne Viruses",
          "wnv_complex",    "West Nile Virus Complex",
          "malaria",        "Malaria (Receptivity)",
          "tbe",            "Tick-borne Encephalitis",
          "lyme",           "Lyme Borreliosis",
          "sfg_rickettsia", "Spotted Fever Rickettsioses",
          "cchf",           "Crimean-Congo Haemorrhagic Fever",
          "tularemia",      "Tularaemia"
      )
  
  # LOAD INPUT DATA
      municipal_suit    <- readr::read_csv(MUNICIPAL_SUIT_PATH, show_col_types = FALSE)
      available_species <- unique(municipal_suit$species)
      missing_species   <- setdiff(unique(disease_weights$species), available_species)
  
      if (length(missing_species) > 0) {
          warning(
              "Species in weight table not found in municipal suitability data:\n  ",
              paste(missing_species, collapse = "\n  "),
              "\n  These will be excluded from their disease groups."
          )
      }
  
      disease_weights  <- disease_weights |>
          dplyr::filter(species %in% available_species)
  
      municipalities   <- municipal_suit |>
          dplyr::select(municipality_mapped) |>
          dplyr::distinct()
      n_municipalities <- nrow(municipalities)
      disease_groups   <- unique(disease_weights$disease_group)
      n_groups         <- length(disease_groups)
  
      cat("Municipalities:", n_municipalities,
          "| Disease groups:", n_groups,
          "| Species:", length(unique(disease_weights$species)),
          "| MC iterations:", N_ITERATIONS, "\n\n")
  
  # HELPER FUNCTIONS
  #' Estimate SD from lower/upper bounds interpreted as ~95% CI
      bounds_to_sd <- function(lower, upper) {
          (upper - lower) / 3.92
      }
  
  #' Sample weights from truncated normal distribution bounded [0, 1]
      sample_weight <- function(central, lower, upper, n_samples) {
          truncnorm::rtruncnorm(
              n    = n_samples,
              a    = 0,
              b    = 1,
              mean = central,
              sd   = bounds_to_sd(lower, upper)
          )
      }
  
  # PRE-SAMPLE WEIGHT DISTRIBUTIONS
      set.seed(SEED)
  
      weight_samples <- disease_weights |>
          dplyr::mutate(
              sample_key = paste(disease_group, species, sep = "::"),
              samples    = purrr::pmap(
                  list(weight_raw, weight_lower, weight_upper),
                  ~ sample_weight(..1, ..2, ..3, N_ITERATIONS)
              )
          ) |>
          dplyr::select(sample_key, samples) |>
          tibble::deframe()
  
      cat("Weight sample keys:", length(weight_samples), "\n\n")
  
  # BUILD MUNICIPAL SUITABILITY LOOKUP
  ## Named list of named vectors: suit_lookup[["species"]] -> c(muni1 = val, ...)
      suit_lookup <- municipal_suit |>
          split(~species) |>
          purrr::map(\(df) rlang::set_names(df$municipal_mean, df$municipality_mapped))
  
      cat("Built suitability lookup for", length(suit_lookup), "species\n\n")
  
  # MONTE CARLO SIMULATION — CONTINUOUS SUITABILITY
  ## For each disease group and iteration:
  ##   (1) Retrieve pre-sampled weights and renormalise to sum to 1
  ##   (2) Multiply each species' continuous suitability by its normalised weight
  ##   (3) Sum across species to produce the disease group exposure index
  ##
  ## No threshold is applied; suitability values enter the index directly,
  ## preserving ecological gradients and eliminating binary classification
  ## artefacts at threshold boundaries.
      cat("Running Monte Carlo simulation (continuous approach)...\n")
  
      mc_results <- purrr::map(disease_groups, function(dg) {
          cat(" ", dg, "\n")
          group_species <- disease_weights |>
              dplyr::filter(disease_group == dg) |>
              dplyr::pull(species)
          result_mat <- matrix(
              NA_real_,
              nrow     = n_municipalities,
              ncol     = N_ITERATIONS,
              dimnames = list(municipalities$municipality_mapped, NULL)
          )
          ## Pre-build suitability matrix (municipalities x species) for this group
          ## to avoid repeated lookup inside the iteration loop
          suit_matrix <- purrr::map(group_species, function(sp) {
              suit_lookup[[sp]][municipalities$municipality_mapped]
          }) |>
              rlang::set_names(group_species) |>
              dplyr::bind_cols() |>
              as.matrix()
          suit_matrix[is.na(suit_matrix)] <- 0
          purrr::walk(seq_len(N_ITERATIONS), function(iter) {
              raw_weights  <- purrr::map_dbl(group_species, \(sp) {
                  weight_samples[[paste(dg, sp, sep = "::")]][iter]
              })
              norm_weights <- raw_weights / sum(raw_weights)
              ## Matrix multiplication: (n_muni x n_species) %*% (n_species x 1)
              result_mat[, iter] <<- as.numeric(suit_matrix %*% norm_weights)
          })
          result_mat
      }) |>
          rlang::set_names(disease_groups)
  
      cat("Monte Carlo simulation complete.\n\n")
  
  # SUMMARISE MC RESULTS
      disease_exposure <- purrr::map_dfr(disease_groups, function(dg) {
          mat <- mc_results[[dg]]
          tibble::tibble(
              disease_group       = dg,
              municipality_mapped = rownames(mat),
              exposure_mean       = rowMeans(mat, na.rm = TRUE),
              exposure_sd         = apply(mat, 1, sd,              na.rm = TRUE),
              exposure_q025       = apply(mat, 1, quantile, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
              exposure_q975       = apply(mat, 1, quantile, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)
          )
      }) |>
          dplyr::left_join(disease_labels, by = "disease_group")
  
      disease_exposure |>
          dplyr::group_by(disease_group, disease_label) |>
          dplyr::summarise(
              mean_exposure    = round(mean(exposure_mean), 4),
              sd_exposure      = round(mean(exposure_sd),   4),
              min_exposure     = round(min(exposure_mean),  4),
              max_exposure     = round(max(exposure_mean),  4),
              n_municipalities = dplyr::n(),
              .groups = "drop"
          ) |>
          print(n = Inf, width = Inf)
  
  # WEIGHT SENSITIVITY — COEFFICIENT OF VARIATION
      sensitivity_summary <- disease_exposure |>
          dplyr::mutate(
              cv = dplyr::if_else(exposure_mean > 0, exposure_sd / exposure_mean, NA_real_)
          ) |>
          dplyr::group_by(disease_group, disease_label) |>
          dplyr::summarise(
              mean_cv   = round(mean(cv,   na.rm = TRUE), 4),
              median_cv = round(median(cv, na.rm = TRUE), 4),
              max_cv    = round(max(cv,    na.rm = TRUE), 4),
              .groups   = "drop"
          ) |>
          dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(mean_cv))
  
      print(sensitivity_summary, n = Inf, width = Inf)
  
  # RANK STABILITY — SPEARMAN CORRELATION WITH POINT ESTIMATE
  ## For each disease group, compute the Spearman rank correlation between
  ## the point estimate and each MC iteration to assess whether the spatial
  ## ranking of municipalities is stable across weight perturbations.
  ## A mean rho > 0.95 indicates that ordinal rankings are effectively
  ## invariant to weight uncertainty.
      rank_stability <- purrr::map_dfr(disease_groups, function(dg) {
          mat       <- mc_results[[dg]]
          point_est <- rowMeans(mat, na.rm = TRUE)
          iter_rhos <- purrr::map_dbl(seq_len(N_ITERATIONS), function(iter) {
              cor(point_est, mat[, iter], method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs")
          })
          tibble::tibble(
              disease_group = dg,
              rho_mean      = round(mean(iter_rhos, na.rm = TRUE), 4),
              rho_sd        = round(sd(iter_rhos,   na.rm = TRUE), 4),
              rho_min       = round(min(iter_rhos,  na.rm = TRUE), 4)
          )
      }) |>
          dplyr::left_join(disease_labels, by = "disease_group")
  
      print(rank_stability, n = Inf, width = Inf)
  
  # SAVE OUTPUTS
      readr::write_csv(
          disease_exposure,
          file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "disease_exposure_continuous_mc_baseline.csv")
      )
      readr::write_csv(
          sensitivity_summary,
          file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "weight_sensitivity_cv_continuous.csv")
      )
      readr::write_csv(
          rank_stability,
          file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "rank_stability_continuous.csv")
      )
  
      cat("All outputs saved to:", OUTPUT_DIR, "\n")

  # LOAD GEORGIA VULNERABILITY DATA FROM GITHUB

  GITHUB_BASE <- "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/IanPsheaSmith/GVecVuln/main/data/georgia_census"

  COMPONENTS <- c(
      "population_total",
      "healthcare_staff",
      "education_graduates",
      "age_dependency",
      "disability_prevalence",
      "average_wages"
  )


  # LOAD METADATA FROM GITHUB

  #' Load municipality metadata from GitHub
    #' @return tibble with region, municipality_slug, and component availability
      load_municipalities_metadata <- function() {
          
          url <- glue("{GITHUB_BASE}/municipalities.csv")
          
          tryCatch({
              read_csv(url, show_col_types = FALSE)
          }, error = function(e) {
              stop("Failed to load municipalities.csv from GitHub. Check your internet connection.")
          })
      }

  # LOAD SINGLE FILE FROM GITHUB

  #' Load a single Excel file from GitHub
    #' @param region Region URL key (e.g., "tbilisi", "adjara")
    #' @param municipality_slug Municipality slug (e.g., "batumi")
    #' @param component Component name (e.g., "population_total")
    #' @return tibble with Excel data, or NULL if not found
      load_component_github <- function(region, municipality_slug, component) {
          
          url <- glue("{GITHUB_BASE}/{region}/{municipality_slug}/{component}.xlsx")
          
          # Download to temp file (required for read_excel)
          temp_file <- tempfile(fileext = ".xlsx")
          
          response <- tryCatch({
              GET(url, write_disk(temp_file, overwrite = TRUE), timeout(30))
          }, error = function(e) NULL)
          
          if (is.null(response) || status_code(response) != 200) {
              return(NULL)
          }
          
          tryCatch({
              read_excel(temp_file)
          }, error = function(e) {
              NULL
          }) %>%
              { if (!is.null(.)) mutate(., .region = region, .municipality = municipality_slug, .component = component) else NULL }
      }

  # LOAD ALL DATA FOR ONE MUNICIPALITY

    #' Load all 6 components for a single municipality
      #' @param region Region URL key
      #' @param municipality_slug Municipality slug
      #' @param verbose Print progress messages
      #' @return Named list of tibbles (one per component)
        load_municipality_github <- function(region, municipality_slug, verbose = TRUE) {
            
            if (verbose) cat(glue("Loading {region}/{municipality_slug}...\n"))
            
            results <- COMPONENTS %>%
                set_names() %>%
                map(function(comp) {
                    data <- load_component_github(region, municipality_slug, comp)
                    if (verbose && !is.null(data)) cat(glue("  ✓ {comp}\n"))
                    if (verbose && is.null(data)) cat(glue("  ✗ {comp} (not found)\n"))
                    data
                }) %>%
                compact()
            
            if (verbose) cat(glue("  Loaded {length(results)}/6 components\n\n"))
            
            results
        }

  # LOAD ALL DATA FOR ONE REGION
  
    #' Load all municipalities in a region
      #' @param region Region URL key
      #' @param verbose Print progress messages
      #' @return Nested list: region$municipality$component
        load_region_github <- function(region_name, verbose = TRUE) {
            
            metadata <- load_municipalities_metadata()
            
            # Fix: use region_name to avoid column/variable conflict
            region_munis <- metadata %>%
                filter(region == region_name) %>%
                pull(municipality_slug)
            
            if (length(region_munis) == 0) {
                stop(glue("Region '{region_name}' not found. Available: {str_c(unique(metadata$region), collapse = ', ')}"))
            }
            
            if (verbose) cat(glue("\n=== Loading {region_name}: {length(region_munis)} municipalities ===\n\n"))
            
            region_munis %>%
                set_names() %>%
                map(~ load_municipality_github(region_name, .x, verbose = verbose))
        }

  # LOAD ALL GEORGIA DATA
  
  #' Load complete dataset for all 64 municipalities
    #' @param verbose Print progress messages
    #' @return Nested list: region$municipality$component
      load_georgia_data <- function(verbose = TRUE) {
          
          metadata <- load_municipalities_metadata()
          regions  <- unique(metadata$region)
          
          if (verbose) {
              cat(glue("\n{'=' %>% strrep(60)}\n"))
              cat("LOADING GEORGIA VULNERABILITY DATA FROM GITHUB\n")
              cat(glue("{'=' %>% strrep(60)}\n"))
              cat(glue("\nTotal: {nrow(metadata)} municipalities across {length(regions)} regions\n\n"))
          }
          
          all_data <- regions %>%
              set_names() %>%
              map(~ load_region_github(.x, verbose = verbose))
          
          if (verbose) {
              total_loaded <- all_data %>%
                  map_int(~ sum(map_int(.x, length))) %>%
                  sum()
          }
          
          all_data
      }

  # FLATTEN TO SINGLE TIBBLE (LONG FORMAT)
  
  #' Convert nested data to single long-format tibble
    #' @param data Nested list from load_georgia_data()
    #' @param component Which component to extract (e.g., "population_total")
    #' @return Single tibble with all municipalities for that component
      flatten_component <- function(data, component) {
          
          data %>%
              imap_dfr(function(region_data, region_name) {
                  region_data %>%
                      imap_dfr(function(muni_data, muni_name) {
                          if (component %in% names(muni_data)) {
                              muni_data[[component]] %>%
                                  mutate(
                                      region       = region_name,
                                      municipality = muni_name,
                                      .before      = 1
                                  )
                          } else {
                              NULL
                          }
                      })
              })
      }

  # LIST AVAILABLE REGIONS AND MUNICIPALITIES
    #' List all available regions
      list_regions <- function() {
          metadata <- load_municipalities_metadata()
          
          metadata %>%
              group_by(region) %>%
              summarise(
                  municipalities = n(),
                  complete       = sum(complete),
                  .groups        = "drop"
              ) %>%
              arrange(region)
      }
      
      #' List municipalities in a region
        list_municipalities <- function(region) {
            metadata <- load_municipalities_metadata()
            
            metadata %>%
                filter(region == !!region) %>%
                dplyr::select(municipality_slug, n_components, complete)
        }
