```{r Cleaning Pipleine for Vulnerability Data}
  # GEORGIA MUNICIPAL VULNERABILITY DATA CLEANING PIPELINE
  
    # UTILITY FUNCTIONS
  
    #' Extract Data Columns
    #'
    #' Removes metadata columns added during data loading, returning only the
    #' original statistical data columns from the raw Excel files.
    #'
    #' @param raw_data Data frame containing both metadata and data columns
    #' @return Data frame with metadata columns removed
      get_data_columns <- function(raw_data) {
          metadata_cols <- c("region", "municipality")
          has_metadata <- any(names(raw_data) %in% metadata_cols)
          
          if (has_metadata) {
              raw_data %>% dplyr::select(-any_of(metadata_cols))
          } else {
              raw_data
          }
      }
    
    #' Extract Row Values
    #'
    #' Extracts and converts values from a specific row of the dataset, handling
    #' metadata removal and type conversion to numeric format.
    #'
    #' @param raw_data Data frame to extract from
    #' @param row_num Row number to extract (1-indexed)
    #' @param start_col Starting column position (1-indexed, after metadata removal)
    #' @return Numeric vector of extracted values
      extract_row_values <- function(raw_data, row_num, start_col = 1) {
          data_only <- get_data_columns(raw_data)
          
          if (nrow(data_only) < row_num) {
              warning(str_glue("Row {row_num} does not exist (only {nrow(data_only)} rows available)"))
              return(numeric(0))
          }
          
          row_data <- data_only[row_num, ]
          values <- row_data[start_col:ncol(row_data)] %>%
              unlist() %>%
              unname() %>%
              as.numeric() %>%
              na.omit() %>%
              as.vector()
          
          return(values)
      }
    
    # DATASET-SPECIFIC CLEANING FUNCTIONS
  
    #' Clean Population Total Data
    #'
    #' Processes total population statistics by municipality and year.
    #' Handles both English and Georgian language files with identical structure.
    #' Values are stored in thousands and are converted to actual population counts.
    #'
    #' File Structure:
    #'   Row 4: Year values (starting column 2)
    #'   Row 5: Population totals in thousands (starting column 2)
    #'
    #' @param raw_data Raw data frame for population statistics
    #' @param region Region name for labeling
    #' @param municipality Municipality name for labeling
    #' @return Tibble with region, municipality, year, and population_total columns
      clean_population_total <- function(raw_data, region, municipality) {
          is_georgian <- !str_detect(raw_data[[1]][1], "Number of population")
          
          if (is_georgian) {
              cat(str_glue("NOTE: {region}/{municipality} has Georgian-language population file\n"))
          }
          
          years <- extract_row_values(raw_data, row_num = 4, start_col = 2)
          total_values <- extract_row_values(raw_data, row_num = 5, start_col = 2)
          
          min_len <- min(length(years), length(total_values))
          
          if (min_len == 0) {
              cat(str_glue("WARNING: No data extracted for {region}/{municipality}\n"))
              return(NULL)
          }
          
          tibble(
              region = region,
              municipality = municipality,
              year = years[1:min_len],
              population_total = total_values[1:min_len] * 1000
          )
      }
    
    #' Clean Healthcare Staff Data
    #'
    #' Processes healthcare staff per 1,000 population statistics, providing a
    #' standardized measure of healthcare capacity across municipalities.
    #'
    #' File Structure:
    #'   Row 2: Year values (starting column 2)
    #'   Row 5: Healthcare staff per 1,000 population (starting column 2)
    #'
    #' @param raw_data Raw data frame for healthcare statistics
    #' @param region Region name for labeling
    #' @param municipality Municipality name for labeling
    #' @return Tibble with region, municipality, year, and healthcare_staff_per_1000 columns
      clean_healthcare_staff <- function(raw_data, region, municipality) {
          years <- extract_row_values(raw_data, row_num = 2, start_col = 2)
          staff_per_1000 <- extract_row_values(raw_data, row_num = 5, start_col = 2)
          
          min_len <- min(length(years), length(staff_per_1000))
          
          if (min_len == 0) return(NULL)
          
          tibble(
              region = region,
              municipality = municipality,
              year = years[1:min_len],
              healthcare_staff_per_1000 = staff_per_1000[1:min_len]
          )
      }
    
    #' Clean Education Graduates Data
    #'
    #' Processes education graduate statistics per 1,000 population, indicating
    #' educational attainment and human capital development in each municipality.
    #' Converts academic year format to numeric year.
    #'
    #' File Structure:
    #'   Row 2: School years in "YYYY-YYYY" format (starting column 2)
    #'   Row 14: Graduates per 1,000 population (starting column 2)
    #'
    #' @param raw_data Raw data frame for education statistics
    #' @param region Region name for labeling
    #' @param municipality Municipality name for labeling
    #' @return Tibble with region, municipality, year, and education_graduates_per_1000 columns
      clean_education_graduates <- function(raw_data, region, municipality) {
          school_years_raw <- get_data_columns(raw_data)[2, ] %>%
              unlist() %>%
              unname() %>%
              as.character()
          
          years <- school_years_raw[-1] %>%
              str_extract("^\\d{4}") %>%
              as.numeric() %>%
              na.omit() %>%
              as.vector()
          
          graduates_per_1000 <- extract_row_values(raw_data, row_num = 14, start_col = 2)
          
          min_len <- min(length(years), length(graduates_per_1000))
          
          if (min_len == 0) return(NULL)
          
          tibble(
              region = region,
              municipality = municipality,
              year = years[1:min_len],
              education_graduates_per_1000 = graduates_per_1000[1:min_len]
          )
      }
    
    #' Clean Age Dependency Data
    #'
    #' Processes age dependency ratio statistics from the 2014 Population Census,
    #' providing critical demographic vulnerability indicators. Extracts three
    #' related measures that reflect dependency burden on working-age population.
    #' Handles both English and Georgian language files.
    #'
    #' File Structure:
    #'   Row 4: Total dependency ratio (column 2) - ratio of 0-14 and 65+ per 100 of 15-64
    #'   Row 5: Child dependency ratio (column 2) - ratio of 0-14 per 100 of 15-64
    #'   Row 6: Old-age dependency ratio (column 2) - ratio of 65+ per 100 of 15-64
    #'
    #' Validation: Verifies that child + old-age ratios sum to total ratio within
    #' acceptable rounding tolerance (0.2).
    #'
    #' @param raw_data Raw data frame for age dependency statistics
    #' @param region Region name for labeling
    #' @param municipality Municipality name for labeling
    #' @return Tibble with region, municipality, year (2014), and three dependency ratios
      clean_age_dependency <- function(raw_data, region, municipality) {
          is_georgian <- !str_detect(raw_data[[1]][1], "Age dependency")
          
          if (is_georgian) {
              cat(str_glue("NOTE: {region}/{municipality} has Georgian-language age_dependency file\n"))
          }
          
          data_only <- get_data_columns(raw_data)
          
          if (nrow(data_only) < 4) {
              cat(str_glue("WARNING: {region}/{municipality} age_dependency file has insufficient rows (n={nrow(data_only)})\n"))
              return(NULL)
          }
          
          total_dependency <- extract_row_values(raw_data, row_num = 4, start_col = 2)
          
          child_dependency <- if(nrow(data_only) >= 5) {
              extract_row_values(raw_data, row_num = 5, start_col = 2)
          } else {
              cat(str_glue("WARNING: {region}/{municipality} missing child dependency ratio (row 5)\n"))
              numeric(0)
          }
          
          old_age_dependency <- if(nrow(data_only) >= 6) {
              extract_row_values(raw_data, row_num = 6, start_col = 2)
          } else {
              cat(str_glue("WARNING: {region}/{municipality} missing old-age dependency ratio (row 6)\n"))
              numeric(0)
          }
          
          if (length(total_dependency) == 0) {
              cat(str_glue("ERROR: {region}/{municipality} missing total dependency ratio\n"))
              return(NULL)
          }
          
          result <- tibble(
              region = region,
              municipality = municipality,
              year = 2014,
              age_dependency_ratio = total_dependency[1],
              child_dependency_ratio = if(length(child_dependency) > 0) child_dependency[1] else NA_real_,
              old_age_dependency_ratio = if(length(old_age_dependency) > 0) old_age_dependency[1] else NA_real_
          )
          
          if (!is.na(result$child_dependency_ratio) && !is.na(result$old_age_dependency_ratio)) {
              sum_components <- result$child_dependency_ratio + result$old_age_dependency_ratio
              diff <- abs(sum_components - result$age_dependency_ratio)
              
              if (diff > 0.2) {
                  cat(str_glue("WARNING: {region}/{municipality} dependency ratios validation failed: "))
                  cat(str_glue("total={result$age_dependency_ratio}, child={result$child_dependency_ratio}, "))
                  cat(str_glue("old_age={result$old_age_dependency_ratio}, sum={sum_components}, diff={diff}\n"))
              }
          }
          
          return(result)
      }
    
    #' Clean Disability Prevalence Data
    #'
    #' Processes registered disability count statistics by year, providing a measure
    #' of vulnerable populations requiring additional support services.
    #'
    #' File Structure:
    #'   Row 2: Year values (starting column 2)
    #'   Row 4: Registered disability counts (starting column 2)
    #'
    #' @param raw_data Raw data frame for disability statistics
    #' @param region Region name for labeling
    #' @param municipality Municipality name for labeling
    #' @return Tibble with region, municipality, year, and disability_count columns
      clean_disability_prevalence <- function(raw_data, region, municipality) {
          years <- extract_row_values(raw_data, row_num = 2, start_col = 2)
          disabilities_count <- extract_row_values(raw_data, row_num = 4, start_col = 2)
          
          min_len <- min(length(years), length(disabilities_count))
          
          if (min_len == 0) return(NULL)
          
          tibble(
              region = region,
              municipality = municipality,
              year = years[1:min_len],
              disability_count = disabilities_count[1:min_len]
          )
      }
    
    #' Clean Average Wages Data
    #'
    #' Processes average monthly wage statistics, providing an indicator of
    #' economic capacity and vulnerability across municipalities.
    #' Handles special case for Tbilisi which has different file structure.
    #'
    #' File Structure:
    #'   Tbilisi: Row 1 (years), Row 2 (wages) - starting column 2
    #'   Others: Row 2 (years), Row 3 (wages) - starting column 2
    #'
    #' @param raw_data Raw data frame for wage statistics
    #' @param region Region name for labeling
    #' @param municipality Municipality name for labeling
    #' @return Tibble with region, municipality, year, and average_monthly_wage columns
      clean_average_wages <- function(raw_data, region, municipality) {
          if (nrow(raw_data) == 4) {
              years <- extract_row_values(raw_data, row_num = 1, start_col = 2)
              avg_wages <- extract_row_values(raw_data, row_num = 2, start_col = 2)
          } else {
              years <- extract_row_values(raw_data, row_num = 2, start_col = 2)
              avg_wages <- extract_row_values(raw_data, row_num = 3, start_col = 2)
          }
          
          min_len <- min(length(years), length(avg_wages))
          
          if (min_len == 0) return(NULL)
          
          tibble(
              region = region,
              municipality = municipality,
              year = years[1:min_len],
              average_monthly_wage = avg_wages[1:min_len]
          )
      }
    
    # ORCHESTRATION FUNCTIONS
  
    #' Clean Single Municipality Data
    #'
    #' Processes all available vulnerability indicators for a single municipality,
    #' applying the appropriate cleaning function to each dataset type.
    #'
    #' @param muni_data List containing raw datasets for the municipality
    #' @param region Region name for labeling
    #' @param municipality Municipality name for labeling
    #' @return List of cleaned tibbles, one per vulnerability indicator
      clean_municipality_data <- function(muni_data, region, municipality) {
          results <- list()
          
          if (!is.null(muni_data$population_total)) {
              results$population_total <- clean_population_total(
                  muni_data$population_total, region, municipality
              )
          }
          
          if (!is.null(muni_data$healthcare_staff)) {
              results$healthcare_staff <- clean_healthcare_staff(
                  muni_data$healthcare_staff, region, municipality
              )
          }
          
          if (!is.null(muni_data$education_graduates)) {
              results$education_graduates <- clean_education_graduates(
                  muni_data$education_graduates, region, municipality
              )
          }
          
          if (!is.null(muni_data$age_dependency)) {
              results$age_dependency <- clean_age_dependency(
                  muni_data$age_dependency, region, municipality
              )
          }
          
          if (!is.null(muni_data$disability_prevalence)) {
              results$disability_prevalence <- clean_disability_prevalence(
                  muni_data$disability_prevalence, region, municipality
              )
          }
          
          if (!is.null(muni_data$average_wages)) {
              results$average_wages <- clean_average_wages(
                  muni_data$average_wages, region, municipality
              )
          }
          
          return(results)
      }
    
    #' Clean All Georgia Data
    #'
    #' Processes the complete nested structure of Georgian municipal data,
    #' applying cleaning functions systematically across all regions and municipalities.
    #'
    #' @param georgia_data Nested list structure containing all raw data
    #' @param verbose Logical flag to enable progress messages
    #' @return Nested list structure with cleaned data maintaining original hierarchy
      clean_georgia_data <- function(georgia_data, verbose = FALSE) {
          all_results <- list()
          
          for (region_name in names(georgia_data)) {
              if (verbose) cat(str_glue("Processing region: {region_name}\n"))
              
              region_data <- georgia_data[[region_name]]
              all_results[[region_name]] <- list()
              
              for (muni_name in names(region_data)) {
                  if (verbose) cat(str_glue("  Processing municipality: {muni_name}\n"))
                  
                  all_results[[region_name]][[muni_name]] <-
                      clean_municipality_data(region_data[[muni_name]], region_name, muni_name)
              }
          }
          
          return(all_results)
      }
      
    #' Flatten Nested Georgia Data
    #'
    #' Converts nested list structure to a single analysis-ready tibble in long format.
    #' All vulnerability indicators are merged by region, municipality, and year,
    #' resulting in one row per municipality-year combination with all available
    #' indicators aligned temporally.
    #'
    #' @param georgia_clean Nested list from clean_georgia_data()
    #' @return Single tibble with one row per municipality-year combination
      flatten_georgia_data <- function(georgia_clean) {
          cat("\n")
          cat(str_glue("{'=' %>% strrep(70)}\n"))
          cat("FLATTENING NESTED DATA TO SINGLE TIBBLE\n")
          cat(str_glue("{'=' %>% strrep(70)}\n\n"))
          
          all_data <- map_dfr(names(georgia_clean), function(region_name) {
              region_data <- georgia_clean[[region_name]]
              
              map_dfr(names(region_data), function(muni_name) {
                  muni_data <- region_data[[muni_name]]
                  
                  components <- list(
                      muni_data$population_total,
                      muni_data$healthcare_staff,
                      muni_data$education_graduates,
                      muni_data$age_dependency,
                      muni_data$disability_prevalence,
                      muni_data$average_wages
                  )
                  
                  components <- compact(components)
                  
                  if (length(components) == 0) return(NULL)
                  
                  reduce(components, full_join, by = c("region", "municipality", "year"))
              })
          })
          
          all_data <- all_data %>%
              arrange(region, municipality, year)
          
          cat(str_glue("Total rows: {nrow(all_data)}\n"))
          cat(str_glue("Municipalities: {n_distinct(all_data$municipality)}\n"))
          cat(str_glue("Year range: {min(all_data$year, na.rm = TRUE)} - {max(all_data$year, na.rm = TRUE)}\n\n"))
          
          return(all_data)
      }
      
    # DATA QUALITY ASSESSMENT
  
    #' Assess Data Completeness
    #'
    #' Evaluates completeness of vulnerability indicators across all municipalities,
    #' identifying gaps and potential data quality issues for research planning.
    #'
    #' @param georgia_flat_data Flattened tibble from flatten_georgia_data()
    #' @return Tibble summarizing data availability by municipality
      assess_data_completeness <- function(georgia_flat_data) {
          cat("\n")
          cat(str_glue("{'=' %>% strrep(70)}\n"))
          cat("DATA COMPLETENESS ASSESSMENT\n")
          cat(str_glue("{'=' %>% strrep(70)}\n\n"))
          
          completeness <- georgia_flat_data %>%
              group_by(region, municipality) %>%
              summarise(
                  n_years = n(),
                  has_population = any(!is.na(population_total)),
                  has_healthcare = any(!is.na(healthcare_staff_per_1000)),
                  has_education = any(!is.na(education_graduates_per_1000)),
                  has_total_dependency = any(!is.na(age_dependency_ratio)),
                  has_child_dependency = any(!is.na(child_dependency_ratio)),
                  has_old_age_dependency = any(!is.na(old_age_dependency_ratio)),
                  has_disability = any(!is.na(disability_count)),
                  has_wages = any(!is.na(average_monthly_wage)),
                  .groups = "drop"
              )
          
          cat("COMPLETENESS SUMMARY:\n")
          cat(str_glue("  Total municipalities: {nrow(completeness)}/64\n"))
          cat(str_glue("  Population: {sum(completeness$has_population)}/64\n"))
          cat(str_glue("  Healthcare: {sum(completeness$has_healthcare)}/64\n"))
          cat(str_glue("  Education: {sum(completeness$has_education)}/64\n"))
          cat(str_glue("  Total dependency: {sum(completeness$has_total_dependency)}/64\n"))
          cat(str_glue("  Child dependency: {sum(completeness$has_child_dependency)}/64\n"))
          cat(str_glue("  Old-age dependency: {sum(completeness$has_old_age_dependency)}/64\n"))
          cat(str_glue("  Disability: {sum(completeness$has_disability)}/64\n"))
          cat(str_glue("  Wages: {sum(completeness$has_wages)}/64\n\n"))
          
          incomplete_dependency <- completeness %>%
              filter(has_total_dependency & (!has_child_dependency | !has_old_age_dependency))
          
          if (nrow(incomplete_dependency) > 0) {
              cat(str_glue("{'=' %>% strrep(70)}\n"))
              cat("MUNICIPALITIES WITH INCOMPLETE DEPENDENCY RATIOS:\n")
              cat(str_glue("{'=' %>% strrep(70)}\n\n"))
              print(incomplete_dependency %>% 
                      dplyr::select(region, municipality, has_child_dependency, has_old_age_dependency))
              cat("\n")
          }
          
          missing_critical <- completeness %>%
              filter(!has_population | !has_wages)
          
          if (nrow(missing_critical) > 0) {
              cat(str_glue("{'=' %>% strrep(70)}\n"))
              cat("MISSING CRITICAL INDICATORS (POPULATION OR WAGES):\n")
              cat(str_glue("{'=' %>% strrep(70)}\n\n"))
              print(missing_critical)
              cat("\n")
          }
          
          cat(str_glue("{'=' %>% strrep(70)}\n"))
          cat("DEPENDENCY RATIO VALIDATION:\n")
          cat(str_glue("{'=' %>% strrep(70)}\n\n"))
          
          validation <- georgia_flat_data %>%
              filter(!is.na(age_dependency_ratio) & 
                     !is.na(child_dependency_ratio) & 
                     !is.na(old_age_dependency_ratio)) %>%
              mutate(
                  sum_components = child_dependency_ratio + old_age_dependency_ratio,
                  difference = abs(sum_components - age_dependency_ratio),
                  valid = difference <= 0.2
              )
          
          cat(str_glue("  Complete dependency data: {nrow(validation)} municipality-years\n"))
          cat(str_glue("  Valid sums (within 0.2): {sum(validation$valid)}/{nrow(validation)}\n"))
          
          if (any(!validation$valid)) {
              cat("\n  Invalid cases (difference > 0.2):\n")
              print(validation %>% 
                      filter(!valid) %>%
                      dplyr::select(region, municipality, year, age_dependency_ratio, 
                             child_dependency_ratio, old_age_dependency_ratio, difference))
          }
          
          cat("\n")
          return(completeness)
      }
    
    # EXECUTION: DATA CLEANING PIPELINE
  
    georgia_clean <- clean_georgia_data(georgia, verbose = TRUE)
    
    georgia_flat <- flatten_georgia_data(georgia_clean)
    
    completeness_summary <- assess_data_completeness(georgia_flat)
    
    georgia_flat %>%
        filter(municipality == "batumi", year >= 2020) %>%
        print()
  
```

```{r Finalizing vulnerability data}
# CONSTRUCT SOCIAL VULNERABILITY INDEX
# Z-score standardization approach with directionality adjustment

  georgia_svi <- georgia_vulndata |>
  	mutate(
  		# Convert disability count to rate per 1,000 population
  		  disability_rate_per_1000 = (disability_count / population_total) * 1000
  	) |>
  	mutate(
  		# Z-score standardize all indicator variables
  		# Using across() for clean application to multiple columns
    		across(
    			c(healthcare_staff_per_1000, 
    			  education_graduates_per_1000,
    			  child_dependency_ratio, 
    			  old_age_dependency_ratio,
    			  disability_rate_per_1000, 
    			  average_monthly_wage),
    			\(x) (x - mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)) / sd(x, na.rm = TRUE),
    			.names = "z_{.col}"
    		)
    	) |>
  	mutate(
  		# Reverse protective factors (higher value = lower vulnerability)
  		# Healthcare staff, education graduates, and wages are protective
    		z_healthcare_staff_per_1000   = -z_healthcare_staff_per_1000,
    		z_education_graduates_per_1000 = -z_education_graduates_per_1000,
    		z_average_monthly_wage        = -z_average_monthly_wage
    	) |>
    	mutate(
  		# Composite SVI: simple unweighted mean of z-scores
  		# Higher values indicate greater vulnerability
    		svi_composite = rowMeans(
    			across(starts_with("z_")),
    			na.rm = TRUE
    		)
    	) |>
  	# Arrange by vulnerability (most vulnerable first)
  	  arrange(desc(svi_composite))
```

```{r SVI Leaflet Map}
                "<strong>Disability Rate per 1,000:</strong> ", round(disability_rate_per_1000, 2)
            )
        )

  # Build interactive leaflet map
    svi_interactive_map <- leaflet(georgia_map_interactive) |>
        addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron) |>
          addPolygons(
              data = georgia_admin0,
              fillColor = "grey90",
              fillOpacity = 0.3,
              color = "grey70",
              weight = 1.5,
              popup = "Area outside government control"
          ) |>
          addPolygons(
              fillColor = ~ifelse(is.na(svi_composite), "grey", pal(svi_composite)),
              fillOpacity = 0.7,
              color = "white",
              weight = 1,
              popup = ~popup_text,
              highlightOptions = highlightOptions(
                  weight = 2,
                  color = "#666",
                  fillOpacity = 0.9,
                  bringToFront = TRUE
              )
          ) |>
          addLegend(
              position = "bottomright",
              pal = pal,
              values = ~svi_composite,
              title = "Social Vulnerability<br/>Index",
              opacity = 0.7,
              na.label = ""
          ) |>
          addLegend(
              position = "bottomright",
              colors = "grey",
              labels = "No SVI data",
              opacity = 0.7
          )
```

```{r SVI LISA}

  # DROP ROWS WITH MISSING SVI DATA BEFORE ANALYSIS
  # Local Moran's I requires a complete, contiguous spatial dataset
    georgia_map_lisa <- georgia_map_new |>
        filter(!is.na(svi_composite))

  # BUILD QUEEN CONTIGUITY SPATIAL WEIGHTS MATRIX
  # Queen contiguity: shared borders AND vertices (appropriate for irregular admin boundaries)
    queen_weights <- queen_weights(georgia_map_lisa)
    summary(queen_weights)

  # COMPUTE LOCAL MORAN'S I
  # Returns LISA (Local Indicators of Spatial Association) object
    lisa_result <- local_moran(
        w           = queen_weights,
        df          = georgia_map_lisa["svi_composite"],
        permutations = 9999,   # Number of conditional permutations for pseudo p-values
        significance_cutoff = 0.05
    )

  # EXTRACT LISA RESULTS INTO THE SPATIAL DATAFRAME
    georgia_map_lisa <- georgia_map_lisa |>
        mutate(
            lisa_ii       = lisa_values(lisa_result),        # Local Moran's Ii statistic
            lisa_pvalue   = lisa_pvalues(lisa_result),       # Pseudo p-value
            lisa_cluster  = lisa_clusters(lisa_result),      # Cluster type (integer code)
            lisa_label    = lisa_labels(lisa_result)[lisa_clusters(lisa_result) + 1]
                            # Cluster labels: "Not significant", "High-High", "Low-Low",
                            # "High-Low", "Low-High", "Undefined"
        )

  # DEFINE CLUSTER COLORS CONSISTENT WITH GEODA CONVENTION
    lisa_colors <- c(
        "Not significant" = "grey85",
        "High-High"       = "#d7191c",   # Red:    High SVI surrounded by high SVI
        "Low-Low"         = "#2c7bb6",   # Blue:   Low SVI surrounded by low SVI
        "High-Low"        = "#fdae61",   # Orange: High SVI surrounded by low SVI (outlier)
        "Low-High"        = "#abd9e9",   # Lt Blue: Low SVI surrounded by high SVI (outlier)
        "Undefined"       = "#484848"
    )

  # MAP: LOCAL MORAN'S I CLUSTER MAP
    georgia_lisa_map <- ggplot() +
        # Base layer: full country extent (occupied territories + country outline)
          geom_sf(
              data  = georgia_admin0,
              fill  = "grey90",
              color = NA,
              size  = 0.05
          ) +
        # LISA cluster layer
          geom_sf(
              data = georgia_map_lisa,
              aes(fill = lisa_label),
              color = "white",
              linewidth = 0.2
          ) +
          scale_fill_manual(
              values = lisa_colors,
              name   = "LISA Cluster\n(p < 0.05)",
              # Enforce display order in legend
              breaks = c("High-High", "Low-Low", "High-Low", "Low-High", "Not significant")
          ) +
          theme_minimal() +
          theme(
              legend.position   = "right",
              panel.grid        = element_blank(),
              axis.text         = element_text(size = 8),
              axis.ticks        = element_line(color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.2),
              axis.title        = element_blank()
          ) +
          labs(
              title    = "Local Moran's I: Spatial Clustering of Social Vulnerability",
              subtitle = "Georgia municipalities | Queen contiguity weights | 9999 permutations"
          )

    print(georgia_lisa_map)

  # SIGNIFICANT CLUSTER SUMMARY TABLE
  # Filter to statistically significant locations only (p < 0.05, excluding "Not significant" and "Undefined")
    lisa_sig_table <- georgia_map_lisa |>
        st_drop_geometry() |>
        filter(
            lisa_pvalue < 0.05,
            !lisa_label %in% c("Not significant", "Undefined")
        ) |>
        dplyr::select(
            Municipality  = municipality_mapped,
            Region        = region,
            SVI           = svi_composite,
            `Moran's Ii`  = lisa_ii,
            `p-value`     = lisa_pvalue,
            `Cluster Type` = lisa_label
        ) |>
        arrange(`Cluster Type`, desc(SVI))

    cat("=== SIGNIFICANT LISA CLUSTERS (p < 0.05) ===\n\n")
    print(lisa_sig_table)
    cat("\nCluster counts:\n")
    print(table(lisa_sig_table$`Cluster Type`))
```

```{r INFORM Risk Index — maxSSS (Conservative)}

## ── Preserve MC results under a unique name ──────────────────────────────────
  ## Prevents data loss if the continuous MC chunk runs later in the same session
  	mc_results_maxsss    <- mc_results
  	disease_groups_saved <- disease_groups


# CONFIGURATION

	EPSILON   <- 0.01   ## Shift constant on 0–1 scale; prevents geometric mean collapse
	SCALE_MAX <- 1    ## INFORM standard upper bound

# Run lookups to adjoin svi and population	

    svi_lookup <- set_names(
        georgia_map_new$svi_composite,
        georgia_map_new$municipality_mapped
    )
    pop_lookup <- set_names(
        georgia_map_new$population_total,
        georgia_map_new$municipality_mapped
    )

    muni_order     <- rownames(mc_results_maxsss[[1]])
    population_vec <- pop_lookup[muni_order]
    svi_raw        <- svi_lookup[muni_order]
    n_muni         <- length(muni_order)


# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# NORMALISE SVI TO 0–10 SCALE
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
## SVI is static across iterations (no MC sampling), so normalise once.
## Municipalities without SVI data receive NA and propagate through to risk.

	svi_range <- range(svi_raw, na.rm = TRUE)
  svi_norm  <- ((svi_raw - svi_range[1]) / diff(svi_range)) * (SCALE_MAX - EPSILON) + EPSILON


# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# COMPUTE GLOBAL NORMALISATION BOUNDS
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
## Fixed across all iterations to ensure consistent 0–10 scaling.
## For multi-scenario analyses, these bounds should span all scenarios.

	global_bounds <- purrr::map_dfr(disease_groups_saved, function(dg) {

		mat <- mc_results_maxsss[[dg]]

		## Relative exposure: raw MC values
		rel_min <- min(mat, na.rm = TRUE)
		rel_max <- max(mat, na.rm = TRUE)

		## Absolute exposure: relative × population (vector recycled across columns)
		abs_mat <- sweep(mat, 1, population_vec, `*`)
		abs_min <- min(abs_mat, na.rm = TRUE)
		abs_max <- max(abs_mat, na.rm = TRUE)

		tibble(
			disease_group = dg,
			rel_min       = rel_min,
			rel_max       = rel_max,
			abs_min       = abs_min,
			abs_max       = abs_max
		)
	})


# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# PER-ITERATION INFORM RISK COMPUTATION
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
## For each MC iteration:
##   1. Normalise relative and absolute exposure per disease group → 0–10
##   2. Average to get disease group index
##   3. Epsilon-adjusted geometric mean across groups → overall hazard
##   4. Epsilon-adjusted geometric mean of hazard × SVI → risk

	## Pre-allocate output matrices (municipalities × iterations)
	hazard_mat <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = n_muni, ncol = N_ITERATIONS,
	                     dimnames = list(muni_order, NULL))
	risk_mat   <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = n_muni, ncol = N_ITERATIONS,
	                     dimnames = list(muni_order, NULL))

	## Store per-group indices for downstream diagnostics and bivariate mapping
	group_index_mats <- purrr::map(disease_groups_saved, ~ {
		matrix(NA_real_, nrow = n_muni, ncol = N_ITERATIONS,
		       dimnames = list(muni_order, NULL))
	}) |>
		set_names(disease_groups_saved)

	cat("  Computing per-iteration INFORM risk...\n")

	purrr::walk(seq_len(N_ITERATIONS), function(iter) {

		## ── Disease group indices ─────────────────────────────────────────────
		group_vals <- purrr::map(disease_groups_saved, function(dg) {

			bounds <- global_bounds |> dplyr::filter(disease_group == dg)

			## Raw MC exposure for this iteration
			relative <- mc_results_maxsss[[dg]][, iter]
			absolute <- relative * population_vec

			## Min-max normalise to 0–10 using pre-computed global bounds
			rel_range <- bounds$rel_max - bounds$rel_min
			abs_range <- bounds$abs_max - bounds$abs_min

      rel_norm <- dplyr::if_else(
          rep(rel_range > 0, n_muni),
          ((relative - bounds$rel_min) / rel_range) * (SCALE_MAX - EPSILON) + EPSILON,
          EPSILON
      )
      abs_norm <- dplyr::if_else(
          rep(abs_range > 0, n_muni),
          ((absolute - bounds$abs_min) / abs_range) * (SCALE_MAX - EPSILON) + EPSILON,
          EPSILON
      )

			## Disease group index = arithmetic mean of relative + absolute
			group_idx <- (rel_norm + abs_norm) / 2

			## Store for later extraction
			group_index_mats[[dg]][, iter] <<- group_idx

			group_idx
		})

		## ── Overall hazard: epsilon-adjusted geometric mean across groups ─────
		## Stack into matrix (n_muni × n_groups) for row-wise aggregation
		group_matrix <- do.call(cbind, group_vals)

		hazard_vec <- apply(group_matrix, 1, function(row) {
			shifted <- row + EPSILON
			exp(mean(log(shifted), na.rm = TRUE)) - EPSILON
		})

		## Clamp to valid range
		hazard_vec <- pmax(0, pmin(hazard_vec, SCALE_MAX))
		hazard_mat[, iter] <<- hazard_vec

		## ── Risk: epsilon-adjusted geometric mean of hazard × SVI ─────────────
		risk_vec <- sqrt((hazard_vec + EPSILON) * (svi_norm + EPSILON)) - EPSILON
		risk_vec <- pmax(0, pmin(risk_vec, SCALE_MAX))
		risk_mat[, iter] <<- risk_vec
	})

	cat("  Done.\n\n")


# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# SUMMARISE MC RESULTS
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

	## Overall hazard summary
	hazard_summary <- tibble(
    municipality_mapped = muni_order,
		hazard_mean = rowMeans(hazard_mat, na.rm = TRUE),
		hazard_sd   = apply(hazard_mat, 1, sd, na.rm = TRUE),
		hazard_q025 = apply(hazard_mat, 1, quantile, probs = 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
		hazard_q975 = apply(hazard_mat, 1, quantile, probs = 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)
	)

	## Overall risk summary
	risk_summary_maxsss <- tibble(
    municipality_mapped = muni_order,
		svi_raw   = svi_raw,
		svi_norm  = svi_norm,
		risk_mean = rowMeans(risk_mat, na.rm = TRUE),
		risk_sd   = apply(risk_mat, 1, sd, na.rm = TRUE),
		risk_q025 = apply(risk_mat, 1, quantile, probs = 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
		risk_q975 = apply(risk_mat, 1, quantile, probs = 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)
	) |>
		left_join(
			hazard_summary |> dplyr::select(municipality_mapped, hazard_mean, hazard_sd),
			by = "municipality_mapped"
		)

	## Per-group disease hazard indices (mean across MC iterations)
	group_index_summary_maxsss <- purrr::map_dfr(disease_groups_saved, function(dg) {
		mat <- group_index_mats[[dg]]
		tibble(
			disease_group   = dg,
      municipality_mapped = muni_order,
			group_idx_mean  = rowMeans(mat, na.rm = TRUE),
			group_idx_sd    = apply(mat, 1, sd, na.rm = TRUE),
			group_idx_q025  = apply(mat, 1, quantile, probs = 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
			group_idx_q975  = apply(mat, 1, quantile, probs = 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)
		)
	}) |>
		left_join(disease_labels, by = "disease_group")


# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# CONSOLE DIAGNOSTICS
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

	cat("══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
	cat("  RISK INDEX SUMMARY — maxSSS (Conservative)\n")
	cat("══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

	cat("  Overall Risk:\n")
	cat("    Mean:  ", round(mean(risk_summary_maxsss$risk_mean, na.rm = TRUE), 3), "\n")
	cat("    Range: ", round(min(risk_summary_maxsss$risk_mean, na.rm = TRUE), 3), "–",
	    round(max(risk_summary_maxsss$risk_mean, na.rm = TRUE), 3), "\n\n")

	## Top and bottom 5 municipalities by risk
	cat("  Top 5 municipalities (highest risk):\n")
	risk_summary_maxsss |>
		dplyr::filter(!is.na(risk_mean)) |>
		arrange(desc(risk_mean)) |>
		head(5) |>
		mutate(label = paste0("    ", municipality_mapped, ": ",
		                      round(risk_mean, 2), " ± ", round(risk_sd, 2),
		                      "  [hazard: ", round(hazard_mean, 2),
		                      ", SVI: ", round(svi_norm, 2), "]")) |>
		pull(label) |>
		cat(sep = "\n")

	cat("\n\n  Bottom 5 municipalities (lowest risk):\n")
	risk_summary_maxsss |>
		dplyr::filter(!is.na(risk_mean)) |>
		arrange(risk_mean) |>
		head(5) |>
		mutate(label = paste0("    ", municipality_mapped, ": ",
		                      round(risk_mean, 2), " ± ", round(risk_sd, 2),
		                      "  [hazard: ", round(hazard_mean, 2),
		                      ", SVI: ", round(svi_norm, 2), "]")) |>
		pull(label) |>
		cat(sep = "\n")

	cat("\n\n  Per-group hazard index means:\n")
	group_index_summary_maxsss |>
		group_by(disease_label) |>
		summarise(
			mean_idx = round(mean(group_idx_mean, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
			max_idx  = round(max(group_idx_mean, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
			.groups  = "drop"
		) |>
		arrange(desc(mean_idx)) |>
		print(n = 20, width = Inf)


# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# SAVE OUTPUTS
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

	write_csv(
		risk_summary_maxsss,
		file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "inform_risk_maxsss_baseline.csv")
	)
	cat("\n  ✓ inform_risk_maxsss_baseline.csv\n")

	write_csv(
		group_index_summary_maxsss,
		file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "inform_group_indices_maxsss_baseline.csv")
	)
	cat("  ✓ inform_group_indices_maxsss_baseline.csv\n")

	write_csv(
		hazard_summary,
		file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "inform_hazard_maxsss_baseline.csv")
	)
	cat("  ✓ inform_hazard_maxsss_baseline.csv\n")

	cat("\nAll INFORM (maxSSS) outputs saved to:", OUTPUT_DIR, "\n")
```

```{r INFORM Risk Index — Continuous (Liberal)}
## ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
## INFORM-STYLE RISK INDEX — CONTINUOUS SUITABILITY (LIBERAL) APPROACH
##
## Identical INFORM aggregation framework to the maxSSS version, but uses
## continuous habitat suitability values rather than binary threshold
## classifications. This preserves ecological gradients and eliminates
## threshold boundary artefacts.
##
## Key difference:
##   maxSSS:     E = Σ w_i × I(suit_i ≥ threshold_i)   [binary]
##   Continuous: E = Σ w_i × suit_i                      [gradient]
##
## PLACEMENT: This chunk must run AFTER the 'Vector Groupings Construction
##            w/ Monte Carlo for simple cont. values' chunk.
## ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════


## ── Preserve MC results under a unique name ──────────────────────────────────
	mc_results_continuous <- mc_results
	disease_groups_saved  <- disease_groups


# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# CONFIGURATION
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

	EPSILON   <- 0.01
	SCALE_MAX <- 1


# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# ## Both hazard (MC matrices) and SVI (georgia_map_new) are now keyed
## on municipality_mapped
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    svi_lookup <- set_names(
        georgia_map_new$svi_composite,
        georgia_map_new$municipality_mapped
    )
    pop_lookup <- set_names(
        georgia_map_new$population_total,
        georgia_map_new$municipality_mapped
    )

    muni_order     <- rownames(mc_results_maxsss[[1]])
    population_vec <- pop_lookup[muni_order]
    svi_raw        <- svi_lookup[muni_order]
    n_muni         <- length(muni_order)


# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# NORMALISE SVI TO 0–10 SCALE
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

	svi_range <- range(svi_raw, na.rm = TRUE)
	svi_norm  <- ((svi_raw - svi_range[1]) / diff(svi_range)) * (SCALE_MAX - EPSILON) + EPSILON


# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# COMPUTE GLOBAL NORMALISATION BOUNDS
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

	global_bounds <- purrr::map_dfr(disease_groups_saved, function(dg) {

		mat <- mc_results_continuous[[dg]]

		rel_min <- min(mat, na.rm = TRUE)
		rel_max <- max(mat, na.rm = TRUE)

		abs_mat <- sweep(mat, 1, population_vec, `*`)
		abs_min <- min(abs_mat, na.rm = TRUE)
		abs_max <- max(abs_mat, na.rm = TRUE)

		tibble(
			disease_group = dg,
			rel_min       = rel_min,
			rel_max       = rel_max,
			abs_min       = abs_min,
			abs_max       = abs_max
		)
	})


# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# PER-ITERATION INFORM RISK COMPUTATION
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

	hazard_mat <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = n_muni, ncol = N_ITERATIONS,
	                     dimnames = list(muni_order, NULL))
	risk_mat   <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = n_muni, ncol = N_ITERATIONS,
	                     dimnames = list(muni_order, NULL))

	group_index_mats <- purrr::map(disease_groups_saved, ~ {
		matrix(NA_real_, nrow = n_muni, ncol = N_ITERATIONS,
		       dimnames = list(muni_order, NULL))
	}) |>
		set_names(disease_groups_saved)

	cat("  Computing per-iteration INFORM risk...\n")

	purrr::walk(seq_len(N_ITERATIONS), function(iter) {

		## ── Disease group indices ─────────────────────────────────────────────
		group_vals <- purrr::map(disease_groups_saved, function(dg) {

			bounds <- global_bounds |> dplyr::filter(disease_group == dg)

			relative <- mc_results_continuous[[dg]][, iter]
			absolute <- relative * population_vec

			rel_range <- bounds$rel_max - bounds$rel_min
			abs_range <- bounds$abs_max - bounds$abs_min

			rel_norm <- dplyr::if_else(
				rep(rel_range > 0, n_muni),
				((relative - bounds$rel_min) / rel_range) * SCALE_MAX,
				0
			)
			abs_norm <- dplyr::if_else(
				rep(abs_range > 0, n_muni),
				((absolute - bounds$abs_min) / abs_range) * SCALE_MAX,
				0
			)

			group_idx <- (rel_norm + abs_norm) / 2
			group_index_mats[[dg]][, iter] <<- group_idx
			group_idx
		})

		## ── Overall hazard: epsilon-adjusted geometric mean across groups ─────
		group_matrix <- do.call(cbind, group_vals)

		hazard_vec <- apply(group_matrix, 1, function(row) {
			shifted <- row + EPSILON
			exp(mean(log(shifted), na.rm = TRUE)) - EPSILON
		})

		hazard_vec <- pmax(0, pmin(hazard_vec, SCALE_MAX))
		hazard_mat[, iter] <<- hazard_vec

		## ── Risk: epsilon-adjusted geometric mean of hazard × SVI ─────────────
		risk_vec <- sqrt((hazard_vec + EPSILON) * (svi_norm + EPSILON)) - EPSILON
		risk_vec <- pmax(0, pmin(risk_vec, SCALE_MAX))
		risk_mat[, iter] <<- risk_vec
	})

	cat("  Done.\n\n")


# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# SUMMARISE MC RESULTS
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

	hazard_summary_cont <- tibble(
    municipality_mapped = muni_order,
		hazard_mean = rowMeans(hazard_mat, na.rm = TRUE),
		hazard_sd   = apply(hazard_mat, 1, sd, na.rm = TRUE),
		hazard_q025 = apply(hazard_mat, 1, quantile, probs = 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
		hazard_q975 = apply(hazard_mat, 1, quantile, probs = 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)
	)

	risk_summary_continuous <- tibble(
		municipality_mapped = muni_order,
		svi_raw   = svi_raw,
		svi_norm  = svi_norm,
		risk_mean = rowMeans(risk_mat, na.rm = TRUE),
		risk_sd   = apply(risk_mat, 1, sd, na.rm = TRUE),
		risk_q025 = apply(risk_mat, 1, quantile, probs = 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
		risk_q975 = apply(risk_mat, 1, quantile, probs = 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)
	) |>
		## Attach hazard estimates for diagnostic reporting
		left_join(hazard_summary_cont, by = "municipality_mapped")

	group_index_summary_continuous <- purrr::map_dfr(disease_groups_saved, function(dg) {
		mat <- group_index_mats[[dg]]
		tibble(
			disease_group   = dg,
      municipality_mapped = muni_order,
			group_idx_mean  = rowMeans(mat, na.rm = TRUE),
			group_idx_sd    = apply(mat, 1, sd, na.rm = TRUE),
			group_idx_q025  = apply(mat, 1, quantile, probs = 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
			group_idx_q975  = apply(mat, 1, quantile, probs = 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)
		)
	}) |>
		left_join(disease_labels, by = "disease_group")


# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# CONSOLE DIAGNOSTICS
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

	cat("══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
	cat("  RISK INDEX SUMMARY — Continuous (Liberal)\n")
	cat("══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")

	cat("  Overall Risk:\n")
	cat("    Mean:  ", round(mean(risk_summary_continuous$risk_mean, na.rm = TRUE), 3), "\n")
	cat("    Range: ", round(min(risk_summary_continuous$risk_mean, na.rm = TRUE), 3), "–",
	    round(max(risk_summary_continuous$risk_mean, na.rm = TRUE), 3), "\n\n")

	cat("  Top 5 municipalities (highest risk):\n")
	risk_summary_continuous |>
		dplyr::filter(!is.na(risk_mean)) |>
		arrange(desc(risk_mean)) |>
		head(5) |>
		mutate(label = paste0("    ", municipality_mapped, ": ",
		                      round(risk_mean, 2), " ± ", round(risk_sd, 2),
		                      "  [hazard: ", round(hazard_mean, 2),
		                      ", SVI: ", round(svi_norm, 2), "]")) |>
		pull(label) |>
		cat(sep = "\n")

	cat("\n\n  Bottom 5 municipalities (lowest risk):\n")
	risk_summary_continuous |>
		dplyr::filter(!is.na(risk_mean)) |>
		arrange(risk_mean) |>
		head(5) |>
		mutate(label = paste0("    ", municipality_mapped, ": ",
		                      round(risk_mean, 2), " ± ", round(risk_sd, 2),
		                      "  [hazard: ", round(hazard_mean, 2),
		                      ", SVI: ", round(svi_norm, 2), "]")) |>
		pull(label) |>
		cat(sep = "\n")

	cat("\n\n  Per-group hazard index means:\n")
	group_index_summary_continuous |>
		group_by(disease_label) |>
		summarise(
			mean_idx = round(mean(group_idx_mean, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
			max_idx  = round(max(group_idx_mean, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
			.groups  = "drop"
		) |>
		arrange(desc(mean_idx)) |>
		print(n = 20, width = Inf)


# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# COMPARISON: maxSSS vs. CONTINUOUS RISK ESTIMATES
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
## If the maxSSS risk summary is still in the environment, compute
## the rank correlation between the two approaches as a concordance check.

	if (exists("risk_summary_maxsss")) {

		comparison_df <- risk_summary_maxsss |>
			dplyr::select(municipality_mapped, risk_maxsss = risk_mean) |>
			left_join(
				risk_summary_continuous |>
					dplyr::select(municipality_mapped, risk_continuous = risk_mean),
				by = "municipality_mapped"
			) |>
			dplyr::filter(!is.na(risk_maxsss), !is.na(risk_continuous))

		rho <- cor(comparison_df$risk_maxsss, comparison_df$risk_continuous,
		           method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs")

		cat("\n\n══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
		cat("  CONCORDANCE: maxSSS vs. Continuous Risk\n")
		cat("══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n\n")
		cat("  Spearman rho:    ", round(rho, 4), "\n")
		cat("  N municipalities:", nrow(comparison_df), "\n")
		cat("  Mean difference: ", round(mean(comparison_df$risk_continuous -
		                                       comparison_df$risk_maxsss, na.rm = TRUE), 3), "\n")
		cat("  Max |difference|:", round(max(abs(comparison_df$risk_continuous -
		                                          comparison_df$risk_maxsss), na.rm = TRUE), 3), "\n\n")

		## Identify municipalities with largest rank shifts
		comparison_df <- comparison_df |>
			mutate(
				rank_maxsss    = rank(-risk_maxsss),
				rank_continuous = rank(-risk_continuous),
				rank_shift     = rank_maxsss - rank_continuous
			) |>
			arrange(desc(abs(rank_shift)))

		cat("  Largest rank shifts (maxSSS rank − continuous rank):\n")
		comparison_df |>
			head(5) |>
			mutate(label = paste0("    ", municipality_mapped,
			                      ": maxSSS rank ", rank_maxsss,
			                      " → continuous rank ", rank_continuous,
			                      " (Δ ", rank_shift, ")")) |>
			pull(label) |>
			cat(sep = "\n")
		cat("\n")
	}


# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# SAVE OUTPUTS
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

	write_csv(
		risk_summary_continuous,
		file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "inform_risk_continuous_baseline.csv")
	)
	cat("\n  ✓ inform_risk_continuous_baseline.csv\n")

	write_csv(
		group_index_summary_continuous,
		file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "inform_group_indices_continuous_baseline.csv")
	)
	cat("  ✓ inform_group_indices_continuous_baseline.csv\n")

	write_csv(
		hazard_summary_cont,
		file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "inform_hazard_continuous_baseline.csv")
	)
	cat("  ✓ inform_hazard_continuous_baseline.csv\n")

	## Save concordance table if available
	if (exists("comparison_df")) {
		write_csv(
			comparison_df,
			file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "inform_risk_concordance_maxsss_vs_continuous.csv")
		)
		cat("  ✓ inform_risk_concordance_maxsss_vs_continuous.csv\n")
	}

	cat("\nAll INFORM (continuous) outputs saved to:", OUTPUT_DIR, "\n")
```

```{r INFORM Interactive Risk Map - Redesigned}
  ## INTERACTIVE LEAFLET MAP — INFORM RISK INDEX EXPLORER (matches SVI style)
  
  # PREPARE SPATIAL DATA
  
  ## Per-group indices — pivot wide first so they exist before map_sf is built
  group_wide_cont <- group_index_summary_continuous |>
      dplyr::select(
          municipality_mapped, disease_group,
          group_idx_mean, group_idx_q025, group_idx_q975
      ) |>
      tidyr::pivot_wider(
          names_from  = disease_group,
          values_from = c(group_idx_mean, group_idx_q025, group_idx_q975),
          names_glue  = "cont_{.value}_{disease_group}"
      )
  
  ## Build map_sf in a single pipeline
  map_sf <- georgia_map_new |>
      dplyr::select(
          -dplyr::matches("^(cont|maxsss)_(risk|risksd|q025|q975|hazard|group_idx)")
      ) |>
      left_join(
          risk_summary_continuous |>
              dplyr::select(
                  municipality_mapped,
                  cont_risk    = risk_mean,
                  cont_risksd  = risk_sd,
                  cont_q025    = risk_q025,
                  cont_q975    = risk_q975,
                  cont_hazard  = hazard_mean
              ),
          by = "municipality_mapped"
      ) |>
      left_join(group_wide_cont, by = "municipality_mapped") |>
      mutate(
          municipality_mapped = stringr::str_to_title(municipality_mapped),
          region              = stringr::str_to_title(region)
      )
  
  ## Disease group keys and labels
  dg_keys   <- unique(group_index_summary_continuous$disease_group)
  dg_labels <- disease_labels$disease_label[match(dg_keys, disease_labels$disease_group)]
  dg_labels <- dplyr::if_else(is.na(dg_labels), dg_keys, dg_labels)
  
  # HELPER: build popup — overall risk/hazard + all group indices in one table
  
  make_popup <- function(df) {
  
      purrr::pmap_chr(df, function(municipality_mapped, region,
                                    cont_risk, cont_q025, cont_q975,
                                    cont_hazard, svi_composite,
                                    population_total, ...) {
  
          dots <- list(...)
  
          ## ── Header ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
          header <- paste0(
              "<strong style='font-size:13px;'>", municipality_mapped, "</strong><br/>",
              "<em style='color:#555;'>Region: ", region, "</em>",
              "<hr style='margin:5px 0;'/>"
          )
  
          ## ── Demographic summary ───────────────────────────────────────────────
          demo_rows <- paste0(
              "<table style='width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:12px;margin-bottom:4px;'>",
              "<tr>",
                "<td style='color:#555;padding:2px 6px 2px 0;'>Population</td>",
                "<td style='font-weight:600;padding:2px 0;' colspan='2'>",
                  format(round(population_total), big.mark = ","),
                "</td>",
              "</tr>",
              "<tr>",
                "<td style='color:#555;padding:2px 6px 2px 0;'>SVI Composite</td>",
                "<td style='font-weight:600;padding:2px 0;' colspan='2'>",
                  ifelse(is.na(svi_composite), "n/a", round(svi_composite, 2)),
                "</td>",
              "</tr>",
              "</table>"
          )
  
          ## ── Section header helper ─────────────────────────────────────────────
          section_header <- function(title) {
              paste0(
                  "<tr>",
                    "<td colspan='3' style='",
                      "font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:0.04em;",
                      "text-transform:uppercase;color:#888;",
                      "padding:5px 0 2px 0;border-top:1px solid #ddd;",
                    "'>", title, "</td>",
                  "</tr>"
              )
          }
  
          ## ── Risk index rows ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
          risk_rows <- paste0(
              "<table style='width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:12px;'>",
              section_header("Risk Indices"),
              "<tr>",
                "<td style='color:#555;padding:2px 6px 2px 0;'>Overall Risk</td>",
                "<td style='font-weight:600;padding:2px 0;'>",
                  round(cont_risk, 2),
                "</td>",
                "<td style='color:#777;padding:2px 0 2px 8px;font-size:11px;'>",
                  "(", round(cont_q025, 2), " \u2013 ", round(cont_q975, 2), ")",
                "</td>",
              "</tr>"
          )
  
          ## ── Hazard index rows ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
          hazard_rows <- paste0(
              section_header("Hazard Indices"),
              "<tr>",
                "<td style='color:#555;padding:2px 6px 2px 0;'>Overall Hazard</td>",
                "<td style='font-weight:600;padding:2px 0;'>",
                  round(cont_hazard, 2),
                "</td>",
                "<td></td>",
              "</tr>"
          )
  
          ## ── Per-group hazard rows ─────────────────────────────────────────────
          group_rows <- purrr::map2_chr(dg_keys, dg_labels, function(k, lbl) {
              mean_val <- dots[[paste0("cont_group_idx_mean_", k)]]
              q025_val <- dots[[paste0("cont_group_idx_q025_", k)]]
              q975_val <- dots[[paste0("cont_group_idx_q975_", k)]]
              paste0(
                  "<tr style='border-top:1px solid #eee;'>",
                    "<td style='color:#555;padding:2px 6px 2px 0;'>", lbl, "</td>",
                    "<td style='font-weight:600;padding:2px 0;'>",
                      ifelse(is.na(mean_val), "n/a", round(mean_val, 2)),
                    "</td>",
                    "<td style='color:#777;padding:2px 0 2px 8px;font-size:11px;'>",
                      ifelse(
                          is.na(q025_val), "",
                          paste0("(", round(q025_val, 2), " \u2013 ", round(q975_val, 2), ")")
                      ),
                    "</td>",
                  "</tr>"
              )
          }) |> paste(collapse = "")
  
          paste0(header, demo_rows, risk_rows, hazard_rows, group_rows, "</table>")
      })
  }
  
  # BUILD LAYER DEFINITIONS  (continuous approach only, neutral labels)
  
  layer_defs <- list(
      list(id = "overall_risk",   label = "Overall Risk",
           mean = "cont_risk",    q025 = "cont_q025", q975 = "cont_q975"),
      list(id = "overall_hazard", label = "Overall Hazard",
           mean = "cont_hazard",  q025 = NULL,        q975 = NULL)
  )
  
  for (i in seq_along(dg_keys)) {
      k <- dg_keys[i]; lbl <- dg_labels[i]
      layer_defs <- c(layer_defs, list(
          list(id   = paste0("grp_", k),
               label = lbl,
               mean  = paste0("cont_group_idx_mean_", k),
               q025  = paste0("cont_group_idx_q025_", k),
               q975  = paste0("cont_group_idx_q975_", k))
      ))
  }
  
  # BUILD POPUP HTML  (same content for every layer — municipality-level table)
  #
  ## Pre-compute once; reused across all layers so clicking always shows
  ## the full risk profile regardless of which layer is currently displayed
  popup_html <- map_sf |>
      sf::st_drop_geometry() |>
      make_popup()
  
  # BUILD LEAFLET MAP
  
  inform_map <- leaflet(map_sf) |>
      addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron) |>
      addPolygons(
          data        = georgia_admin0,
          fillColor   = "grey90",
          fillOpacity = 0.3,
          color       = "grey70",
          weight      = 1.5,
          group       = "base",
          popup       = "Area outside government control"
      )
  
  for (ld in layer_defs) {
  
      pal_layer <- colorNumeric(
          palette  = "viridis",
          domain   = map_sf[[ld$mean]],
          na.color = "transparent"
      )
  
      inform_map <- inform_map |>
          addPolygons(
              fillColor        = ~pal_layer(map_sf[[ld$mean]]),
              fillOpacity      = 0.7,
              color            = "white",
              weight           = 1,
              popup            = popup_html,
              group            = ld$label,
              highlightOptions = highlightOptions(
                  weight       = 2,
                  color        = "#666",
                  fillOpacity  = 0.9,
                  bringToFront = TRUE
              )
          ) |>
          addLegend(
              position = "bottomright",
              pal      = pal_layer,
              values   = map_sf[[ld$mean]],
              title    = ld$label,
              opacity  = 0.7,
              na.label = "",
              group    = ld$label,
              layerId  = paste0("legend_", ld$id)
          )
  }
  
  layer_labels <- purrr::map_chr(layer_defs, "label")
  legend_ids   <- purrr::map_chr(layer_defs, ~ paste0("legend_", .x$id))
  
  inform_map <- inform_map |>
      addLayersControl(
          overlayGroups = layer_labels,
          options       = layersControlOptions(collapsed = TRUE)
      ) |>
      hideGroup(layer_labels[-1])
  
  # JS: enforce one-layer-at-a-time and sync legend visibility
  
  js_layer_array <- layer_labels |>
      purrr::imap_chr(~ paste0(
          '["', gsub('"', '\\"', .x), '","', legend_ids[.y], '"]'
      )) |>
      paste(collapse = ",\n  ")
  
  js_snippet <- paste0('
  function(el, x) {
    var layers = [
    ', js_layer_array, '
    ];
    this.on("overlayadd", function(e) {
      layers.forEach(function(pair) {
        var groupName = pair[0];
        var legendId  = pair[1];
        var isActive  = (groupName === e.name);
        var legendEl  = document.getElementById(legendId);
        if (legendEl) legendEl.style.display = isActive ? "block" : "none";
        if (!isActive) {
          var layerId = Object.keys(e.target._layers).find(function(id) {
            var l = e.target._layers[id];
            return l.options && l.options.group === groupName;
          });
          if (layerId) e.target.removeLayer(e.target._layers[layerId]);
        }
      });
    });
    layers.forEach(function(pair, idx) {
      var legendEl = document.getElementById(pair[1]);
      if (legendEl) legendEl.style.display = idx === 0 ? "block" : "none";
    });
  }
  ')
  
  inform_map <- inform_map |>
      htmlwidgets::onRender(js_snippet)
  
  # DISPLAY
  
  inform_map
```
